    }
    // Fallback
    probeFiles();
  }

  // Try /files.json first (from server.py)
  fetch(KB_BASE + 'files.json')
    .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
    .then(loadIndex)
    .catch(function() {
      // Fallback to static index.json
      fetch(KB_BASE + 'index.json')
        .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
        .then(loadIndex)
        .catch(function() {
          // Pure HTML fallback: parallel probe
          probeFiles();
        });
    });
}

function buildCombinedSearchIndex() {
  // Process in batches to avoid blocking UI
  state.searchIndex = {};
  var batchSize = 100;
  var i = 0;
  var files = state.files;
  
  function processBatch() {
    var end = Math.min(i + batchSize, files.length);
    for (; i < end; i++) {
      var f = files[i];
      state.searchIndex[f] = [];
      var title = state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].title;
      var name = f;
      var slash = f.lastIndexOf('/');
      if (slash !== -1) name = f.slice(slash + 1);
      name = name.replace(/\.md$/i, '');
      var tokens = [];
      if (title) tokens.push(title);
      tokens.push(name);
      f.split('/').forEach(function(part) {
        tokens.push(part.replace(/\.md$/i, ''));
      });
      var tags = state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].tags;
      if (tags) tokens = tokens.concat(tags);
      var type = state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].type;
      if (type) tokens.push(type);
      var text = tokens.join(' ').toLowerCase();
      text.split(/\s+/).forEach(function(word) {
        if (word.length < 2) return;
        if (!state.searchIndex[f]) state.searchIndex[f] = [];
        state.searchIndex[f].push(word);
      });
    }
    if (i < files.length) {
      setTimeout(processBatch, 0);
    }
  }
  processBatch();
}
function buildSearchIndex(filename, md) {
  var lines = md.split('\n');
  var index = [];
  lines.forEach(function(line, i) {
    var trimmed = line.trim();
    if (trimmed.length > 10) {
      index.push({ line: i + 1, text: trimmed });
    }
  });
  state.searchIndex[filename] = index;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Search
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

var searchTimeout = null;

searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
  clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
  searchTimeout = setTimeout(performSearch, 150);
});

searchInput.addEventListener('focus', function() {
  if (searchInput.value) performSearch();
});

function recordSearch(q) {
  q = String(q || '').trim();
  if (!q) return;
  try {
    var list = (localStorage.getItem('md-recent-searches') || '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
    list = [q].concat(list.filter(function(x) { return x !== q; })).slice(0, 6);
    localStorage.setItem('md-recent-searches', list.join(','));
  } catch (e) {}
}

searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Enter') recordSearch(searchInput.value);
});

function performSearch() {
  var query = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (query.length < 2) {
    searchResults.classList.remove('visible');
    searchResults.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  var results = [];
  var queryWords = query.split(/\s+/).filter(function(w) { return w.length > 0; });
  
  visibleFiles().forEach(function(f) {
    var title = state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].title;
    var type = state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].type;
    var tags = state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].tags;
    
    var name = f;
    var slash = f.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (slash !== -1) name = f.slice(slash + 1);
    name = name.replace(/\.md$/i, '');
    
    var searchText = (title || name) + ' ' + f + ' ' + (type || '');
    if (tags) searchText += ' ' + tags.join(' ');
    searchText = searchText.toLowerCase();

    var match = queryWords.every(function(w) { return searchText.indexOf(w) !== -1; });
    if (!match) return;

    var score = 0;
    var lowerName = name.toLowerCase();
    var lowerTitle = (title || '').toLowerCase();
    if (lowerTitle.indexOf(query) !== -1) score += 10;
    else if (lowerName.indexOf(query) !== -1) score += 5;
    else if (f.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1) score += 3;
    if (type && type.indexOf(query) !== -1) score += 2;
    results.push({ file: f, score: score, title: title || name, type: type });
  });

  results.sort(function(a, b) { return b.score - a.score; });
  results = results.slice(0, 50);

  if (results.length === 0) {
    searchResults.innerHTML = '<div class="search-result-item" style="padding:12px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:13px;">No matches</div>';
    searchResults.classList.add('visible');
    return;
  }

  var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
  results.forEach(function(r) {
    var el = document.createElement('a');
    el.className = 'search-result-item';
    var label = escapeHtml(r.title);
    if (r.type) label += ' <span class="search-result-type">' + escapeHtml(r.type) + '</span>';
    el.innerHTML = label;
    el.href = '#' + encodeURIComponent(r.file);
    (function(f) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        searchInput.value = '';
        searchResults.classList.remove('visible');
        closeSidebar();
        navigateTo(f);
      });
    })(r.file);
    frag.appendChild(el);
  });
  searchResults.innerHTML = '';
  searchResults.appendChild(frag);
  searchResults.classList.add('visible');
}
function renderSidebar() {
  fileList.innerHTML = '';

  // Home entry
  var home = document.createElement('a');
  home.className = 'file-entry home-entry';
  home.innerHTML = '<span class="icon">\u2302</span> All Documents';
  home.href = '#';
  home.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    closeSidebar();
    navigateHome();
  });
  if (!state.currentFile) home.classList.add('active');
  fileList.appendChild(home);

  var sectionLabel = document.getElementById('files-section-label');
  if (state.stubsOnly && !state.stubPaths) {
    if (sectionLabel) sectionLabel.textContent = 'Stub documents (loading stub index…)';
    var ld = document.createElement('div');
    ld.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);';
    ld.textContent = 'Loading stub index…';
    fileList.appendChild(ld);
    return;
  }
  var all = visibleFiles();
  var count = all.length;
  var modeLabel = showMeta ? 'Meta documents' : (state.stubsOnly ? 'Stub documents' : 'Documents');

  var query = (state.sidebarFilter || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  var filtered = query
    ? all.filter(function(f) { return sidebarMatch(f, query); })
    : all;

  if (sectionLabel) {
    if (query) {
      sectionLabel.textContent = modeLabel + ' (' + count + ' \u00b7 ' + filtered.length + ' match' + (filtered.length === 1 ? '' : 'es') + ')';
    } else {
      sectionLabel.textContent = modeLabel + ' (' + count + ')';
    }
  }

  // Quick entry points: recent documents within the current view
  var recentVisible = [];
  try {
    recentVisible = (localStorage.getItem('md-recent') || '').split(',').filter(function(f) {
      return f && filtered.indexOf(f) !== -1;
    }).slice(0, 6);
  } catch (e) {}
  if (recentVisible.length > 0) {
    var recentHeader = document.createElement('div');
    recentHeader.className = 'sidebar-section';
    var recentArrow = document.createElement('span');
    recentArrow.className = 'dir-arrow collapsed';
    recentArrow.textContent = '\u25BC';
    recentHeader.appendChild(recentArrow);
    var recentLabel = document.createElement('span');
    recentLabel.textContent = 'Recent';
    recentHeader.appendChild(recentLabel);
    var recentCount = document.createElement('span');
    recentCount.className = 'dir-count';
    recentCount.textContent = recentVisible.length;
    recentHeader.appendChild(recentCount);
    fileList.appendChild(recentHeader);
    var recentWrap = document.createElement('div');
    recentWrap.className = 'recent-entries';
    recentVisible.forEach(function(f) { recentWrap.appendChild(renderFileEntry(f)); });
    fileList.appendChild(recentWrap);
  }

  if (state.groupMode === 'area') {
    renderAreaSidebar(filtered, query);
  } else if (state.groupMode === 'type') {
    renderTypeSidebar(filtered, query);
  } else {
    renderDirSidebar(filtered);
  }
}

// ── Sidebar helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Extract the top-level wiki area for a file:
//   wiki/<area>/<rest...> -> {area, rest}
//   raw/<file>            -> {area: 'raw', rest: '<file>'}
//   <root file>           -> {area: '(root)', rest: '<file>'}
function sidebarAreaInfo(f) {
  var segs = String(f).split('/');
  if (segs.length >= 3) return { area: segs[1], rest: segs.slice(2).join('/') };
  if (segs.length === 2) return { area: segs[0], rest: segs[1] };
  return { area: '(root)', rest: f };
}

// Case-insensitive multi-term filter across path, title, type and tags.
function sidebarMatch(f, query) {
  var m = state.meta[f] || {};
  var hay = String(f).toLowerCase();
  if (m.title) hay += ' ' + String(m.title).toLowerCase();
  if (m.type) hay += ' ' + String(m.type).toLowerCase();
  if (m.tags && m.tags.length) hay += ' ' + m.tags.join(' ').toLowerCase();
  return query.split(/\s+/).every(function(t) { return hay.indexOf(t) !== -1; });
}

// Shorten a subgroup path for display: strip the boilerplate "categories"
// prefix and fold "subcategories/<x>" into "<x>".
function sidebarSubgroupLabel(dirPath) {
  var parts = String(dirPath || '').split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (parts[0] === 'categories') parts.shift();
  var out = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    if (parts[i] === 'subcategories' && i + 1 < parts.length) {
      out.push(parts[i + 1]);
      i++;
    } else {
      out.push(parts[i]);
    }
  }
  return out.join('/') || dirPath;
}

// Sort a leaf group: landing pages first, then by filename.
function sidebarGroupSort(files) {
  files.sort(function(a, b) {
    var aName = a.slice(a.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
    var bName = b.slice(b.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
    var aIdx = (aName === 'index.md' || aName === 'README.md') ? 0 : 1;
    var bIdx = (bName === 'index.md' || bName === 'README.md') ? 0 : 1;
    if (aIdx !== bIdx) return aIdx - bIdx;
    return aName.localeCompare(bName);
  });
  return files;
}

// Render a leaf group, capped at SIDEBAR_MAX_GROUP entries with a "+N more"
// link (a filter query surfaces every match, no cap).
var SIDEBAR_MAX_GROUP = 50;
function appendSidebarEntries(container, files, moreKey, query) {
  var shown = files;
  var extra = 0;
  if (!query && !state.moreOpen[moreKey] && files.length > SIDEBAR_MAX_GROUP) {
    shown = files.slice(0, SIDEBAR_MAX_GROUP);
    extra = files.length - shown.length;
  }
  shown.forEach(function(f) {
    container.appendChild(renderFileEntry(f));
  });
  if (extra > 0) {
    var more = document.createElement('button');
    more.type = 'button';
    more.className = 'more-link';
    more.textContent = '+' + extra + ' more';
    more.addEventListener('click', function() {
      state.moreOpen[moreKey] = true;
      renderSidebar();
    });
    container.appendChild(more);
  }
}

// ── Group By Area (top-level wiki areas, collapsible, capped) ──────────────
function renderAreaSidebar(filtered, query) {
  var groups = {};
  var areas = [];
  filtered.forEach(function(f) {
    var info = sidebarAreaInfo(f);
    if (!groups[info.area]) {
      groups[info.area] = { flat: [], subs: {} };
      areas.push(info.area);
    }
    var slash = info.rest.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (slash === -1) {
      groups[info.area].flat.push(f);
    } else {
      var dp = info.rest.slice(0, slash);
      if (!groups[info.area].subs[dp]) groups[info.area].subs[dp] = [];
      groups[info.area].subs[dp].push(f);
    }
  });

  areas.sort(function(a, b) {
    if (a === '(root)') return 1;
    if (b === '(root)') return -1;
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  areas.forEach(function(area) {
    var g = groups[area];
    var subPaths = Object.keys(g.subs).sort();
    var total = g.flat.length;
    subPaths.forEach(function(dp) { total += g.subs[dp].length; });

    var collapsed;
    if (state.userToggled[area]) collapsed = !!state.sectionCollapsed[area];
    else collapsed = !query && total > 120;

    var header = document.createElement('div');
    header.className = 'sidebar-section';
    var arrow = document.createElement('span');
    arrow.className = 'dir-arrow' + (collapsed ? ' collapsed' : '');
    arrow.textContent = '\u25BC';
    header.appendChild(arrow);
    var label = document.createElement('span');
    label.textContent = area;
    header.appendChild(label);
    var ec = document.createElement('span');
    ec.className = 'dir-count';
    ec.textContent = total;
    header.appendChild(ec);
    (function(a) {
      header.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        state.userToggled[a] = true;
        state.sectionCollapsed[a] = !state.sectionCollapsed[a];
        renderSidebar();
      });
    })(area);
    fileList.appendChild(header);

    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'area-entries' + (collapsed ? ' collapsed' : '');
    fileList.appendChild(container);

    if (g.flat.length > 0) {
      appendSidebarEntries(container, sidebarGroupSort(g.flat.slice()), area, query);
    }

    subPaths.forEach(function(dp) {
      var subFiles = sidebarGroupSort(g.subs[dp].slice());
      var subKey = area + '::' + dp;
      var subCollapsed = query ? false : !!state.subgroupCollapsed[subKey];

      var subHeader = document.createElement('div');
      subHeader.className = 'subgroup-header';
      var sArrow = document.createElement('span');
      sArrow.className = 'sg-arrow' + (subCollapsed ? ' collapsed' : '');
      sArrow.textContent = '\u25B8';
      subHeader.appendChild(sArrow);
      var sLabel = document.createElement('span');
      sLabel.textContent = sidebarSubgroupLabel(dp);
      subHeader.appendChild(sLabel);
      var sCount = document.createElement('span');
      sCount.className = 'sg-count';
      sCount.textContent = subFiles.length;
      subHeader.appendChild(sCount);
      (function(k) {
        subHeader.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          state.subgroupCollapsed[k] = !state.subgroupCollapsed[k];
          renderSidebar();
        });
      })(subKey);
      container.appendChild(subHeader);

      var subContainer = document.createElement('div');
      subContainer.className = 'subgroup-entries' + (subCollapsed ? ' collapsed' : '');
      container.appendChild(subContainer);
      appendSidebarEntries(subContainer, subFiles, subKey, query);
    });
  });
}

// ── Group By Type ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderTypeSidebar(filtered, query) {
  var sectionLabel = document.getElementById('files-section-label');
  var MAX_RENDER = 300;
  var fileSubset = query ? filtered : filtered.slice(0, MAX_RENDER);
  if (sectionLabel && !query && filtered.length > MAX_RENDER) {
    sectionLabel.textContent = (showMeta ? 'Meta documents' : 'Documents') + ' (' + filtered.length + ' \u00b7 showing first ' + MAX_RENDER + ')';
  }

  var typeGroups = {};
  fileSubset.forEach(function(f) {
    var entry = state.meta[f];
    var t = (entry && entry.type) || 'other';
    if (!typeGroups[t]) typeGroups[t] = [];
    typeGroups[t].push(f);
  });

  var sortedTypes = Object.keys(typeGroups).sort(function(a, b) {
    return typeGroups[b].length - typeGroups[a].length;
  });

  sortedTypes.forEach(function(typeName) {
    var entries = typeGroups[typeName];
    var typeLabel = typeName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + typeName.slice(1);

    var section = document.createElement('div');
    section.className = 'type-section';

    var header = document.createElement('div');
    header.className = 'type-section-header';

    var arrow = document.createElement('span');
    arrow.className = 'type-arrow' + (state.typeCollapsed[typeName] ? ' collapsed' : '');
    arrow.textContent = '\u25BC';
    header.appendChild(arrow);

    var label = document.createElement('span');
    label.textContent = typeLabel;
    header.appendChild(label);

    var ec = document.createElement('span');
    ec.className = 'type-count';
    ec.textContent = entries.length;
    header.appendChild(ec);

    (function(t) {
      header.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        state.typeCollapsed[t] = !state.typeCollapsed[t];
        renderSidebar();
      });
    })(typeName);

    section.appendChild(header);

    var container = document.createElement('div');
    container.className = 'type-entries' + (state.typeCollapsed[typeName] ? ' collapsed' : '');

    var sorted = entries.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
      var ta = state.meta[a] && state.meta[a].title;
      var tb = state.meta[b] && state.meta[b].title;
      if (ta && tb) return ta.localeCompare(tb);
      if (ta) return -1;
      if (tb) return 1;
      return a.localeCompare(b);
    });

    sorted.forEach(function(f) {
      container.appendChild(renderFileEntry(f));
    });

    section.appendChild(container);
    fileList.appendChild(section);
  });
}

// ── Group By Folder (directory tree) ───────────────────────────────────────
function renderDirSidebar(filtered) {
  var sectionLabel = document.getElementById('files-section-label');
  var MAX_RENDER = 300;
  var fileSubset = filtered.length > MAX_RENDER ? filtered.slice(0, MAX_RENDER) : filtered;

  var groups = {};
  fileSubset.forEach(function(f) {
    if (f === 'complete.md') return;
    var dir = '';
    var name = f;
    var slash = f.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (slash !== -1) {
      dir = f.slice(0, slash);
      name = f.slice(slash + 1);
    }
    if (!groups[dir]) groups[dir] = [];
    groups[dir].push({ full: f, name: name });
  });

  var dirs = Object.keys(groups).sort(function(a, b) {
    if (a === '') return -1;
    if (b === '') return 1;
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(dir) {
    groups[dir].sort(function(a, b) {
      var aIdx = a.name === 'index.md' || a.name === 'README.md' ? 0 : 1;
      var bIdx = b.name === 'index.md' || b.name === 'README.md' ? 0 : 1;
      if (aIdx !== bIdx) return aIdx - bIdx;
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
  });

  if (sectionLabel) {
    var base = showMeta ? 'Meta documents' : 'Documents';
    sectionLabel.textContent = fileSubset.length < filtered.length
      ? base + ' (' + filtered.length + ' \u00b7 showing first ' + MAX_RENDER + ')'
      : (dirs.length > 1
        ? base + ' (' + filtered.length + ' in ' + dirs.length + ' dirs)'
        : base + ' (' + filtered.length + ')');
  }

  dirs.forEach(function(dir) {
    var entries = groups[dir];
    if (dir !== '') {
      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sidebar-section';
      var arrow = document.createElement('span');
      arrow.className = 'dir-arrow' + (state.dirCollapsed[dir] ? ' collapsed' : '');
      arrow.textContent = '\u25BC';
      header.appendChild(arrow);
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = dir;
      header.appendChild(label);
      var ec = document.createElement('span');
      ec.className = 'dir-count';
      ec.textContent = entries.length;
      header.appendChild(ec);
      (function(d) {
        header.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          state.dirCollapsed[d] = !state.dirCollapsed[d];
          renderSidebar();
        });
      })(dir);
      fileList.appendChild(header);
    }
    var entriesContainer = document.createElement('div');
    entriesContainer.className = 'dir-entries' + (dir !== '' && state.dirCollapsed[dir] ? ' collapsed' : '');
    fileList.appendChild(entriesContainer);
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      entriesContainer.appendChild(renderFileEntry(entry.full));
    });
  });
}

function renderFileEntry(filename) {
  var wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.className = 'file-entry-wrap';

  var main = document.createElement('a');
  main.className = 'file-entry-main';
  if (state.currentFile === filename) main.classList.add('active');

  var meta = state.meta[filename] || {};
  var title = meta.title || '';
  
  var cleanName = filename;
  var slash = filename.lastIndexOf('/');
  if (slash !== -1) cleanName = filename.slice(slash + 1);
  cleanName = cleanName.replace(/\.md$/i, '');

  var displayName = title || cleanName;
  var iconChar = '\u2022';

  var arrow = document.createElement('span');
  arrow.className = 'file-arrow';
  arrow.textContent = '\u25B6';
  if (state.accordionExpanded[filename]) arrow.classList.add('expanded');

  (function(fn) {
    arrow.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
      var h = state.fileHeadings[fn] || [];
      var dh = h.filter(function(x) { return x.level <= 4; });
      if (dh.length === 0) return;
      state.accordionExpanded[fn] = !state.accordionExpanded[fn];
      renderSidebar();
    });
  })(filename);

  var label = document.createElement('span');
  label.className = 'file-label';
  label.innerHTML = '<span class="icon">' + iconChar + '</span>' + escapeHtml(displayName);
  if (!title && displayName !== cleanName) {
    // Show subtitle if we have a title different from filename
    var sub = document.createElement('span');
    sub.style.cssText = 'display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:400;margin-left:22px;margin-top:-1px;';
    sub.textContent = cleanName;
    label.appendChild(sub);
  }

  main.appendChild(arrow);
  main.appendChild(label);
  if (meta.type) {
    var chip = document.createElement('span');
    chip.className = 'type-chip ' + String(meta.type).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');
    chip.textContent = meta.type;
    chip.title = 'Type: ' + meta.type;
    main.appendChild(chip);
  }
  main.href = '#' + encodeURIComponent(filename);

  (function(fn) {
    main.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      closeSidebar();
      navigateTo(fn);
    });
  })(filename);

  wrap.appendChild(main);

  // Headings sub-list
  var hList = state.fileHeadings[filename] || [];
  var dhList = hList.filter(function(x) { return x.level <= 4; });

  if (state.accordionExpanded[filename] && dhList.length > 0) {
    var sub = document.createElement('div');
    sub.className = 'file-headings';
    dhList.forEach(function(h) {
      var hEl = document.createElement('a');
      hEl.className = 'file-heading level-' + h.level;
      hEl.textContent = h.text;
      hEl.href = '#' + encodeURIComponent(filename) + '#' + h.slug;
      (function(slug) {
        hEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          closeSidebar();
          navigateTo(filename, slug);
        });
      })(h.slug);
      sub.appendChild(hEl);
    });
    wrap.appendChild(sub);
  }

  return wrap;
}
function resolveDotSegments(p) {
  var parts = String(p || '').split('/');
  var out = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    var seg = parts[i];
    if (seg === '' || seg === '.') continue;
    if (seg === '..') { if (out.length) out.pop(); continue; }
    out.push(seg);
  }
  return out.join('/');
}

function canonicalFile(p) {
  // Return the canonical path from state.files for a lookup, case-insensitively.
  if (!p) return null;
  if (state.files.indexOf(p) !== -1) return p;
  var lower = p.toLowerCase();
  for (var i = 0; i < state.files.length; i++) {
    if (state.files[i].toLowerCase() === lower) return state.files[i];
  }
  return null;
}

function resolveWikiPath(filename) {
  // Turn any link/hash target into a canonical file path (or null).
  // Handles ../ relative links (resolved against the current file's directory),
  // wiki/ prefixes, .md suffixes, wiki/wiki/ double prefixes, and falls back to
  // a unique basename match so archived/moved pages still resolve.
  if (!filename) return null;
  var anchor = null;
  var raw = String(filename).trim();
  var hashIdx = raw.indexOf('#');
  if (hashIdx !== -1) {
    anchor = raw.slice(hashIdx + 1) || null;
    raw = raw.slice(0, hashIdx);
  }
  raw = raw.replace(/^\.\//, '');
  if (!raw) return null;

  var candidates = [];
  function push(c) {
    c = resolveDotSegments(c);
    if (c && candidates.indexOf(c) === -1) candidates.push(c);
  }
  // Relative to the current file's directory first (../foo.md)
  if (raw.indexOf('../') !== -1 && state.currentFile) {
    var curDir = state.currentFile.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/');
    push((curDir ? curDir + '/' : '') + raw);
  }
  // Root-relative, with legacy ../ segments stripped
  push(raw.replace(/(?:^|\/)\.\.\//g, ''));
  // Double wiki/wiki/ prefix
  push(raw.replace(/^wiki\/wiki\//, 'wiki/'));
  // Strip or add the wiki/ prefix
  if (raw.indexOf('wiki/') === 0) push(raw.slice(5));
  push('wiki/' + raw);

  for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
    var c = candidates[i];
    var forms = [c];
    if (/\.md$/i.test(c)) forms.push(c.replace(/\.md$/i, ''));
    else forms.push(c + '.md');
    for (var j = 0; j < forms.length; j++) {
      var canon = canonicalFile(forms[j]);
      if (canon) return { path: canon, anchor: anchor };
    }
  }

  // Unique-basename fallback (archived/moved pages)
  var base = raw.split('/').pop().replace(/\.md$/i, '').toLowerCase();
  if (base.length > 2) {
    var hits = [];
    for (var k = 0; k < state.files.length; k++) {
      var f = state.files[k];
      if (f.split('/').pop().replace(/\.md$/i, '').toLowerCase() === base) hits.push(f);
    }
    if (hits.length === 1) return { path: hits[0], anchor: anchor };
    if (hits.length > 1) {
      var wikiHits = hits.filter(function(h) { return h.indexOf('wiki/') === 0; });
      if (wikiHits.length === 1) return { path: wikiHits[0], anchor: anchor };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function navigateTo(filename, anchor) {
  if (!filename) return;
  switchContentView('doc');

  // Resolve the target against the wiki index (relative ../, prefixes, fallbacks)
  var resolved = resolveWikiPath(filename);
  if (resolved) {
    filename = resolved.path;
    if (!anchor) anchor = resolved.anchor || null;
  }

  // If already viewing this file with an anchor, just scroll
  if (filename === state.currentFile && anchor) {
    history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + encodeURIComponent(filename) + '#' + anchor);
    var el = document.getElementById(anchor);
    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    return;
  }

  state.currentFile = filename;
  fbFabUpdate();
  history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + encodeURIComponent(filename) + (anchor ? '#' + anchor : ''));
  recordRecent(filename);
  renderSidebar();

  function afterRender() {
    if (anchor) {
      setTimeout(function() {
        var el = document.getElementById(anchor);
        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      }, 100);
    }
  }

  if (state.fileContents[filename]) {
    renderContent(filename, state.fileContents[filename]);
    afterRender();
    return;
  }

  docBody.innerHTML = '<div class="loading">Loading&hellip;</div>';
  artHideToolbar();

  fetch(KB_BASE + encodeURIComponent(filename))
    .then(function(r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Not found');
      return r.text();
    })
    .catch(function() {
      // Fall back to the wiki daemon's file endpoint (local mode)
      return fetch(KB_BASE + 'api/file?path=' + encodeURIComponent(filename)).then(function(r) {
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Not found');
        return r.text();
      });
    })
    .then(function(md) {
      state.fileContents[filename] = md;
      buildSearchIndex(filename, md);
      renderContent(filename, md);
      afterRender();
    })
    .catch(function() {
      var base = String(filename).split('/').pop().replace(/\.md$/i, '');
      var searchLink = '';
      if (base && base.length > 1) {
        searchLink = '<p><a href="#" id="err-search" style="color:var(--accent);">Search for &lsquo;' + escapeHtml(base) + '&rsquo;</a></p>';
      }
      docBody.innerHTML = '<div class="welcome"><h1>Error</h1><p>Could not load <strong>' + escapeHtml(filename) + '</strong>.</p><p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">Path: ' + escapeHtml(filename) + '</p>' + searchLink + '<p><a href="#" id="err-home" style="color:var(--accent);">← Back to all documents</a></p></div>';
      artHideToolbar();
      var errHome = docBody.querySelector('#err-home');
      if (errHome) errHome.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); navigateHome(); });
      var errSearch = docBody.querySelector('#err-search');
      if (errSearch) errSearch.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (searchInput) { searchInput.value = base; performSearch(); }
      });
    });
}

function renderContent(filename, md) {
  var result = parseMarkdown(md);
  docBody.innerHTML = result.html;
  artShowToolbar(filename);
  state.fileHeadings[filename] = result.headings;
  renderSidebar();
  document.title = filename.replace(/\.md$/i, '') + ' — md';
  document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
  closeSidebar();
}

function resolveRoute() {
  var hash = window.location.hash.slice(1);
  if (hash === 'stubs' || hash === 'review' || hash === 'guidance' || hash === 'guide') {
    activateStubs();
    return;
  }
  if (!hash) {
    navigateHome();
    return;
  }
  var parts = hash.split('#');
  var file = decodeURIComponent(parts[0]);
  var anchor = parts.slice(1).join('#');

  // If the hash is a known file, navigate to it (resolution handles wiki/
  // prefixes, .md suffixes, ../ relatives and archived basename matches)
  var resolved = resolveWikiPath(file);
  if (resolved) {
    navigateTo(resolved.path, resolved.anchor || anchor || null);
    return;
  }

  // If viewing a file and hash is a heading ID in it, just scroll
  if (state.currentFile) {
    var el = document.getElementById(hash);
    if (el) {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      return;
    }
  }

  // Unknown hash with no current file: navigate to first visible file
  var visible = visibleFiles();
  if (visible.length > 0 && !state.currentFile) {
    navigateTo(visible[0]);
  }
}

window.addEventListener('hashchange', function() {
  resolveRoute();
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Sidebar collapse (desktop)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

var sidebarCollapsed = localStorage.getItem('md-sidebar-collapsed') === 'true';

function applySidebarState() {
  if (window.innerWidth < 820) return;
  sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed', sidebarCollapsed);
  sidebarToggle.setAttribute('title', (sidebarCollapsed ? 'Expand' : 'Collapse') + ' sidebar (Ctrl+B)');
}

function toggleSidebar() {
  if (window.innerWidth < 820) return;
  sidebarCollapsed = !sidebarCollapsed;
  localStorage.setItem('md-sidebar-collapsed', sidebarCollapsed);
  applySidebarState();
}

sidebarToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);

window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
  if (window.innerWidth < 820) {
    sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
  } else {
    applySidebarState();
  }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Home
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

var IS_TOUCH = typeof window !== 'undefined' && (('ontouchstart' in window) || (navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0) > 0);
var homeGraphFetching = false;

function homeMetrics() {
  var files = state.files;
  var content = 0;
  var metaCount = 0;
  var types = {};
  var dirs = {};
  files.forEach(function(f) {
    if (isMetaFile(f)) metaCount++; else content++;
    var slash = f.lastIndexOf('/');
    var dir = slash === -1 ? '(root)' : f.slice(0, slash);
    dirs[dir] = true;
    var t = state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].type;
    if (t) types[t] = (types[t] || 0) + 1;
  });
  var typeCount = Object.keys(types).length;
  var topTypes = Object.keys(types).sort(function(a, b) { return types[b] - types[a]; }).slice(0, 3);
  return {
    total: files.length,
    content: content,
    meta: metaCount,
    dirs: Object.keys(dirs).length,
    typeCount: typeCount,
    topTypes: topTypes
  };
}

function homeRecents() {
  var visible = visibleFiles();
  try {
    return (localStorage.getItem('md-recent') || '').split(',').filter(function(f) { return f && visible.indexOf(f) !== -1; }).slice(0, 5);
  } catch (e) { return []; }
}

function homeRecentSearches() {
  try {
    return (localStorage.getItem('md-recent-searches') || '').split(',').filter(Boolean).slice(0, 5);
  } catch (e) { return []; }
}

function findProtocolFile() {
  var visible = visibleFiles();
  for (var i = 0; i < visible.length; i++) {
    var f = visible[i];
    var t = ((state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].type) || '').toLowerCase();
    var p = f.toLowerCase();
    if (t.indexOf('protocol') !== -1 || p.indexOf('/protocol') !== -1) return f;
  }
  return visible[0];
}

function setGraphCard(stats) {
  var card = document.getElementById('metric-graph');
  if (!card) return;
  var v = card.querySelector('.metric-value');
  var subEl = card.querySelector('.metric-sub');
  if (stats) {
    v.textContent = stats.nodes.toLocaleString();
    subEl.textContent = stats.nodes + ' nodes \u00b7 ' + stats.edges + ' edges';
  } else {
    v.textContent = '\u2713';
    subEl.textContent = 'link graph enabled';
  }
}

function probeGraphStats() {
  if (graphStats || homeGraphFetching) return;
  homeGraphFetching = true;
  fetch(KB_BASE + 'graph.json')
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(g) {
      homeGraphFetching = false;
      if (g && g.nodes) {
        graphStats = { nodes: g.nodes.length, edges: (g.edges || []).length };
        setGraphCard(graphStats);
      }
    })
    .catch(function() { homeGraphFetching = false; });
}

function navigateHome() {
  state.currentFile = '';
  fbFabUpdate();
  history.replaceState(null, '', '#');
  renderSidebar();
  document.title = 'md \u2014 documents';
  var sub = document.getElementById('header-subtitle');
  if (sub) sub.textContent = 'RSIS3 memory \u00b7 wiki';

  var m = homeMetrics();
  var recents = homeRecents();
  var searches = homeRecentSearches();

  var recentHtml = '';
  if (recents.length > 0) {
    recentHtml = '<div class="home-section"><h2>Recent Documents</h2><div class="home-recent-list">' +
      recents.map(function(f) {
        var clean = f.replace(/\.md$/i, '').split('/').pop();
        var title = (state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].title) || clean;
        var t = (state.meta[f] && state.meta[f].type) || '';
        var badge = t ? '<span class="hr-type">' + escapeHtml(t) + '</span>' : '';
        return '<a class="home-recent-item" href="#' + encodeURIComponent(f) + '" data-recent="' + encodeURIComponent(f) + '">' + escapeHtml(title) + badge + '</a>';
      }).join('') +
      '</div></div>';
  }

  var searchesHtml = '';
  if (searches.length > 0) {
    searchesHtml = '<div class="home-section"><h2>Recent Searches</h2><div class="home-search-chips">' +
      searches.map(function(q) {
        return '<button type="button" class="home-chip" data-search="' + escapeHtml(q) + '">' + escapeHtml(q) + '</button>';
      }).join('') +
      '</div></div>';
  }

  var hint = IS_TOUCH
    ? 'Open the sidebar to browse the knowledge base.'
    : 'Keyboard \u2014 Ctrl+K search \u00b7 Ctrl+B sidebar \u00b7 G graph \u00b7 H health';

  artHideToolbar();
  docBody.innerHTML = '' +
    '<div class="welcome home">' +
      '<h1>mykb</h1>' +
      '<p class="home-tagline">Long-term semantic memory for RSIS3 \u2014 curated knowledge, operational protocols, and agent guidance.</p>' +
      '<div class="home-metrics">' +
        '<div class="metric" id="metric-docs"><span class="metric-value">\u2026</span><span class="metric-label">Documents</span><span class="metric-sub"></span></div>' +
        '<div class="metric" id="metric-types"><span class="metric-value">\u2026</span><span class="metric-label">Types</span><span class="metric-sub"></span></div>' +
        '<div class="metric" id="metric-dirs"><span class="metric-value">\u2026</span><span class="metric-label">Folders</span><span class="metric-sub"></span></div>' +
        '<div class="metric" id="metric-graph"><span class="metric-value">\u2026</span><span class="metric-label">Knowledge Graph</span><span class="metric-sub"></span></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="home-actions">' +
        '<button type="button" class="home-action" data-home="browse">Browse</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="home-action" data-home="search">Search</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="home-action" data-home="graph">Graph</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="home-action" data-home="protocols">Protocols</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="home-action" data-home="recent">Recent</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      recentHtml + searchesHtml +
      '<div class="home-context">' +
        '<span>Viewing <strong>' + (showMeta ? 'Meta' : 'Content') + '</strong></span>' +
        '<span>Grouped by <strong>' + (state.groupMode === 'dir' ? 'Folder' : 'Type') + '</strong></span>' +
        '<span>' + hint + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';

  var docsEl = document.getElementById('metric-docs');
  if (docsEl) {
    docsEl.querySelector('.metric-value').textContent = m.total.toLocaleString();
    docsEl.querySelector('.metric-sub').textContent = m.content.toLocaleString() + ' content \u00b7 ' + m.meta.toLocaleString() + ' meta';
  }
  var typesEl = document.getElementById('metric-types');
  if (typesEl) {
    typesEl.querySelector('.metric-value').textContent = m.typeCount > 0 ? m.typeCount : '\u2014';
    typesEl.querySelector('.metric-sub').textContent = m.topTypes.length > 0 ? m.topTypes.slice(0, 2).join(' \u00b7 ') : 'semantic metadata';
  }
  var dirsEl = document.getElementById('metric-dirs');
  if (dirsEl) {
    dirsEl.querySelector('.metric-value').textContent = m.dirs.toLocaleString();
    dirsEl.querySelector('.metric-sub').textContent = 'folders';
  }
  setGraphCard(graphStats);
  probeGraphStats();
}

contentDoc.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  var action = e.target.closest('.home-action');
  if (action) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var act = action.getAttribute('data-home');
    if (act === 'browse') {
      openSidebar();
      var t = document.querySelector('.sidebar-tab[data-tab="docs"]');
      if (t) t.click();
    } else if (act === 'search') {
      openSidebar();
      setTimeout(function() { searchInput.focus(); searchInput.select(); }, 60);
    } else if (act === 'graph') {
      switchContentView('graph');
    } else if (act === 'protocols') {
      var pf = findProtocolFile();
      if (pf) navigateTo(pf);
    } else if (act === 'recent') {
      var r = homeRecents();
      if (r.length > 0) navigateTo(r[0]);
    }
    return;
  }
  var recent = e.target.closest('[data-recent]');
  if (recent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    navigateTo(decodeURIComponent(recent.getAttribute('data-recent')));
    return;
  }
  var chip = e.target.closest('.home-chip');
  if (chip) {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchInput.value = chip.getAttribute('data-search');
    openSidebar();
    performSearch();
    searchInput.focus();
  }
});

sidebarHeaderTitle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  closeSidebar();
  navigateHome();
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Mobile sidebar
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

function openSidebar() { sidebar.classList.add('open'); overlay.classList.add('visible'); }
function closeSidebar() { sidebar.classList.remove('open'); overlay.classList.remove('visible'); }

hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
  if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) { closeSidebar(); }
  else { openSidebar(); }
});

overlay.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);

var touchStartX = 0;
document.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) { touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; });
document.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
  if (sidebar.classList.contains('open') && e.changedTouches[0].screenX - touchStartX < -50) { closeSidebar(); }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Keyboard shortcuts
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'k') {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchInput.focus();
    return;
  }
  if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'b') {
    e.preventDefault();
    toggleSidebar();
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    if (document.activeElement === searchInput) {
      searchInput.blur();
      searchResults.classList.remove('visible');
    }
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === 't' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) {
    var tag = document.activeElement ? document.activeElement.tagName : '';
    if (tag !== 'INPUT' && tag !== 'TEXTAREA' && tag !== 'SELECT') {
      toggleTheme();
    }
  }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Internal heading link handling
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

// Intercept heading anchor clicks and .md links for internal navigation.
// stopPropagation keeps the document-level .md interceptor from re-navigating
// with the unresolved raw href after this handler has already resolved it.
content.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  var target = e.target;
  // Wikilink with data-target
  if (target.classList && target.classList.contains('wikilink')) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var t = target.getAttribute('data-target');
    if (t) navigateTo(t);
    return;
  }
  if (target.tagName === 'A' && target.getAttribute('href')) {
    var href = target.getAttribute('href');
    // Internal .md link -> navigate within viewer
    if (href.match(/\.md$/i)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      navigateTo(href);
      return;
    }
    // Heading anchor -> smooth scroll
    if (href.charAt(0) === '#') {
      var id = href.slice(1);
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el && state.currentFile) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + encodeURIComponent(state.currentFile) + '#' + id);
      }
    }
  }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Group selector
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

var groupSelector = document.getElementById('group-selector');
if (groupSelector) {
  groupSelector.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('.group-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    var mode = btn.getAttribute('data-mode');
    if (mode === state.groupMode) return;
    state.groupMode = mode;
    groupSelector.querySelectorAll('.group-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    // Reset collapse states when switching
    state.typeCollapsed = {};
    renderSidebar();
  });
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Init
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Review & Feedback — integrated into the mykb app
   Two things live here: stub triage (Keep / Enrich 1-3x / Categorize /
   Archive / Delete for pages with frontmatter status: stub) and free-form
   human commentary on ANY wiki page that guides the next improvement pass.
   Decisions and feedback persist in this browser; Save queue writes both to
   the inference queue. Live data comes from the wiki daemon; static pages
   fall back to stub-review.json / stub-index.json and print copyable
   commands.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
var SRV = {
  items: [],            // normalized review items
  dirs: [], areas: [],
  live: false, loaded: false,
  filter: 'all',
  sort: 'n',
  page: 1, pageSize: 50,
  areaFilter: 'all',
  choices: {},          // path -> decision (persisted under 'stub-audit')
  depths: {},           // path -> 1|2|3 enrichment passes for 'e' (persisted under 'stub-audit-depth')
  catTargets: {}        // path -> wiki/<area>/<sub> destination for 'c'
};
try { SRV.choices = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('stub-audit') || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) { SRV.choices = {}; }
try { SRV.depths = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('stub-audit-depth') || '{}') || {}; } catch (e) { SRV.depths = {}; }
var FB = { items: [] }; // pending human feedback/commentary on any wiki page
try { FB.items = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mykb-feedback') || '[]') || []; } catch (e) { FB.items = []; }
try { state.stubsOnly = localStorage.getItem('md-stubs-only') === 'on'; } catch (e) {}

/* ── Guidance state — research & feedback queue (wanted pages, directions,
   questions, page-level notes). The working set persists as a draft so
   unsaved items survive reloads; "Save guidance" POSTs it to the daemon
   queue (guidance-queue.json) or downloads it when static. ── */
var GUID = { live: false, liveState: null, loaded: false, total: null, areas: [], focus: [], wantedLinks: [], queue: null, items: [] };
try { GUID.items = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mykb-guidance-draft') || '[]') || []; } catch (e) { GUID.items = []; }
function gdPersist() {
  try { localStorage.setItem('mykb-guidance-draft', JSON.stringify(GUID.items)); } catch (e) {}
}

function srvPersist() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('stub-audit', JSON.stringify(SRV.choices));
    localStorage.setItem('stub-audit-depth', JSON.stringify(SRV.depths));
  } catch (e) {}
}
function fbPersist() {
  try { localStorage.setItem('mykb-feedback', JSON.stringify(FB.items)); } catch (e) {}
}
function srvEsc(x) {
  return String(x == null ? '' : x).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

function gdNorm(it) {
  return {
    kind: it.kind || it.type || 'note',
    path: it.path || '',
    note: it.note || it.text || '',
    priority: it.priority != null ? it.priority : 2,
    added: it.added || ''
  };
}
function gdFillPaths() {
  var dl = document.getElementById('fb-paths');
  if (!dl) return;
  dl.innerHTML = '';
  (state.files || []).slice(0, 400).forEach(function(f) {
    var p = (typeof f === 'string') ? f : (f.path || '');
    if (!p) return;
    var o = document.createElement('option');
    o.value = p.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    dl.appendChild(o);
  });
}
function loadGuidance() {
  if (GUID.loaded) { gdRender(); return; }
  var draft = GUID.items.length ? GUID.items.slice() : null;
  function applyData(d, live) {
    GUID.live = !!live;
    GUID.loaded = true;
    GUID.total = d.total || null;
    GUID.areas = d.areas || [];
    GUID.focus = d.focus || [];
    GUID.wantedLinks = d.wanted_links || [];
    GUID.queue = d.queue || null;
    GUID.liveState = d.live || null;
    var seeded = (d.queue && Array.isArray(d.queue.items) ? d.queue.items : []).map(gdNorm);
    GUID.items = draft || seeded;
    gdFillPaths();
    gdRender();
  }
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/guidance')
    .then(function(d) {
      if (!d || !Array.isArray(d.areas)) throw new Error('bad payload');
      applyData(d, true);
    })
    .catch(function() {
      fetch(KB_BASE + 'guidance.json')
        .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
        .then(function(d) {
          if (!d || !Array.isArray(d.areas)) throw new Error('bad payload');
          applyData(d, false);
        })
        .catch(function() {
          GUID.loaded = true; GUID.live = false;
          GUID.total = null; GUID.areas = []; GUID.focus = []; GUID.wantedLinks = []; GUID.queue = null; GUID.liveState = null;
          GUID.items = GUID.items.slice();
          gdFillPaths();
          gdRender();
        });
    });
}
function gdRender() {
  var tot = document.getElementById('gd-total');
  if (tot) {
    if (GUID.total) {
      tot.innerHTML = '<b>' + GUID.total.pages + '</b> wiki pages &middot; <b>' + GUID.total.stubs + '</b> stubs (' + GUID.total.stub_pct + '%)' +
        (GUID.live ? ' &middot; <span style="color:#34d399">live</span>' : ' &middot; snapshot');
    } else {
      tot.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--text-muted)">coverage data unavailable &mdash; run <code>cosmos guidance build</code></span>';
    }
  }
  var foc = document.getElementById('gd-focus');
  if (foc) {
    foc.innerHTML = '';
    (GUID.focus || []).forEach(function(f) {
      var chip = document.createElement('span');
      chip.className = 'gd-focus-chip';
      chip.innerHTML = '<b>' + srvEsc(f.area) + '</b> ' + f.stubs + ' stubs &middot; ' + f.stub_pct + '% <span class="note">&mdash; ' + srvEsc(f.note) + '</span>';
      foc.appendChild(chip);
    });
    if (!(GUID.focus || []).length) foc.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted)">no focus data</span>';
  }
  gdRenderWanted();
  gdRenderLive();
  gdRenderModels();
  gdPopulateAreas();
  var tbl = document.getElementById('gd-areas');
  if (tbl) {
    var rows = (GUID.areas || []).slice(0, 15);
    var html = '<tr><th>area</th><th>pages</th><th>stubs</th><th>stub %</th><th>avg words</th></tr>';
    rows.forEach(function(a) {
      var hot = a.stub_pct >= 50 ? ' class="stub-cell hot"' : '';
      html += '<tr><td>' + srvEsc(a.area) + '</td><td class="num">' + a.pages + '</td><td class="num"><span' + hot + '>' + a.stubs + '</span></td><td class="num">' + a.stub_pct + '%</td><td class="num">' + a.avg_words + '</td></tr>';
    });
    if (!rows.length) html += '<tr><td colspan="5" style="color:var(--text-muted)">no area data</td></tr>';
    tbl.innerHTML = html;
  }
  gdRenderList();
}
function gdRenderLive() {
  var live = GUID.liveState || null;
  var loopsEl = document.getElementById('gd-live-loops');
  var tracesEl = document.getElementById('gd-live-traces');
  var synthsEl = document.getElementById('gd-live-synths');
  if (!live) {
    if (loopsEl) loopsEl.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted)">no live state in guidance payload</div>';
    return;
  }
  if (loopsEl) {
    loopsEl.innerHTML = '';
    (live.loops || []).forEach(function(l) {
      var cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'gd-live-cell';
      var last = l.last_run ? l.last_run.replace('T', ' ').slice(5, 16) : 'never';
      cell.innerHTML = '<b>' + srvEsc(l.id) + '</b> ' + srvEsc(l.name) +
        '<div class="st">' + srvEsc(l.status) + ' &middot; ' + l.runs + ' runs &middot; ' + srvEsc(last) + '</div>';
      loopsEl.appendChild(cell);
    });
    if (!(live.loops || []).length) loopsEl.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted)">no loop stack</div>';
  }
  if (tracesEl) {
    tracesEl.innerHTML = '';
    var traces = live.telemetry && live.telemetry.spec_traces ? live.telemetry.spec_traces : [];
    traces.forEach(function(t) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'row';
      row.innerHTML = '<div class="goal">&#127919; ' + srvEsc(t.goal) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="meta">' + srvEsc((t.timestamp || '').replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19)) + ' UTC</div>';
      tracesEl.appendChild(row);
    });
    if (!traces.length) tracesEl.innerHTML = '<div class="row" style="color:var(--text-muted)">no spec-backed L2 goals yet &mdash; run <code>rsis run --goal from-space</code></div>';
  }
  if (synthsEl) {
    synthsEl.innerHTML = '';
    var synths = live.memory && live.memory.syntheses ? live.memory.syntheses : [];
    synths.forEach(function(s) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'row';
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = 'wiki/syntheses/' + s.slug + '.md';
      a.textContent = s.title;
      a.style.color = 'var(--accent)';
      row.appendChild(a);
      if (s.timestamp) {
        var meta = document.createElement('div');
        meta.className = 'meta';
        meta.textContent = (s.timestamp || '').replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16) + ' UTC';
        row.appendChild(meta);
      }
      synthsEl.appendChild(row);
    });
    if (!synths.length) synthsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="row" style="color:var(--text-muted)">no syntheses</div>';
  }
}
function gdRenderModels() {
  var live = GUID.liveState || null;
  var el = document.getElementById('gd-models');
  if (!el) return;
  var loops = (live && live.loops) || [];
  var tuners = loops.filter(function(l) { return (l.params || []).length; });
  if (!tuners.length) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);grid-column:1/-1;">no tuned params in live guidance payload &mdash; run the meta loops to populate</div>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = '';
  tuners.forEach(function(l) {
    var cell = document.createElement('div');
    cell.className = 'gd-live-cell';
    var html = '<b>' + srvEsc(l.id) + '</b> ' + srvEsc(l.name) +
      '<div class="st">' + srvEsc(l.target || '') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="params">';
    (l.params || []).forEach(function(pm) {
      html += '<span class="p"><code>' + srvEsc(pm.key) + '</code> = <span class="v">' + srvEsc(pm.value) + '</span></span>';
    });
    html += '</div>';
    cell.innerHTML = html;
    el.appendChild(cell);
  });
}

function gdRenderWanted() {
  var el = document.getElementById('gd-wanted');
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = '';
  var rows = GUID.wantedLinks || [];
  if (!rows.length) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);">no red links &mdash; the wiki&rsquo;s link graph is clean</div>';
    return;
  }
  rows.slice(0, 12).forEach(function(r) {
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'gd-wl-row';
    row.innerHTML = '<span class="tgt">[[' + srvEsc(r.target) + ']]</span>' +
      '<span class="cnt">' + r.links + 'x &middot; ' + srvEsc((r.from || []).join(', ')) + '</span>' +
      '<button class="add" title="add to research queue">+ queue</button>';
    row.querySelector('.add').addEventListener('click', function() {
      gdQueueWanted(r.suggested, r.target, r.links);
    });
    el.appendChild(row);
  });
  if (rows.length > 12) {
    var more = document.createElement('div');
    more.style.cssText = 'font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);padding:2px 6px;';
    more.textContent = '… and ' + (rows.length - 12) + ' more (see guidance.json)';
    el.appendChild(more);
  }
}
function gdQueueWanted(suggested, target, count) {
  GUID.items.push({
    kind: 'wanted',
    path: suggested || '',
    note: 'Red link from ' + count + ' wiki page' + (count === 1 ? '' : 's') + ': [[' + target + ']]',
    priority: count >= 3 ? 1 : 2,
    added: new Date().toISOString()
  });
  gdPersist();
  gdRenderList();
  srvQueueFlash('added [[ ' + target + ' ]] to the research queue (Save guidance persists it)', true);
}
function gdPopulateAreas() {
  var sel = document.getElementById('srv-area');
  if (!sel || !GUID.areas || !GUID.areas.length) return;
  var cur = sel.value || 'all';
  sel.innerHTML = '<option value="all">all areas</option>' +
    GUID.areas.map(function(a) {
      return '<option value="' + srvEsc(a.area) + '"' + (a.area === cur ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + srvEsc(a.area) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
}
function gdRenderList() {
  var el = document.getElementById('fb-list');
  if (!el) return;
  var cnt = document.getElementById('fb-count');
  var items = GUID.items || [];
  if (cnt) cnt.textContent = items.length;
  el.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function(it, i) {
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'fb-item';
    row.innerHTML =
      '<span class="fb-kind">' + srvEsc(it.kind) + '</span>' +
      '<span style="font-size:10px;color:#ffd166;flex:none;">P' + (it.priority || 2) + '</span>' +
      (it.path ? '<span class="fb-path">' + srvEsc(it.path) + '</span>' : '') +
      (it.note ? '<span class="fb-note">' + srvEsc(it.note) + '</span>' : '') +
      '<button class="fb-x" data-i="' + i + '" title="remove">&#10005;</button>';
    row.querySelector('.fb-x').addEventListener('click', function() {
      GUID.items.splice(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-i'), 10), 1);
      gdPersist();
      gdRenderList();
    });
    el.appendChild(row);
  });
  if (!items.length) el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);">No guidance items yet &mdash; add a wanted page, research direction, open question, or page-level note above.</div>';
}
function gdNormPath(p) {
  p = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\/+/, '');
  if (!p) return '';
  if (p.indexOf('wiki/') === 0 || p.indexOf('raw/') === 0) return p;
  if (p.indexOf('.md') === -1) p += '.md';
  return 'wiki/' + p;
}
function gdAdd() {
  var kind = document.getElementById('fb-kind');
  var prio = document.getElementById('fb-prio');
  var path = document.getElementById('fb-path');
  var note = document.getElementById('fb-note');
  if (!kind || !prio || !path || !note) return;
  var p = gdNormPath(path.value);
  var n = note.value.trim();
  if (!p && !n) { note.focus(); return; }
  GUID.items.push({
    kind: kind.value,
    path: p,
    note: n,
    priority: parseInt(prio.value, 10) || 2,
    added: new Date().toISOString()
  });
  path.value = ''; note.value = '';
  gdPersist();
  gdRenderList();
  srvQueueFlash('added to guidance queue (Save guidance persists it)', true);
}
function gdClear() {
  if (!GUID.items.length) return;
  GUID.items = [];
  gdPersist();
  gdRenderList();
}
function gdDownloadQueue(payload) {
  var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 1)], { type: 'application/json' });
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = 'guidance-queue.json';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
  setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 1500);
  srvQueueFlash('downloaded guidance-queue.json (no live server) — place it in .wiki-daemon/buffers/ and run drain_stub_queue.py --apply', false);
}
function gdSave() {
  if (!GUID.items.length) { srvQueueFlash('nothing to save — add at least one guidance item', false); return; }
  var payload = { source: 'guidance', queued_at: new Date().toISOString(), count: GUID.items.length, items: GUID.items };
  if (!window.fetch) { gdDownloadQueue(payload); return; }
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/guidance/queue', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) })
    .then(function(j) {
      if (j.status === 'ok') {
        srvQueueFlash('guidance saved → ' + j.path + ' ✓', true);
        try { localStorage.removeItem('mykb-guidance-draft'); } catch (e) {}
        GUID.loaded = false;
        GUID.items = [];
        loadGuidance();
      } else throw new Error(j.error || 'queue failed');
    })
    .catch(function() { gdDownloadQueue(payload); });
}
function fbFabUpdate() {
  var fab = document.getElementById('fb-fab');
  if (!fab) return;
  var show = !!state.currentFile && state.currentTab !== 'stubs';
  fab.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
}
var SRV_API_BASES = ['', 'http://localhost:8765', 'http://127.0.0.1:8765'];
function srvApiReq(path, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var i = 0;
  return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
    function next() {
      if (i >= SRV_API_BASES.length) { reject(new Error('no API reachable')); return; }
      var base = SRV_API_BASES[i++];
      var ctrl = (typeof AbortController !== 'undefined') ? new AbortController() : null;
      var t = setTimeout(function(){ if (ctrl) ctrl.abort(); }, 20000);
      fetch(base + path, {
        method: opts.method || 'GET',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: opts.body,
        signal: ctrl ? ctrl.signal : undefined
      }).then(function(r) {
        clearTimeout(t);
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
        return r.json();
      }).then(resolve).catch(function(e) { clearTimeout(t); next(); });
    }
    next();
  });
}
function srvNorm(it) {
  var p = it.p || it.path || '';
  var junk = it.j ? 1 : 0;
  if (!junk && p.indexOf('wiki/') !== 0 && p.indexOf('raw/') !== 0) p = 'wiki/' + p;
  return {
    path: p,
    title: it.t || it.title || p.split('/').pop().replace(/\.md$/,'').replace(/-/g, ' '),
    words: it.w != null ? it.w : (it.words || 0),
    status: it.s || it.status || 'stub',
    junk: junk,
    created: it.c || it.created || '',
    links: it.l != null ? it.l : (it.links || 0),
    desc: it.d || it.description || '',
    snip: it.x || it.snippet || '',
    n: it.n || 0
  };
}
function srvSetData(items, dirs, areas, live) {
  SRV.items = items;
  SRV.dirs = dirs || [];
  SRV.areas = areas || [];
  SRV.live = !!live;
  SRV.loaded = true;
  // Feed the browse "Stubs only" filter from the same dataset.
  state.stubPaths = new Set();
  state.stubIndex = {};
  items.forEach(function(it) {
    if (!it.junk) { state.stubPaths.add(it.path); state.stubIndex[it.path] = it; }
  });
  if (state.stubsOnly) renderSidebar();
  var chip = document.getElementById('srv-chip');
  if (chip) {
    chip.textContent = live ? 'live data' : 'snapshot';
    chip.classList.add(live ? 'live' : 'snap');
  }
  srvRender();
  srvDrainStatus();
}
function loadStubsReview() {
  if (SRV.loaded) { srvRender(); srvDrainStatus(); return; }
  var chip = document.getElementById('srv-chip');
  if (chip) { chip.textContent = 'scanning…'; chip.classList.remove('live', 'snap'); }
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/stubs')
    .then(function(d) {
      if (!d || !Array.isArray(d.items)) throw new Error('bad payload');
      srvSetData(d.items.map(srvNorm), d.dirs || [], d.areas || [], true);
    })
    .catch(function() {
      fetch(KB_BASE + 'stub-review.json')
        .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
        .then(function(d) {
          if (!d || !Array.isArray(d.items)) throw new Error('bad payload');
          srvSetData(d.items.map(srvNorm), d.dirs || [], d.areas || [], false);
        })
        .catch(function() {
          fetch(KB_BASE + 'stub-index.json')
            .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
            .then(function(d) {
              var items = (d.stubs || []).map(function(ss) {
                return srvNorm({ path: ss.path, title: ss.title, words: ss.words, status: ss.status, created: ss.created, description: ss.description });
              });
              srvSetData(items, [], [], false);
            })
            .catch(function() {
              var el = document.getElementById('srv-list');
              if (el) el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-soft);">No stub data found — run <code>cosmos stubs build</code> to generate stub-index.json.</div>';
            });
        });
    });
}
function ensureStubPaths() {
  if (state.stubPaths) return Promise.resolve();
  return fetch(KB_BASE + 'stub-index.json')
    .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
    .then(function(d) {
      state.stubPaths = new Set();
      state.stubIndex = {};
      (d.stubs || []).forEach(function(ss) { state.stubPaths.add(ss.path); state.stubIndex[ss.path] = ss; });
    });
}
function activateStubs() {
  state.currentTab = 'stubs';
  fbFabUpdate();
  // Guide is a main content view, not a sidebar tab: keep the browse list
  // visible so guidance and articles can be used side by side.
  document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-tab').forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('active'); });
  var gpAct = document.getElementById('guide-promo');
  if (gpAct) gpAct.classList.add('active');
  var fl = document.getElementById('file-list'); if (fl) fl.style.display = '';
  var sc = document.getElementById('search-container'); if (sc) sc.style.display = 'none';
  var cc = document.getElementById('compositions-container'); if (cc) cc.style.display = 'none';
  var stc = document.getElementById('stubs-container'); if (stc) stc.style.display = 'none';
  switchContentView('stubs');
  loadStubsReview();
  loadGuidance();
}
function srvVisible() {
  var fltStub = document.getElementById('srv-flt-stub') ? document.getElementById('srv-flt-stub').checked : true;
  var fltJunk = document.getElementById('srv-flt-junk') ? document.getElementById('srv-flt-junk').checked : false;
  var showAll = !fltStub && !fltJunk;
  return SRV.items.filter(function(it) {
    if (it.junk) return fltJunk || showAll;
    if (!(fltStub || showAll)) return false;
    if (SRV.areaFilter && SRV.areaFilter !== 'all') {
      var area = it.path.split('/')[1] || '';
      if (area !== SRV.areaFilter) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
}
function srvSorted(items) {
  if (SRV.sort === 'n') return items;
  return items.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    var va = a[SRV.sort], vb = b[SRV.sort];
    if (SRV.sort === 'c') {
      if (!va && !vb) return a.n - b.n;
      if (!va) return 1;
      if (!vb) return -1;
    }
    if (va < vb) return -1;
    if (va > vb) return 1;
    return a.n - b.n;
  });
}
function srvSetChoice(path, choice) {
  if (SRV.choices[path] === choice) delete SRV.choices[path];
  else SRV.choices[path] = choice;
  if (choice !== 'c') delete SRV.catTargets[path];
  srvPersist();
  srvRender();
}
function srvSetCat(path, target) {
  SRV.choices[path] = 'c';
  SRV.catTargets[path] = target;
  srvPersist();
  srvRender();
}
function srvOpenPicker(path) {
  var box = document.getElementById('cp-' + encodeURIComponent(path).replace(/%/g, '_'));
  if (!box) return;
  box.innerHTML = '';
  var it = SRV.items.filter(function(x) { return x.path === path; })[0] || {};
  var cur = it.path.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/');
  var area = it.path.split('/')[1] || '';
  var html = '<label>Categorize — choose an area and a destination folder, then press the &#10003; button</label>';
  html += '<div class="row"><div><label>Area (domain)</label><select id="ca-area-' + path + '">';
  html += SRV.areas.map(function(a) { return '<option value="' + srvEsc(a) + '"' + (a === area ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + srvEsc(a) + '</option>'; }).join('');
  html += '</select></div>';
  html += '<div style="flex:2"><label>Destination folder (existing wiki dirs)</label><input list="srv-dirs" id="ca-path-' + path + '" value="' + srvEsc(cur.replace(/^wiki\//, '')) + '"></div></div>';
  html += '<div class="row"><div style="flex:1"><button class="srv-btn" id="ca-ok-' + path + '" style="margin-top:8px;background:#c084fc;border-color:#c084fc;color:#0b0d11;font-weight:700;">&#10003; Apply target</button></div></div>';
  html += '<div class="hint">e.g. wiki/agent-systems/foo.md &#8594; wiki/&lt;area&gt;/&hellip;  Final path is prefixed with wiki/ automatically.</div>';
  box.innerHTML = html;
  var ok = document.getElementById('ca-ok-' + path);
  if (ok && !ok.dataset.listening) {
    ok.dataset.listening = '1';
    ok.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var area = document.getElementById('ca-area-' + path).value;
      var sub = document.getElementById('ca-path-' + path).value.trim().replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
      var target = sub ? area + '/' + sub : area;
      srvSetCat(path, 'wiki/' + target);
    });
  }
}
function srvRender() {
  var items = srvSorted(srvVisible());
  var total = items.length;
  var pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / SRV.pageSize));
  if (SRV.page > pages) SRV.page = pages;
  var start = (SRV.page - 1) * SRV.pageSize;
  var pageItems = items.slice(start, start + SRV.pageSize);
  var done = SRV.items.filter(function(it) { return SRV.choices[it.path]; }).length;
  var pct = SRV.items.length ? Math.round(done / SRV.items.length * 100) : 0;
  var fill = document.getElementById('srv-progress-fill');
  if (fill) fill.style.width = pct + '%';
  var pl = document.getElementById('srv-progress-label');
  if (pl) pl.textContent = done + '/' + SRV.items.length + ' (' + pct + '%)';
  var pg = document.getElementById('srv-pg-info');
  if (pg) pg.textContent = 'page ' + SRV.page + ' / ' + pages + ' · ' + SRV.pageSize + ' per page';
  var prev = document.getElementById('srv-pg-prev');
  var next = document.getElementById('srv-pg-next');
  if (prev) prev.disabled = SRV.page <= 1;
  if (next) next.disabled = SRV.page >= pages;

  var list = document.getElementById('srv-list');
  if (!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = '';
  var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
  pageItems.forEach(function(it) {
    var choice = SRV.choices[it.path] || null;
    if (SRV.filter === 'remaining' && choice) return;
    if (SRV.filter === 'classified' && !choice) return;
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'srv-card' + (choice ? ' classified' : '');
    var sel = { k: '', e: '', c: '', a: '', d: '' };
    if (choice && sel[choice] !== undefined) sel[choice] = ' sel';
    var target = (choice === 'c' && SRV.catTargets[it.path]) ? '<div class="hint">target: ' + srvEsc(SRV.catTargets[it.path]) + '</div>' : '';
    var picker = '<div class="srv-picker" id="cp-' + encodeURIComponent(it.path).replace(/%/g, '_') + '" style="display:none;"></div>';
    var actions = '<div class="srv-actions">' +
      '<button class="srv-opt k' + sel.k + '" data-c="k"><span class="key">1</span>Keep</button>';
    if (!it.junk) {
      actions += '<button class="srv-opt e' + sel.e + '" data-c="e"><span class="key">2</span>Enrich</button>' +
        '<button class="srv-opt c' + sel.c + '" data-c="c"><span class="key">3</span>Categorize</button>' +
        '<button class="srv-opt a' + sel.a + '" data-c="a"><span class="key">4</span>Archive</button>';
    }
    actions += '<button class="srv-opt d' + sel.d + '" data-c="d"><span class="key">5</span>Delete</button></div>';
    var badgeCls = it.status === 'stub' ? ' warn' : (it.junk ? ' del' : '');
    card.innerHTML =
      '<div class="top"><span class="num">' + it.n + '.</span>' +
      '<span class="title"><a href="#' + encodeURIComponent(it.path) + '">' + srvEsc(it.title) + '</a></span>' +
      '<span class="badge">' + it.words + ' words</span>' +
      '<span class="badge">' + it.links + ' links</span>' +
      (it.created ? '<span class="badge">created ' + srvEsc(it.created) + '</span>' : '') +
      '<span class="badge' + badgeCls + '">' + srvEsc(it.status) + '</span></div>' +
      (it.desc ? '<div class="desc">' + srvEsc(it.desc) + '</div>' : '') +
      '<div class="path">' + srvEsc(it.path) + '</div>' +
      (it.snip ? '<div class="snip">' + srvEsc(it.snip) + '…</div>' : '') +
      target + picker + actions;
    var path = it.path;
    card.querySelectorAll('.srv-opt').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var c = btn.getAttribute('data-c');
        if (c === 'c') { srvSetChoice(path, 'c'); var box = document.getElementById('cp-' + encodeURIComponent(path).replace(/%/g, '_')); if (box) { box.style.display = 'block'; srvOpenPicker(path); } }
        else srvSetChoice(path, c);
      });
    });
    var link = card.querySelector('.title a');
    if (link) link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      closeSidebar();
      navigateTo(path);
    });
    frag.appendChild(card);
  });
  list.appendChild(frag);
  srvRenderSidebar();
}
function srvRenderSidebar() {
  var el = document.getElementById('stubs-list');
  if (!el) return;
  var items = SRV.items.filter(function(it) { return !it.junk; }).slice(0, 40);
  el.innerHTML = '';
  items.forEach(function(it) {
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'stub-entry' + (SRV.choices[it.path] ? ' classified' : '');
    row.innerHTML = '<span class="stub-dot"></span><span style="flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">' + srvEsc(it.title || it.path) + '</span><span class="words">' + it.words + 'w</span>';
    row.title = it.path;
    (function(path) {
      row.addEventListener('click', function() { closeSidebar(); navigateTo(path); });
    })(it.path);
    el.appendChild(row);
  });
  if (!items.length) el.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);padding:4px;">No stubs</div>';
}
function srvBuildQueue() {
  var now = new Date().toISOString();
  var items = [];
  SRV.items.forEach(function(it) {
    var choice = SRV.choices[it.path];
    if (!choice) return;
    items.push({
      path: it.path,
      title: it.title,
      decision: choice,
      target: (choice === 'c' && !it.junk && SRV.catTargets[it.path]) ? SRV.catTargets[it.path] + '/' + it.path.split('/').pop() : null,
      words: it.words,
      links: it.links,
      status: it.status,
      description: it.desc || '',
      snippet: it.snip || ''
    });
  });
  return { source: 'stub-audit', queued_at: now, count: items.length, items: items };
}
function srvQueueFlash(msg, ok) {
  var el = document.getElementById('srv-queue-flash');
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.style.color = ok ? '#34d399' : (msg.indexOf('downloaded') === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : '#f87171');
  setTimeout(function() { el.textContent = ''; }, 4200);
}
function srvDownloadQueue(payload) {
  var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 1)], { type: 'application/json' });
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = 'stub-audit-queue.json';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
  setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 1500);
  srvQueueFlash('downloaded stub-audit-queue.json (no live server) — place it in .wiki-daemon/buffers/ and run drain_stub_queue.py', false);
}
function srvSaveQueue() {
  var payload = srvBuildQueue();
  if (!payload.count) { srvQueueFlash('nothing queued yet — classify at least one stub first', false); return; }
  if (!window.fetch) { srvDownloadQueue(payload); return; }
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/stubs/queue', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) })
    .then(function(j) {
      if (j.status === 'ok') srvQueueFlash('queued ' + j.count + ' answers → ' + j.path + ' ✓', true);
      else throw new Error(j.error || 'queue failed');
    })
    .catch(function() { srvDownloadQueue(payload); });
}
function srvDrainStatus() {
  var el = document.getElementById('srv-drain-status');
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = 'loading…';
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/stubs/queue').then(function(d) {
    var q = d.queue, m = d.manifest, bits = [];
    if (q && q.items && q.items.length) {
      var counts = {};
      q.items.forEach(function(it) { counts[it.decision] = (counts[it.decision] || 0) + 1; });
      var sum = Object.keys(counts).map(function(k) { return k + '=' + counts[k]; }).join(' ');
      bits.push('queue: ' + q.items.length + ' items @ ' + (q.queued_at || '?').slice(0, 19) + ' (' + sum + ')');
    } else bits.push('queue: none');
    if (m && m.tasks && m.tasks.length) bits.push('inference manifest: ' + m.tasks.length + ' enrich tasks');
    else bits.push('inference manifest: none');
    el.textContent = bits.join(' · ');
  }).catch(function() {
    el.textContent = 'static mode — live queue ops need the MyKB server (cosmos start mykb); use `cosmos stubs plan / apply / status` in the terminal.';
  });
}
function srvDrainOut(text) {
  var pre = document.getElementById('srv-drain-out');
  if (!pre) return;
  pre.textContent = text;
  pre.style.display = 'block';
}
function srvDrainRun(mode) {
  var btn = document.getElementById('srv-drain-' + mode);
  var old = btn ? btn.textContent : '';
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'running…'; }
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/stubs/queue/' + mode, { method: 'POST' })
    .then(function(j) {
      srvDrainOut(j && j.output ? j.output : (j && j.error ? j.error : 'done'));
      srvDrainStatus();
    })
    .catch(function() {
      srvDrainOut(
        '# No MyKB daemon reachable (static page). Run the drain locally.\n' +
        '# First ensure the queue exists: use "Save queue" and place the JSON in .wiki-daemon/buffers/stub-audit-queue.json\n' +
        'cd components/mykb\n' +
        'python3 .wiki-daemon/drain_stub_queue.py --' + mode + '\n' +
        '# or: cosmos stubs ' + mode + '\n' +
        '# After apply: cosmos stubs build && cosmos stubs status'
      );
    })
    .then(function() { if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = old; } });
}
function srvDrainBuild() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('srv-drain-build');
  var old = btn ? btn.textContent : '';
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'building…'; }
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/stubs/build', { method: 'POST' })
    .then(function(j) {
      srvDrainOut(j && j.output ? j.output : (j && j.error ? j.error : 'done'));
      srvDrainStatus();
    })
    .catch(function() {
      srvDrainOut(
        '# No MyKB daemon reachable (static page). Rebuild the stub data locally.\n' +
        'cd components/mykb\n' +
        'python3 .wiki-daemon/build_stub_index.py && python3 .wiki-daemon/build_stub_audit.py\n' +
        '# or: cosmos stubs build'
      );
    })
    .then(function() { if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = old; } });
}
function gdDrainStatus() {
  var el = document.getElementById('gd-drain-status');
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = 'loading…';
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/guidance/queue').then(function(d) {
    var q = d.queue, m = d.guidance_manifest, bits = [];
    if (q && q.items && q.items.length) {
      var counts = {};
      q.items.forEach(function(it) { var k = it.kind || 'note'; counts[k] = (counts[k] || 0) + 1; });
      bits.push('queue: ' + q.items.length + ' items @ ' + (q.queued_at || '?').slice(0, 19));
      bits.push(Object.keys(counts).map(function(k) { return k + '=' + counts[k]; }).join(' '));
    } else bits.push('queue: none');
    if (m && m.created) bits.push('manifest: ' + m.created.length + ' scaffolded · ' + (m.research || []).length + ' directions');
    else bits.push('manifest: none (run Plan / Apply)');
    el.textContent = bits.join(' · ');
  }).catch(function() {
    el.textContent = 'static mode — live research drain needs the MyKB server (cosmos start mykb); use `cosmos guidance plan / apply` in the terminal.';
  });
}
function gdDrainOut(text) {
  var pre = document.getElementById('gd-drain-out');
  if (!pre) return;
  pre.textContent = text;
  pre.style.display = 'block';
}
function gdDrainRun(mode) {
  var btn = document.getElementById('gd-drain-' + mode);
  var old = btn ? btn.textContent : '';
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'running…'; }
  srvApiReq('/api/v2/guidance/' + mode, { method: 'POST' })
    .then(function(j) {
      gdDrainOut(j && j.output ? j.output : (j && j.error ? j.error : 'done'));
      gdDrainStatus();
    })
    .catch(function() {
      gdDrainOut(
        '# No MyKB daemon reachable (static page). Run the research drain locally.\n' +
        '# First ensure the guidance queue exists: add items in the Guide tab, then "Save guidance".\n' +
        'cd components/mykb\n' +
        'python3 .wiki-daemon/drain_guidance.py --' + mode + '\n' +
        '# or: cosmos guidance ' + mode
      );
    })
    .then(function() { if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = old; } });
}
function srvBuildResults() {
  var lines = [];
  var now = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  lines.push('# Stub Audit Results — ' + now);
  lines.push('');
  var classified = SRV.items.filter(function(it) { return SRV.choices[it.path]; }).length;
  lines.push('Reviewed: ' + classified + '/' + SRV.items.length);
  lines.push('');
  var order = [['k', '## Keep', ''], ['e', '## Enrich', ''], ['c', '## Categorize', ''], ['a', '## Archive', ''], ['d', '## Delete', '']];
  order.forEach(function(g) {
    var items = SRV.items.filter(function(it) { return SRV.choices[it.path] === g[0]; });
    lines.push(g[1] + ' (' + items.length + ')');
    lines.push('');
    items.forEach(function(it) {
      var line = '- ' + it.title + ' (' + it.path + ')';
      if (g[0] === 'c' && SRV.catTargets[it.path]) {
        var from = it.path;
        var to = SRV.catTargets[it.path] + '/' + it.path.split('/').pop();
        line = '- ' + it.title + ' (' + it.path + ' → ' + to + ')';
        lines.push('git mv ' + from + ' ' + to);
      } else if (g[0] === 'a') {
