        lines.push('git mv ' + it.path + ' raw/archive/stub-audit-' + now + '/' + it.path);
      } else if (g[0] === 'd') {
        lines.push('git rm ' + it.path);
      }
      lines.push(line);
    });
    lines.push('');
  });
  var un = SRV.items.filter(function(it) { return !SRV.choices[it.path]; });
  if (un.length) {
    lines.push('## Unreviewed (' + un.length + ')');
    lines.push('');
    un.forEach(function(it) { lines.push('- ' + it.title + ' (' + it.path + ')'); });
    lines.push('');
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}
function srvShowResults() {
  var ta = document.getElementById('srv-results-text');
  var panel = document.getElementById('srv-results-panel');
  if (!ta || !panel) return;
  ta.value = srvBuildResults();
  panel.style.display = 'block';
  panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
}
function srvFallbackCopy(text, done) {
  var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
  ta.value = text; ta.style.position = 'fixed'; ta.style.opacity = '0';
  document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
  try { done(document.execCommand('copy')); } catch (e) { done(false); }
  document.body.removeChild(ta);
}
function srvCopyResults() {
  var ta = document.getElementById('srv-results-text');
  var text = ta && ta.value ? ta.value : srvBuildResults();
  function done(ok) {
    var el = document.getElementById('srv-queue-flash');
    if (el) { el.textContent = ok ? 'copied ✓' : 'copy failed'; el.style.color = ok ? '#34d399' : '#f87171'; setTimeout(function() { el.textContent = ''; }, 1800); }
  }
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function() { done(true); }).catch(function() { srvFallbackCopy(text, done); });
  } else srvFallbackCopy(text, done);
}
/* ── Stub review event wiring ── */
document.querySelectorAll('.srv-tab').forEach(function(t) {
  t.addEventListener('click', function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.srv-tab').forEach(function(x) { x.classList.remove('active'); });
    t.classList.add('active');
    SRV.filter = t.getAttribute('data-srvf');
    SRV.page = 1;
    srvRender();
  });
});
['srv-flt-stub', 'srv-flt-junk'].forEach(function(id) {
  var el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.addEventListener('change', function() { SRV.page = 1; srvRender(); });
});
var srvSortEl = document.getElementById('srv-sort');
if (srvSortEl) srvSortEl.addEventListener('change', function() { SRV.sort = this.value; SRV.page = 1; srvRender(); });
var srvAreaEl = document.getElementById('srv-area');
if (srvAreaEl) srvAreaEl.addEventListener('change', function() { SRV.areaFilter = this.value; SRV.page = 1; srvRender(); });
var srvPlanBtn = document.getElementById('srv-drain-plan');
if (srvPlanBtn) srvPlanBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { srvDrainRun('plan'); });
var srvApplyBtn = document.getElementById('srv-drain-apply');
if (srvApplyBtn) srvApplyBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { srvDrainRun('apply'); });
var srvBuildBtn = document.getElementById('srv-drain-build');
if (srvBuildBtn) srvBuildBtn.addEventListener('click', srvDrainBuild);
var srvPrevBtn = document.getElementById('srv-pg-prev');
if (srvPrevBtn) srvPrevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { if (SRV.page > 1) { SRV.page--; srvRender(); } });
var srvNextBtn = document.getElementById('srv-pg-next');
if (srvNextBtn) srvNextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { SRV.page++; srvRender(); });
var srvSaveBtn = document.getElementById('srv-save-queue');
if (srvSaveBtn) srvSaveBtn.addEventListener('click', srvSaveQueue);
var srvResultsBtn = document.getElementById('srv-results');
if (srvResultsBtn) srvResultsBtn.addEventListener('click', srvShowResults);
var srvCopyBtn = document.getElementById('srv-copy');
if (srvCopyBtn) srvCopyBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { srvShowResults(); srvCopyResults(); });

/* ── Guidance wiring (research & feedback queue, FAB) ── */
var fbAddBtn = document.getElementById('fb-add');
if (fbAddBtn) fbAddBtn.addEventListener('click', gdAdd);
var fbClearBtn = document.getElementById('fb-clear');
if (fbClearBtn) fbClearBtn.addEventListener('click', gdClear);
var gdSaveBtn = document.getElementById('gd-save');
if (gdSaveBtn) gdSaveBtn.addEventListener('click', gdSave);
var gdPlanBtn = document.getElementById('gd-drain-plan');
if (gdPlanBtn) gdPlanBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { gdDrainRun('plan'); });
var gdApplyBtn = document.getElementById('gd-drain-apply');
if (gdApplyBtn) gdApplyBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { gdDrainRun('apply'); });
var fbFab = document.getElementById('fb-fab');
if (fbFab) fbFab.addEventListener('click', function() {
  var p = state.currentFile || '';
  activateStubs();
  if (window.innerWidth < 820) openSidebar();
  var pathEl = document.getElementById('fb-path');
  if (pathEl && p) pathEl.value = p;
  var noteEl = document.getElementById('fb-note');
  if (noteEl) noteEl.focus();
});
fbFabUpdate();
var SRV_KEY_MAP = { '1': 'k', '2': 'e', '3': 'c', '4': 'a', '5': 'd' };
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (state.currentTab !== 'stubs') return;
  if (e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'SELECT') return;
  if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
  var key = SRV_KEY_MAP[e.key];
  if (!key) return;
  var pool = srvSorted(srvVisible());
  var first = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) {
    if (!SRV.choices[pool[i].path]) { first = pool[i]; break; }
  }
  if (!first) return;
  if (first.junk && key !== 'k' && key !== 'd') return;
  e.preventDefault();
  if (key === 'c') { srvSetChoice(first.path, 'c'); var box = document.getElementById('cp-' + encodeURIComponent(first.path).replace(/%/g, '_')); if (box) { box.style.display = 'block'; srvOpenPicker(first.path); } }
  else srvSetChoice(first.path, key);
  if (SRV.page > 1) SRV.page = 1;
});
/* ── Browse filter + actions wiring ── */
var stubsOnlyCb = document.getElementById('stubs-only');
if (stubsOnlyCb) {
  stubsOnlyCb.checked = !!state.stubsOnly;
  stubsOnlyCb.addEventListener('change', function() {
    state.stubsOnly = stubsOnlyCb.checked;
    try { localStorage.setItem('md-stubs-only', state.stubsOnly ? 'on' : 'off'); } catch (e) {}
    if (state.stubsOnly) {
      ensureStubPaths().then(function() { renderSidebar(); }).catch(function() { renderSidebar(); });
    } else {
      renderSidebar();
    }
  });
}

if (openStubsBtn) openStubsBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {

if (state.stubsOnly) {
  ensureStubPaths().catch(function() {});
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Article toolbar — Graph / Edit / Archive / Delete
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
var artToolbarEl = document.getElementById('article-toolbar');
var artEditorEl = document.getElementById('art-editor');
var artEditorTa = document.getElementById('art-editor-ta');
var artPathEl = document.getElementById('art-path');
var artEditPathEl = document.getElementById('art-edit-path');
var artFlashEl = document.getElementById('art-flash');

function artFlash(msg, isErr) {
  if (!artFlashEl) return;
  artFlashEl.textContent = msg;
  artFlashEl.style.color = isErr ? '#f87171' : '#34d399';
  clearTimeout(artFlash._t);
  artFlash._t = setTimeout(function() { if (artFlashEl) artFlashEl.textContent = ''; }, 4000);
}
function artShowToolbar(filename) {
  if (!artToolbarEl) return;
  if (artPathEl) artPathEl.textContent = filename || '';
  if (artEditorEl) artEditorEl.style.display = 'none';
  artToolbarEl.style.display = 'flex';
}
function artHideToolbar() {
  if (artToolbarEl) artToolbarEl.style.display = 'none';
  if (artEditorEl) artEditorEl.style.display = 'none';
}
function artOpenEditor() {
  var path = state.currentFile;
  if (!path) return;
  var content = state.fileContents[path];
  if (content == null) {
    artFlash('Loading source…');
    fetch(KB_BASE + encodeURIComponent(path))
      .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Not found'); return r.text(); })
      .then(function(md) { state.fileContents[path] = md; artOpenEditor(); })
      .catch(function() { artFlash('Could not load ' + path + ' for editing', true); });
    return;
  }
  if (artEditPathEl) artEditPathEl.textContent = path;
  if (artEditorTa) { artEditorTa.value = content; artEditorTa.focus(); artEditorTa.scrollTop = 0; }
  if (artEditorEl) artEditorEl.style.display = '';
  if (artToolbarEl) artToolbarEl.style.display = 'flex';
}
function artCloseEditor() {
  if (artEditorEl) artEditorEl.style.display = 'none';
  if (artToolbarEl) artToolbarEl.style.display = 'flex';
}
function artSave() {
  var path = state.currentFile;
  if (!path || !artEditorTa) return;
  var content = artEditorTa.value;
  artFlash('Saving…');
  fetch(KB_BASE + 'api/v2/file', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ path: path, content: content })
  }).then(function(r) {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    return r.json();
  }).then(function(d) {
    if (d.error) throw new Error(d.error);
    state.fileContents[path] = content;
    buildSearchIndex(path, content);
    artCloseEditor();
    renderContent(path, content);
    artFlash('Saved ' + path);
  }).catch(function(e) {
    artFlash('Save failed — ' + e.message + '. Static page? Edit the file on disk and rebuild.', true);
  });
}
function artPostFile(endpoint, path) {
  return fetch(KB_BASE + endpoint, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ path: path })
  }).then(function(r) {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    return r.json();
  });
}
function artStaticFallback(cmd, verb) {
  var full = 'cd components/mykb && ' + cmd;
  artFlash(verb + ' failed — no live daemon (command copied to clipboard)', true);
  try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(full); } catch (e) {}
  alert(verb + ' needs the live daemon.\nRun in the repo (copied to clipboard):\n\n' + full);
}
function artArchive() {
  var path = state.currentFile;
  if (!path) return;
  if (!confirm('Archive "' + path + '" to raw/archive/stub-audit-<date>? It can be restored with git.')) return;
  artFlash('Archiving…');
  artPostFile('api/v2/file/archive', path).then(function(d) {
    if (d.error) throw new Error(d.error);
    if (d.ok === false) throw new Error(d.output || 'archive failed');
    delete state.fileContents[path];
    artFlash('Archived ' + path);
    navigateHome();
    loadFileList();
  }).catch(function(e) {
    artStaticFallback('git mv "' + path + '" "raw/archive/stub-audit-$(date +%F)/' + path + '"', 'Archive');
  });
}
function artDelete() {
  var path = state.currentFile;
  if (!path) return;
  if (!confirm('Delete "' + path + '"? This runs git rm \u2014 recoverable via git history.')) return;
  artFlash('Deleting…');
  artPostFile('api/v2/file/delete', path).then(function(d) {
    if (d.error) throw new Error(d.error);
    if (d.ok === false) throw new Error(d.output || 'delete failed');
    delete state.fileContents[path];
    artFlash('Deleted ' + path);
    navigateHome();
    loadFileList();
  }).catch(function(e) {
    artStaticFallback('git rm "' + path + '"', 'Delete');
  });
}
var artGraphBtn = document.getElementById('art-graph');
if (artGraphBtn) artGraphBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { switchContentView('graph'); });
var artEditBtn = document.getElementById('art-edit');
if (artEditBtn) artEditBtn.addEventListener('click', artOpenEditor);
var artSaveBtn = document.getElementById('art-save');
if (artSaveBtn) artSaveBtn.addEventListener('click', artSave);
var artCancelBtn = document.getElementById('art-cancel');
if (artCancelBtn) artCancelBtn.addEventListener('click', artCloseEditor);
var artArchiveBtn = document.getElementById('art-archive');
if (artArchiveBtn) artArchiveBtn.addEventListener('click', artArchive);
var artDeleteBtn = document.getElementById('art-delete');
if (artDeleteBtn) artDeleteBtn.addEventListener('click', artDelete);

/* ── Sidebar Guidance promo + Guide sub-tabs ── */
var guidePromoBtn = document.getElementById('guide-promo');
if (guidePromoBtn) {
  guidePromoBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    activateStubs();
    if (window.innerWidth < 820) closeSidebar();
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll('.gt-tab').forEach(function(tab) {
  tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var gt = tab.getAttribute('data-gt');
    document.querySelectorAll('.gt-tab').forEach(function(t) { t.classList.toggle('active', t === tab); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.gt-section').forEach(function(sec) {
      sec.style.display = sec.getAttribute('data-gt') === gt ? '' : 'none';
    });
  });
});

loadFileList();

applySidebarState();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

 *{box-sizing:border-box}
 html,body{margin:0;height:100%}
 body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:14px/1.55 'Poppins',system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
 @property --side-w{syntax:'<length>';inherits:true;initial-value:380px}
 h1,h2,h3,h4{margin:0}

 /* ── app shell: rail + main ── */
 #app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:76px 1fr;height:100vh;height:100dvh}
 #rail{grid-column:1;background:var(--rail);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:12px 8px;overflow:hidden}
 .rail-brand{width:34px;height:34px;margin:2px 0 10px;flex:none}
 .rail-brand svg{width:34px;height:34px;display:block}
 .rail-item{position:relative;width:60px;padding:9px 2px;border:0;background:none;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;color:var(--rail-ink);transition:background .15s,color .15s;font-family:inherit}
 .rail-item .ri-ico svg{width:21px;height:21px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
 .rail-item .ri-lbl{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.005em}
 .rail-item:hover{color:var(--rail-ink-hi);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
 .rail-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
 .rail-item.active{color:#fff}
 .rail-item.active .ri-ico{color:var(--accent)}
 .rail-item.active::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-8px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:3px;height:24px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:var(--accent);
  transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
 .rail-sp{flex:1}
 .rail-tools{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center}
 .rail-tools .btn{color:var(--rail-ink);border-color:transparent;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
 .rail-tools .btn:hover{color:var(--rail-ink-hi);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:transparent}

 /* ── main column ── */
 #main{grid-column:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
 #topbar{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel)}
 /* on desktop the tools wrapper is layout-invisible — its children stay direct
    flex items of the bar; on mobile (below) it becomes the ⚙ drop-down sheet */
 #bar-tools{display:contents}
 /* the title may shrink and ellipsize at every width — mid-size viewports

 .ident{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:-.01em;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
 .ident .muted{color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;margin-left:9px;font-size:12.5px}

 .ident .src:hover{text-decoration:underline}
 #views{flex:1;min-height:0;position:relative;background:var(--bg)}
 .view{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;min-height:0}
 .view.active{display:flex}

 /* ── shared controls ── */
 .field{height:34px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);
  font:inherit;font-size:13px;padding:0 10px;outline:none;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
 .field:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}

 .search input{width:100%;padding-left:33px}
 .selwrap{position:relative;display:inline-flex;flex:none}
 .selwrap::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:12px;top:50%;width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.6px solid var(--muted);border-bottom:1.6px solid var(--muted);transform:translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg);pointer-events:none}
 select.field{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;padding-right:30px;cursor:pointer}
 select.field:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
 .btn{cursor:pointer;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--panel);color:var(--muted);transition:color .15s,border-color .15s,background .15s;font-family:inherit;position:relative}
 .btn:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
 .btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
 .btn[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}
 .btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
 .btn[hidden]{display:none}
 .btn.text{width:auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 12px;gap:7px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
 .btn .fbadge{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;min-width:16px;height:16px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--accent);
  color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;display:none;place-items:center;line-height:1}
 .btn.on-filter .fbadge{display:grid}
 #graph-controls{display:none;align-items:center;gap:9px}
 #app[data-view=graph] #graph-controls{display:flex}
 #file-controls{display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px}
 #app[data-view=files] #file-controls{display:flex}
 /* the mobile controls toggle — the ≤768px block turns the control groups into

 #btn-controls{display:none;flex:none}
 #btn-controls[aria-expanded=true]{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}

 #app[data-view=stats] #search-wrap{visibility:hidden}

 #btn-full .compress{display:none} #btn-full[aria-pressed=true] .compress{display:block} #btn-full[aria-pressed=true] .expand{display:none}

 /* ── section head with the whysimplicity red underline ── */
 .shead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin:0 0 16px}
 .shead h2{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;position:relative;padding-bottom:7px}
 .shead h2::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:34px;height:3px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--accent)}
 .shead .cnt{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--faint)}

 /* ── chips / badges ── */
 .chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12.5px;
  color:var(--muted);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:.14s;font-family:inherit}
 .chip:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
 .chip.off{opacity:.38} .chip.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
 .chip .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%} .chip .c{color:var(--faint);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
 .chip.on .c{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
 .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--line-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:3px 9px}
 .badge .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%}
 .status{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:5px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--line-2)}
 .status.shipped{color:var(--ok);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ok) 14%,transparent)}
 .tag{background:var(--line-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}

 /* ── graph view ── */
 .graph-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr var(--side-w);height:100%;min-height:0;
  --side-w:var(--side-w-user,380px);transition:--side-w .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
 .graph-body[data-side=hidden]{--side-w:0px}
 /* the chevron is a preset, not a maximum — the resizer goes wider on demand,
    so it splits the screen rather than burying the graph */
 .graph-body[data-side=wide]{--side-w:50vw}
 .graph-body.side-drag{transition:none}
 #stage{position:relative;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--canvas)}
 #cy{position:absolute;inset:0}
 .ghint{position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:14px;z-index:3;font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);pointer-events:none}
 #side{position:relative;min-width:0;background:var(--panel);border-left:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
 .graph-body[data-side=hidden] #side{border-left:0}
 /* drag handle on the panel's left edge (double-click resets the width) */
 #side-resizer{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:7px;cursor:col-resize;z-index:4;touch-action:none}
 #side-resizer::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--accent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s}
 #side-resizer:hover::after,.graph-body.side-drag #side-resizer::after{opacity:.7}
 .graph-body[data-side=hidden] #side-resizer{display:none}
 #side-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex:none}
 #side-head .lbl{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--faint);margin-right:auto}
 #side-head .btn{width:30px;height:30px}
 #side-body{padding:16px 18px;overflow:auto;flex:1}

 /* ── filters slide-over (graph + catalog) ── */
 .slideover{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:300px;max-width:82%;z-index:6;background:var(--panel);
  border-left:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
 .slideover.open{transform:none}
 .slideover .fhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
 .slideover .fhead h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-right:auto}
 .slideover .fbody{padding:14px;overflow:auto;flex:1}
 .slideover .fgroup{margin-bottom:18px}
 .slideover .fgroup h4{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--faint);margin:0 0 9px}
 .slideover .fchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
 .cat-types{align-items:center;gap:10px} .cat-types #cat-types{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
 .link{background:none;border:0;color:var(--accent-ink);font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;padding:0;font-weight:500}
 .link:hover{text-decoration:underline}

 /* ── inspector content ── */
 .type{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--line-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:3px 9px}
 .type .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%}
 .title{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;margin:.5em 0 0;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.3;text-wrap:balance}
 .desc{color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 14px}
 .tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px}
 /* the inspector's type and tags are filter handles — clicking one focuses the
    graph on that facet, the same jump a stats bar makes. Real buttons, like
    .tcloud, so the keyboard reaches them for free; font-size stays with .type
    and .tag, which set their own and are the reason this rule sets neither. */
 .facet{cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;line-height:inherit}
 .facet:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
 .facet.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
 .rel{margin:14px 0 0}
 .rel h4{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--faint)}
 .rel h4 .c{margin-left:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
 /* A link row is a concept row, so it speaks the vocabulary .titem already uses
    in the tags view: the type's dot, the title, the type name trailing faint.
    The dot is the bullet that carries information — it is the colour the node
    already wears in the graph beside it, so the column reads as a map of the
    neighbourhood before a single title is.
    What makes these read as *links* is the container, not the colour. Accent
    text on every row spends the accent on nothing and leaves the eye no way in;
    ink text alone reads as prose. So the rows share one panel with hairline
    dividers and a hover fill — the affordance a menu has, carried by structure,
    which leaves colour free to mean type and nothing else. One box rather than
    .titem's per-row cards: at nine links in a side panel, six borders weigh
    more than the concepts do, and a single surface stays quiet. */
 .rellist{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel-2)}
 .rel a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:6px 10px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;transition:background .12s,color .12s}
 .rel a+a{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
 .rel a:hover{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink)}
 .rel a .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
 .rel a .rt{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
 .rel a .ty{margin-left:auto;padding-left:8px;flex:none;font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}
 .empty{color:var(--muted)} .empty b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600} .loading{color:var(--faint)}

 /* ── markdown body ── */
 .body{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:14px;margin-top:16px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink-soft)}
 .body>*:first-child{margin-top:0}
 .body h1{font-size:19px}.body h2{font-size:16px}.body h3{font-size:14px}.body h1,.body h2,.body h3{line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;margin:1.2em 0 .5em}
 .body a{color:var(--accent-ink)}
 #side-body a.dead,.fp-body a.dead{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;text-decoration:line-through}
 .body code{background:var(--line-2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:5px;font-size:.85em;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace}
 .body pre{background:var(--line-2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px;border-radius:10px;overflow:auto}
 .body pre code{background:none;border:0;padding:0}
 .body table{border-collapse:collapse;display:block;overflow:auto}
 .body td,.body th{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:5px 9px}
 .body img{max-width:100%}
 .body blockquote{margin:.6em 0;padding:.2em 0 .2em 14px;border-left:3px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted)}
 .mermaid{margin:14px 0;display:flex;justify-content:center;background:var(--panel-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;overflow:auto;cursor:zoom-in}
 .mermaid:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
 .mermaid:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
 .mermaid svg{max-width:100%;height:auto}

 /* ── fullscreen diagram viewer (Panzoom, lazy like Mermaid itself) ── */
 #dgv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;background:var(--canvas)}
 #dgv[hidden]{display:none}
 #dgv-stage{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
 #dgv-stage:active{cursor:grabbing}
 #dgv-pan{flex:none}
 #dgv-pan svg{display:block;max-width:none}
 .dgv-bar{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;display:flex;gap:8px;z-index:2}
 .dgv-bar .btn{background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
 .dgv-hint{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--faint);pointer-events:none}
 /* ── bundle switcher (hub only) ── */
 #sw{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:rgba(0,0,0,.34);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding-top:14vh}
 #sw[hidden]{display:none}
 #sw-box{width:min(540px,92vw);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:12px}
 #sw-input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
 #sw-list{list-style:none;margin:10px 0 0;padding:0;max-height:46vh;overflow:auto}
 #sw-list a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px}
 #sw-list a .slug{margin-left:auto;color:var(--faint);font-size:12px}
 #sw-list .sw-grp{margin:9px 0 3px;padding:0 10px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--faint)}
 #sw-list .sw-grp:first-child{margin-top:0}
 /* Under a hub a view is the sideline, so it sits at the muted weight until the
    cursor reaches it — present, never competing with the bundle you came for.
    Standalone drops the class: there, views are all there is to pick. */
 #sw-list a.sw-view{color:var(--muted)}
 #sw-list a.sw-view:hover,#sw-list a.sw-view.active{color:var(--ink)}
 /* The rail sets its own svg size, so the copy needs one here — smaller, since
    a palette row is not a 76px rail tile. currentColor is what the rail already
    draws with, which means the icon dims and lifts with the row for free. */
 #sw-list a .sw-ico{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center}
 #sw-list a .sw-ico svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
 #sw-list a:hover,#sw-list a.active{background:var(--line-2)}
 #sw-list a.cur{color:var(--muted);cursor:default}
 #sw-list a.cur:hover{background:none}
 #sw-list a.none{color:var(--muted);cursor:default;font-size:13px}
 .sw-def{margin-left:7px;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--line-2);color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;vertical-align:1px}

 /* ── the ? sheet — same overlay shape as the palette, one row per binding ── */
 #kb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:91;background:rgba(0,0,0,.34);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding-top:14vh}
 #kb[hidden]{display:none}
 #kb-box{width:min(420px,92vw);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:14px 16px 16px}
 #kb-head{display:flex;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}
 #kb-head h3{margin:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em}
 #kb-head .btn{margin-left:auto;width:28px;height:28px}
 /* the key column sizes to the widest chord, so every description starts on one
    line and the sheet reads as a table without drawing one */
 #kb-list{margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:9px 14px;align-items:center}
 #kb-list dt{justify-self:start}
 #kb-list dd{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
 #kb-list kbd{display:inline-block;min-width:22px;text-align:center;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11.5px;
  color:var(--ink);background:var(--panel-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:6px;padding:2px 6px}
 .sw-hint{margin:9px 2px 2px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint)}
 /* ── bundle-count badge (hub only) ── */
 #btn-switch{position:relative}
 .swcount{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;min-width:16px;height:16px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--accent);
  color:#fff;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;display:grid;place-items:center;line-height:1}
 .swcount[hidden]{display:none}
 @keyframes swping{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(226,30,30,.5)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(226,30,30,0)}}
 .swcount:not([hidden]){animation:swping 1.6s ease-out .6s 4}
 /* ── mobile nav (hamburger + drawer) and the one-time desktop note ── */
 #btn-menu{display:none;position:relative;flex:none}
 #btn-menu .menudot{position:absolute;top:-3px;right:-3px;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
 #btn-menu .menudot[hidden]{display:none}
 #nav-bk{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:74;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
 #nav-bk[hidden]{display:none}
 #mnote{position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:72;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink)}
 #mnote[hidden]{display:none}
 #mnote .btn{flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;font-size:13px}

 /* ── catalog ── */
 .pad{padding:22px 24px;overflow:auto;flex:1}
 .cat-types{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-bottom:18px}
 .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:14px}
 .card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:15px 16px 13px;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .16s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-color .16s}
 .card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--accent)}
 .card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
 .card .r1{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
 .card .area{margin-left:auto;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);font-family:ui-monospace,monospace}
 .card h3{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.28}
 .card .cd{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
 .card .cm{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:auto;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)}
 .card .mini{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
 .card .mini.links{color:var(--accent-ink);margin-left:auto}
 .none{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:var(--faint);padding:48px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:12px}

 /* ── files ── */
 .files-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--ftree-w,320px) 1fr;height:100%;min-height:0}
 /* min-width:0 — the file rows' nowrap descriptions would otherwise set the
    pane's min-content width and blow the 1fr column past a phone viewport
    (the fixed desktop column never hits this) */
 .ftree{position:relative;border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0;background:var(--panel)}
 /* drag handle on the file list's right edge (double-click resets the width) */
 #ftree-resizer{position:absolute;right:-4px;top:0;bottom:0;width:7px;cursor:col-resize;z-index:4;touch-action:none}
 #ftree-resizer::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:3px;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--accent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s}
 #ftree-resizer:hover::after,#ftree-resizer.dragging::after{opacity:.7}
 .ftree-list{overflow:auto;flex:1;padding:8px}
 .ffolder{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;
  font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--faint);padding:12px 8px 5px;font-weight:600}
 .ffolder:hover{color:var(--muted)}
 .ffolder .chev{width:11px;height:11px;flex:none;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .15s}
 .ffolder.closed .chev{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
 .file.res .fn{color:var(--muted)}
 .file .fn .ricon{width:12px;height:12px;flex:none;stroke:var(--faint);fill:none;stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
 .ftabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:8px 10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex:none;align-items:center}
 /* mobile-only: collapses the stacked file list down to this tab bar */
 #ftree-min{display:none;width:28px;height:28px;flex:none;margin-bottom:4px}
 #ftree-min svg{transition:transform .15s}
 .files-grid.tree-min #ftree-min svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
 .ftab{flex:1;border:0;background:none;font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);
  padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px}
 .ftab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
 .ftab.active{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--accent)}
 /* the type/tag combos filter concepts; they mean nothing on the Indexes tab */
 #app[data-ftab=indexes] #file-controls .combo{display:none}
 .file .fn .badge-res{margin-left:auto;flex:none;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--faint);background:var(--line-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:1px 7px}
 /* The name needs an element of its own: as a bare text node it was an
    anonymous flex item, whose automatic minimum size is the full width of the
    text — so a long path refused to shrink and drove the badge past the right
    edge instead. overflow:hidden takes that minimum to zero, which is what lets
    the name give way and the badge stay put. */
 .file .fn .rn{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
 .file{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;background:none;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;color:var(--ink)}
 .file:hover{background:var(--panel-2)} .file.sel{background:var(--accent-soft)}
 .file .fn{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
 .file .fn .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
 .file .fd{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:2px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
 .fpreview{min-width:0;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
 .fp-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex:none}
 .fp-head .title{margin:0;font-size:16px}
 .fp-body{padding:20px 28px;overflow:auto;flex:1}
 .fp-body .body{border-top:0;padding-top:0;margin-top:0}

 /* ── tags ── */
 .cloud{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:24px;align-items:center}
 .tcloud{border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) var(--heat,0%),var(--line));background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) var(--heat,0%),var(--panel));border-radius:999px;padding:6px 13px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;transition:.14s}
 .tcloud:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)} .tcloud.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
 .tcloud b{color:var(--faint);font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:.8em;margin-left:5px} .tcloud.on b{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
 .tlist{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:9px}
 .titem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel);cursor:pointer;transition:.14s;font-family:inherit;text-align:left;color:var(--ink)}
 .titem:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-2px)}
 .titem .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:none} .titem .tt{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500}
 .titem .ty{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);margin-left:auto}

 /* ── stats ── */
 .stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:13px;margin-bottom:26px}
 .stat{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:17px 18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
 .stat .n{font-size:30px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
 .stat .l{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:7px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:500}
 .stat .n .u{color:var(--accent)}
 .bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;max-width:640px}
 .bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr 40px;align-items:center;gap:12px}
 .bar .bl{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
 .bar .bt{height:9px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--line-2);overflow:hidden}
 .bar .bf{height:100%;border-radius:5px;transform-origin:left;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
 .bar .bv{font-size:12px;color:var(--faint);text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
 .bar.clickable{cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;padding:3px 7px;margin:0 -7px;transition:background .13s}
 .bar.clickable:hover{background:var(--panel-2)} .bar.clickable:hover .bl{color:var(--accent-ink)}
 .bar.clickable:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
 .two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px} @media(max-width:820px){.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

 /* ── type autocomplete (graph filters + catalog) ── */
 .combo{position:relative;flex:none;width:170px}
 .combo input{width:100%;padding-right:26px}
 .combo .clear{position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:6px;display:none;place-items:center;padding:0}
 .combo .clear svg{width:13px;height:13px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round}
 .combo.has .clear{display:grid}
 .listbox{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:0;right:0;z-index:60;margin:0;padding:6px;list-style:none;background:var(--panel);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);max-height:320px;overflow:auto;animation:pop .13s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
 .listbox[hidden]{display:none}
 .opt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
 .opt .sw{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:none} .opt .c{margin-left:auto;color:var(--faint);font-size:12px}
 .opt:hover,.opt.active{background:var(--line-2)} .opt.sel{color:var(--accent-ink);font-weight:600}
 @keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

 /* ── the synthesized-map listing (inspector + files preview) ── */
 .ix-listing{margin:10px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
 .ix-listing li{padding:3px 0;font-size:13.5px}
 .ix-listing a{color:var(--accent-ink);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
 .ix-listing a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
 .ix-listing .d{color:var(--muted)}

 /* ── compact chrome for ≤768px (phones and portrait tablets): the rail becomes
    a drawer behind ☰ and every topbar tool collapses into the ⚙ sheet. Wider
    viewports — a rotated tablet included — fall back to the desktop layout;
    the media query re-evaluates live, so rotation flips strategy on its own ── */
 @media (max-width:768px){
  #app{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  #main{grid-column:1}
  #rail{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;z-index:75;width:76px;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .18s ease}
  #app.nav-open #rail{transform:none;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
  #btn-menu{display:inline-grid}
  #topbar{gap:8px;padding:10px 10px;position:relative;flex-wrap:nowrap}
  .ident{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;flex:1 1 auto}
  .ident .muted{display:none}
  /* the bar keeps only ☰ · title · ⚙ — search and every control move into the
     ⚙ sheet, on every view (stats has nothing to show, so no ⚙ there) */
  #btn-controls{display:inline-grid}
  #app[data-view=stats] #btn-controls{display:none}
  #bar-tools{display:none}
  #app.controls-open #bar-tools{display:flex;position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;z-index:55;
   flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:9px;padding:10px 12px;
   background:var(--panel);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
  #bar-tools .search{min-width:0;max-width:none;flex:1 1 auto} /* search spans the full sheet width */
  #app.controls-open #graph-controls,#app.controls-open #file-controls{flex-wrap:wrap}
  #app.controls-open #file-controls .combo{flex:1 1 44%;width:auto;min-width:130px}
  /* the graph inspector takes the whole viewport — the ✕ closes it; widening,
     drag-resizing, and the topbar panel toggle have no job at this size
     (grid-template beats the resizer's inline --side-w) */
  .graph-body[data-side=default],.graph-body[data-side=wide]{grid-template-columns:0 1fr}
  #side{border-left:0}
  #side-widen,#side-resizer,#btn-panel{display:none}
  /* the files view stacks: list on top, reader below — side-by-side panes
     don't survive a phone width */
  .files-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,42%) minmax(0,1fr)}
  .ftree{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  #ftree-resizer{display:none}
  .fp-body{padding:16px 14px}
  /* "Open in graph" shrinks to its icon — the label steals a third of the
     reader header on a phone (tooltip and aria-label carry the name) */
  #fp-graph .fpg-lbl{display:none}
  #fp-graph{width:34px;padding:0;flex:none}
  /* the list collapses to its tab bar so the reader gets the screen — picking
     a file collapses it, picking a tab brings it back */
  #ftree-min{display:inline-grid}
  .files-grid.tree-min{grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr)}
  .files-grid.tree-min .ftree-list{display:none}
 }
 /* ── tablet and up: the panes stay side-by-side, but the same chevron folds
    the whole list column into a slim strip so the reader takes the width ── */
 @media (min-width:769px){
  #ftree-min{display:inline-grid;margin-left:auto}
  #ftree-min svg{transform:rotate(90deg)}
  .files-grid.tree-min #ftree-min svg{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
  .files-grid.tree-min{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr}
  .files-grid.tree-min .ftree-list,.files-grid.tree-min .ftab,.files-grid.tree-min #ftree-resizer{display:none}
 }
 @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}
</style></head>
<body>
<div id="app" data-view="graph">
 <nav id="rail" aria-label="Views">
  <span class="rail-brand" title="components/mykb — 5418 concepts · 36892 links">
   <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect width="100" height="100" rx="24" fill="#1a1a1a"/><polygon points="38,44 62,44 50,82" fill="#7a0a1e"/><polygon points="18,44 38,44 50,82" fill="#a8112c"/><polygon points="62,44 82,44 50,82" fill="#a8112c"/><polygon points="35,28 18,44 38,44" fill="#dc1e3c"/><polygon points="65,28 82,44 62,44" fill="#dc1e3c"/><polygon points="35,28 65,28 62,44 38,44" fill="#f43f5e"/><polygon points="36,29 49,29 42,42" fill="#fff" opacity=".38"/><polygon points="35,28 65,28 82,44 50,82 18,44" fill="none" stroke="#ff6b7f" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
  </span>
  <button class="rail-item active" data-view="graph"><span class="ri-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2.4"/><circle cx="18" cy="9" r="2.4"/><circle cx="9" cy="18" r="2.4"/><path d="M7.7 7.3 15.9 8.6M7.5 16 8.2 8.3M10.9 16.4 16.3 10.5"/></svg></span><span class="ri-lbl">Graph</span></button>
  <button class="rail-item" data-view="index"><span class="ri-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16M4 9.6h10.5M4 14.2h16M4 18.8h7.5"/></svg></span><span class="ri-lbl">Index</span></button>
  <button class="rail-item" data-view="files"><span class="ri-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 7a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h3.5l2 2H19a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v8a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2Z"/></svg></span><span class="ri-lbl">Files</span></button>
  <button class="rail-item" data-view="catalog"><span class="ri-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="1.6"/><rect x="13.5" y="4" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="1.6"/><rect x="3" y="14.5" width="7.5" height="5.5" rx="1.6"/><rect x="13.5" y="14.5" width="7.5" height="5.5" rx="1.6"/></svg></span><span class="ri-lbl">Catalog</span></button>
  <button class="rail-item" data-view="tags"><span class="ri-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4.5h6.8L20 13.7l-6.3 6.3L4.5 10.8V4.5Z"/><circle cx="8.4" cy="8.4" r="1.4" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg></span><span class="ri-lbl">Tags</span></button>
  <button class="rail-item" data-view="stats"><span class="ri-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 20V11M12 20V4M19 20v-6"/></svg></span><span class="ri-lbl">Stats</span></button>
  <div class="rail-sp"></div>
  <div class="rail-tools">
   <button class="btn" id="btn-switch" type="button" hidden aria-label="Switch bundle (⌘K)" title="Switch bundle (⌘K)">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18 3a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v12a3 3 0 0 0 3 3 3 3 0 0 0 3-3 3 3 0 0 0-3-3H6a3 3 0 0 0-3 3 3 3 0 0 0 3 3 3 3 0 0 0 3-3V6a3 3 0 0 0-3-3 3 3 0 0 0-3 3 3 3 0 0 0 3 3h12a3 3 0 0 0 3-3 3 3 0 0 0-3-3Z"/></svg>
    <span class="swcount" id="sw-count" hidden>0</span></button>
   <button class="btn" id="btn-theme" type="button" aria-label="Toggle theme">
    <svg class="moon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 14.5A8 8 0 0 1 9.5 4 8 8 0 1 0 20 14.5Z"/></svg>
    <svg class="sun" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.2"/><path d="M12 2.5v2M12 19.5v2M2.5 12h2M19.5 12h2M5.2 5.2l1.5 1.5M17.3 17.3l1.5 1.5M18.8 5.2l-1.5 1.5M6.7 17.3l-1.5 1.5"/></svg></button>
   <button class="btn" id="btn-full" type="button" aria-label="Toggle full screen" aria-pressed="false">
    <svg class="expand" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 3H4a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4M16 3h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v4M8 21H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1v-4M16 21h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-4"/></svg>
    <svg class="compress" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 8h4V4M20 8h-4V4M4 16h4v4M20 16h-4v4"/></svg></button>
   <button class="btn" id="btn-help" type="button" aria-label="Keyboard shortcuts (?)" title="Keyboard shortcuts (?)">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M9.2 9.4a2.9 2.9 0 0 1 5.6 1c0 1.9-2.8 2.3-2.8 3.9"/><circle cx="12" cy="17.3" r=".95" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg></button>
  </div>
 </nav>

 <div id="main">
  <header id="topbar">
   <button class="btn" id="btn-menu" type="button" aria-label="Menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="rail">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"/></svg><span class="menudot" hidden></span></button>
   <span class="ident">components/mykb<span class="muted">5418 concepts · 36892 links</span></span>
   <div id="bar-tools">
   <div id="search-wrap"><label class="search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>
    <input id="search" class="field" placeholder="search concepts…" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search"></label></div>
   <div id="file-controls">
    <div class="combo" id="file-type-combo"><input id="file-type-input" class="field" placeholder="all types" autocomplete="off" role="combobox" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="file-type-list" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Filter files by type"><button class="clear" id="file-type-clear" type="button" aria-label="Clear type filter"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button><ul class="listbox" id="file-type-list" role="listbox" hidden></ul></div>
    <div class="combo" id="file-tag-combo"><input id="file-tag-input" class="field" placeholder="all tags" autocomplete="off" role="combobox" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="file-tag-list" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="Filter files by tag"><button class="clear" id="file-tag-clear" type="button" aria-label="Clear tag filter"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button><ul class="listbox" id="file-tag-list" role="listbox" hidden></ul></div>
   </div>
   <div id="graph-controls">
    <button class="btn text" id="btn-filters" type="button" aria-label="Filters"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 5h18l-7 8v6l-4-2v-4Z"/></svg>Filters<span class="fbadge">0</span></button>
    <span class="selwrap"><select id="layout" class="field" aria-label="Layout">
     <optgroup label="built-in">
      <option value="cose">force</option><option value="concentric">concentric</option>
      <option value="breadthfirst">breadth-first</option><option value="circle">circle</option><option value="grid">grid</option>
     </optgroup>
     <optgroup label="extended">
      <option value="fcose">organic</option><option value="dagre">hierarchy</option><option value="cola">physics</option>
     </optgroup>
    </select></span>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-fit" type="button" aria-label="Fit graph to screen" title="Fit graph to screen">
     <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 9V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h3M21 9V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-3M3 15v3a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3M21 15v3a2 2 0 0 0-2 2h-3"/><rect x="9.5" y="9.5" width="5" height="5" rx="1"/></svg></button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-cluster" type="button" aria-label="Cluster by area" aria-pressed="false" title="Cluster nodes by area">
     <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="4" opacity=".45"/><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="1.9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><circle cx="15" cy="10" r="1.9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><circle cx="11" cy="15" r="1.9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg></button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-tree" type="button" aria-label="File tree" aria-pressed="false" title="File tree: folders and files, parent-to-child edges only">
     <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="5" rx="1.2"/><rect x="3" y="16" width="6" height="5" rx="1.2"/><rect x="15" y="16" width="6" height="5" rx="1.2"/><path d="M12 8v4M12 12H6v4M12 12h6v4"/></svg></button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-panel" type="button" aria-label="Toggle inspector" aria-pressed="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M15 4v16"/></svg></button>
   </div>
   </div>
   <button class="btn" id="btn-controls" type="button" aria-label="View controls" aria-expanded="false">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 7h9M17 7h3M4 17h3M11 17h9M14.5 4.5v5M8.5 14.5v5"/></svg><span class="fbadge">0</span></button>
  </header>

  <div id="views">
   <!-- GRAPH -->
   <section class="view active" id="view-graph">
    <div class="graph-body" data-side="hidden">
     <div id="stage">
      <div id="cy"></div>
      <div class="ghint">click a concept · scroll to zoom · drag to pan</div>
      <aside id="filters" class="slideover" aria-label="Graph filters">
       <div class="fhead"><h3>Filters</h3><button class="link" id="filters-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
        <button class="btn" id="filters-close" type="button" aria-label="Close filters" style="width:28px;height:28px"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button></div>
       <div class="fbody">
        <label class="search" style="max-width:none;margin-bottom:12px"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>
         <input id="filter-search" class="field" placeholder="find a type, area, tag…" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Find a filter"></label>
        <div class="fgroup"><h4>Types</h4><div class="fchips" id="ftypes"></div></div>
        <div class="fgroup"><h4>Areas</h4><div class="fchips" id="fareas"></div></div>
        <div class="fgroup"><h4>Tags</h4><div class="fchips" id="ftags"></div></div>
       </div>
      </aside>
     </div>
     <aside id="side">
      <div id="side-resizer" title="Drag to resize · double-click to reset" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div id="side-head"><span class="lbl">Inspector</span>
       <button class="btn" id="side-widen" type="button" aria-label="Widen panel" aria-pressed="false" title="Widen / restore">
        <svg class="wide" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M13 6l-6 6 6 6M19 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg>
        <svg class="narrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="display:none"><path d="M11 6l6 6-6 6M5 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
       <button class="btn" id="side-close" type="button" aria-label="Hide panel" title="Hide panel"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button></div>
      <div id="side-body"><p class="empty">Select a concept — <b>click a node</b> in the graph, or search above — to read its full markdown here.</p></div>
     </aside>
    </div>
   </section>

   <!-- CATALOG -->
   <section class="view" id="view-catalog">
    <div class="pad">
     <div class="shead"><h2>Catalog</h2><span class="cnt" id="cat-cnt"></span></div>
     <div class="cat-types">
      <div id="cat-types"></div>
      <button class="btn text" id="cat-filters-btn" type="button" aria-label="Filters"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 5h18l-7 8v6l-4-2v-4Z"/></svg>Filters<span class="fbadge">0</span></button>
     </div>
     <div class="grid" id="cat-grid"><div class="none">Loading concepts…</div></div>
    </div>
    <aside id="cat-filters" class="slideover" aria-label="Catalog filters">
     <div class="fhead"><h3>Filters</h3><button class="link" id="cat-filters-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
      <button class="btn" id="cat-filters-close" type="button" aria-label="Close filters" style="width:28px;height:28px"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button></div>
     <div class="fbody">
      <label class="search" style="max-width:none;margin-bottom:12px"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>
       <input id="cat-filter-search" class="field" placeholder="find a type, area, tag…" autocomplete="off"></label>
      <div class="fgroup"><h4>Types</h4><div class="fchips" id="cat-ftypes"></div></div>
      <div class="fgroup"><h4>Areas</h4><div class="fchips" id="cat-fareas"></div></div>
      <div class="fgroup"><h4>Tags</h4><div class="fchips" id="cat-ftags"></div></div>
     </div>
    </aside>
   </section>

   <!-- FILES -->
   <section class="view" id="view-files">
    <div class="files-grid">
     <div class="ftree">
      <div class="ftabs" role="tablist" aria-label="File kinds">
       <button class="ftab active" id="ftab-files" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="true">Files</button>
       <button class="ftab" id="ftab-indexes" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Indexes</button>
       <button class="btn" id="ftree-min" type="button" aria-label="Collapse file list" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="ftree-list">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
      </div>
      <div class="ftree-list" id="ftree-list"><p class="empty" style="padding:14px">Loading files…</p></div>
      <div id="ftree-resizer" title="Drag to resize · double-click to reset" aria-hidden="true"></div>
     </div>
     <div class="fpreview">
      <div class="fp-head" id="fp-head" hidden><span class="type" id="fp-type"></span><h2 class="title" id="fp-title"></h2>
       <button class="btn text" id="fp-graph" type="button" style="margin-left:auto" aria-label="Open in graph" title="Open in graph"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2.4"/><circle cx="18" cy="9" r="2.4"/><circle cx="9" cy="18" r="2.4"/><path d="M7.7 7.3 15.9 8.6M10.9 16.4 16.3 10.5"/></svg><span class="fpg-lbl">Open in graph</span></button></div>
      <div class="fp-body" id="fp-body"><p class="empty">Pick a file on the left to read it here — Mermaid diagrams render inline.</p></div>
     </div>
    </div>
   </section>

   <!-- TAGS -->
   <section class="view" id="view-tags">
    <div class="pad">
     <div class="shead" style="align-items:center"><h2>Tags</h2><span class="cnt" id="tag-cnt"></span>
      <button class="btn text" id="tag-filters-btn" type="button" aria-label="Filters" style="margin-left:auto"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 5h18l-7 8v6l-4-2v-4Z"/></svg>Filters<span class="fbadge">0</span></button></div>
     <div class="cloud" id="tag-cloud"></div>
     <div id="tag-detail"><p class="empty">Select a tag to see the concepts that carry it.</p></div>
    </div>
    <aside id="tag-filters" class="slideover" aria-label="Tag filters">
     <div class="fhead"><h3>Filters</h3><button class="link" id="tag-filters-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
      <button class="btn" id="tag-filters-close" type="button" aria-label="Close filters" style="width:28px;height:28px"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button></div>
     <div class="fbody">
      <div class="fgroup"><h4>Types</h4><div class="fchips" id="tag-ftypes"></div></div>
      <div class="fgroup"><h4>Areas</h4><div class="fchips" id="tag-fareas"></div></div>
     </div>
    </aside>
   </section>

   <!-- STATS -->
   <section class="view" id="view-stats">
    <div class="pad">
     <div class="shead"><h2>Overview</h2><span class="cnt">the bundle at a glance</span></div>
     <div class="stat-grid" id="stat-grid"></div>
     <div class="two">
      <div><div class="shead"><h2>By type</h2></div><div class="bars" id="bars-type"></div></div>
      <div><div class="shead"><h2>By area</h2></div><div class="bars" id="bars-area"></div></div>
     </div>
    </div>
   </section>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

<!-- fullscreen diagram viewer — click (or tap) a rendered Mermaid block to open it -->
<div id="dgv" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Diagram viewer">
 <div id="dgv-stage"><div id="dgv-pan"></div></div>
 <div class="dgv-bar">
  <button class="btn" id="dgv-out" type="button" aria-label="Zoom out"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
  <button class="btn" id="dgv-reset" type="button" aria-label="Reset view"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 3H4v5M15 3h5v5M9 21H4v-5M15 21h5v-5"/></svg></button>
  <button class="btn" id="dgv-in" type="button" aria-label="Zoom in"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
  <button class="btn" id="dgv-close" type="button" aria-label="Close diagram viewer"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button>
 </div>
 <p class="dgv-hint">drag to pan · scroll or pinch to zoom · double-click resets · Esc closes</p>
</div>

<div id="sw" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Switch bundle">
 <div id="sw-box">
  <input id="sw-input" class="field" placeholder="switch bundle…" autocomplete="off" role="combobox" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sw-list" aria-label="Switch bundle">
  <ul id="sw-list" role="listbox"></ul>
  <p class="sw-hint" id="sw-hint">↑↓ move · ⏎ open · ⌘/Ctrl-⏎ new tab · Esc close</p>
 </div>
</div>

<div id="kb" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="kb-h">
 <div id="kb-box">
  <div id="kb-head"><h3 id="kb-h">Keyboard</h3>
   <button class="btn" id="kb-x" type="button" aria-label="Close"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button></div>
  <dl id="kb-list"></dl>
 </div>
</div>

<div id="nav-bk" hidden></div>
<div id="mnote" hidden role="note">
 <span>Best experienced on a desktop — tap ☰ for views, pinch to zoom, tap a concept to read it.</span>
 <button class="btn" id="mnote-x" type="button" aria-label="Dismiss">✕</button>
</div>

<script>
const NODES=[], EDGES=[], TYPES={}, TAGS={};
/* Pass 10: data now loads lazily from graph.json / catalog.json next to
   this page instead of being baked in (the old 43 MB embed would not
   parse on mobile). TYPES/TAGS are rebuilt from the catalog so node
   typing, colours and filters keep working over static hosting. */
let OKF_CATALOG=null;
function okfCatalogFetch(){
  if(OKF_CATALOG)return Promise.resolve(OKF_CATALOG);
  return fetch('catalog.json',{cache:'no-cache'}).then(function(r){return r.ok?r.json():[];}).then(function(d){
    var list=Array.isArray(d)?d:(d&&Array.isArray(d.concepts)?d.concepts:[]);
    OKF_CATALOG=list;
    for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){var c=list[i];if(!c||c.id==null)continue;
      if(c.type)(TYPES[c.type]=TYPES[c.type]||[]).push(c.id);
      if(Array.isArray(c.tags))for(var j=0;j<c.tags.length;j++)(TAGS[c.tags[j]]=TAGS[c.tags[j]]||[]).push(c.id);}
    return list;
  }).catch(function(){OKF_CATALOG=[];return OKF_CATALOG;});
}
/* Layout safety (pass 10): force-directed layouts (cose/fcose/cola) are
   synchronous and unusable beyond ~1.2k nodes on mobile — default the page
   to concentric and fall back to it when a force layout is requested on a
   graph this large. */
function okfForceLayout(n){return n==='cose'||n==='fcose'||n==='cola';}
function okfSafeLayout(name){if(okfForceLayout(name)&&NODES.length>1200){okfToast('Graph too large for '+name+' ('+NODES.length+' nodes) — using concentric');return 'concentric';}return name;}
function okfToast(msg){var t=document.createElement('div');t.textContent=msg;t.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:100;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(20,24,33,.95);color:#e2e5ea;font:600 12px Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.4);max-width:80vw;text-align:center';document.body.appendChild(t);setTimeout(function(){t.style.opacity='0';t.style.transition='opacity .4s';setTimeout(function(){if(t.parentNode)t.parentNode.removeChild(t);},420);},3200);}

const NODE_ENDPOINT="node", META_ENDPOINT="node/meta";
const CATALOG_ENDPOINT="catalog",INDEX_ENDPOINT="index",LOG_ENDPOINT="log";
/* The hub's bundle switcher (⌘/Ctrl-K). SIBLINGS is empty for a standalone
   server and for `okf render`, so a single bundle or a static file offers none. */
const SIBLINGS=[], SELF_SLUG=null, HUB_PATH=null;
/* null when served live (`okf server`) — the getters below fetch the endpoints
   above. `okf render` injects a payload {catalog,index,logs,bodies,meta}, and
   every getter resolves from it instead, so one file needs no server and the
   endpoint consts above go inert. */
const EMBED=null;
function okfBoot(){

const MIN=14, MAX=44;
const PALETTE=["#6E56CF","#D97757","#22C55E","#3B82F6","#EAB308","#EC4899","#14B8A6","#F97316","#A855F7","#0EA5E9","#84CC16","#EF4444","#64748B"];
const root=document.documentElement;
const byId=Object.fromEntries(NODES.map(n=>[n.id,n]));
const outL={}, inL={};
NODES.forEach(n=>{outL[n.id]=[];inL[n.id]=[];});
EDGES.forEach(e=>{outL[e.source].push(e.target);inL[e.target].push(e.source);});
const typeOf={};Object.entries(TYPES).forEach(([t,ids])=>ids.forEach(id=>typeOf[id]=t));
const tagsOf={};NODES.forEach(n=>tagsOf[n.id]=[]);Object.entries(TAGS).forEach(([t,ids])=>ids.forEach(id=>{(tagsOf[id]=tagsOf[id]||[]).push(t);}));
const types=Object.keys(TYPES).sort();
const color=Object.fromEntries(types.map((t,i)=>[t,PALETTE[i%PALETTE.length]]));
const deg=id=>(outL[id]||[]).length+(inL[id]||[]).length;
const szOf=id=>Math.max(MIN,Math.min(MAX,MIN+deg(id)*4));
// Quotes included, because this escape feeds attributes as well as text:
// `href="${esc(...)}"` breaks out of its own quoting the moment one survives.
// The Ruby half of the page escapes the same set (Rack::Utils.escape_html), and
// an escape whose safety depends on where the caller happens to interpolate it
// is the shape of the XSS this page's trust boundary exists to refuse.
const esc=s=>(s==null?'':String(s)).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const cvar=n=>getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue(n).trim();
const isDark=()=>root.getAttribute('data-theme')==='dark';
const reduce=()=>matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
const areaOf=id=>id.includes('/')?id.split('/')[0]:'(root)';

/* ── Cytoscape ── */
function styleSheet(){const ink=cvar('--ink'),halo=cvar('--canvas'),edge=cvar('--edge');
 return [
  {selector:'node',style:{'background-color':'data(c)','label':'data(title)','color':ink,'font-family':'Poppins,sans-serif',
   'font-size':10,'font-weight':500,'text-wrap':'wrap','text-max-width':120,'text-valign':'bottom','text-margin-y':5,
   'text-outline-width':2.5,'text-outline-color':halo,'min-zoomed-font-size':7,'border-width':0,'width':'data(sz)','height':'data(sz)'}},
  {selector:'edge',style:{'width':1.2,'line-color':edge,'target-arrow-color':edge,'target-arrow-shape':'triangle','arrow-scale':.8,'curve-style':'bezier','opacity':.8}},
  {selector:'.dim',style:{'opacity':.1}},
  {selector:'.hl',style:{'border-width':3,'border-color':cvar('--accent')}},
  {selector:'node.dir',style:{'shape':'round-rectangle','background-color':cvar('--faint'),'background-opacity':.85,
   'font-size':9.5,'font-weight':600,'color':cvar('--muted')}},
  {selector:'edge.tree',style:{'width':1.1,'opacity':.7,'target-arrow-shape':'none'}},
  {selector:'edge.linkhid',style:{'display':'none'}},
  {selector:':parent',style:{'background-color':cvar('--ink'),'background-opacity':0.05,'border-width':1,'border-color':cvar('--edge'),'shape':'round-rectangle','padding':26,'label':'data(label)','color':cvar('--ink'),'font-size':13,'font-weight':600,'text-valign':'top','text-halign':'center','text-margin-y':-8,'min-zoomed-font-size':0,'text-outline-width':3,'text-outline-color':cvar('--canvas')}}
 ];}
/* Only the floor for a graph that already fits. "Far enough out to see
   everything" is not a constant — a big bundle, especially clustered by area
   where cose spreads the compound boxes wide, needs to go well below this, and
   a floor above the fitting zoom puts the whole picture out of reach, fit
   button included. relaxZoom() lowers it to follow anything bigger. */
const MIN_ZOOM=.2;
const cy=cytoscape({container:document.getElementById('cy'),minZoom:MIN_ZOOM,maxZoom:1.6,wheelSensitivity:.2,
 elements:[...NODES.map(n=>({data:{id:n.id,title:n.title,c:color[typeOf[n.id]||'Untyped']||'#64748b',sz:szOf(n.id)}})),...EDGES.map(e=>({data:e}))],
 style:styleSheet(),layout:{name:'concentric',animate:false,minNodeSpacing:30,padding:40,avoidOverlap:true,spacingFactor:1.2,nodeDimensionsIncludeLabels:true}});
function applyCyTheme(){cy.style(styleSheet());}
/* Debounced so the panel width transition (--side-w, .22s) fires cy.resize()
   once after it settles instead of on every frame — avoids canvas flicker. */
let cyResizeTimer;
new ResizeObserver(()=>{clearTimeout(cyResizeTimer);cyResizeTimer=setTimeout(()=>{cy.resize();relaxZoom();},240);}).observe(document.getElementById('cy'));
const cyEl=document.getElementById('cy');
cy.on('mouseover','node',()=>cyEl.style.cursor='pointer');
cy.on('mouseout','node',()=>cyEl.style.cursor='');

/* ── Mermaid (lazy) ── */
let _mermaid=null;
function loadMermaid(){return _mermaid||(_mermaid=new Promise((res,rej)=>{const s=document.createElement('script');
 s.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11/dist/mermaid.min.js';s.onload=()=>{window.mermaid.initialize({startOnLoad:false,securityLevel:'strict',theme:isDark()?'dark':'default'});res(window.mermaid);};s.onerror=rej;document.head.appendChild(s);}));}
let mermaidSeq=0;
function processMermaid(el){const blocks=[...el.querySelectorAll('code.language-mermaid')];if(!blocks.length)return;
 loadMermaid().then(m=>{const nodes=[];blocks.forEach(b=>{const pre=b.closest('pre');const d=document.createElement('div');
  d.className='mermaid';d.dataset.src=b.textContent;d.id='mmd-'+(++mermaidSeq);d.textContent=b.textContent;
  d.tabIndex=0;d.setAttribute('role','button');d.setAttribute('aria-label','Expand diagram');d.title='Expand — pan & zoom';
  pre.replaceWith(d);nodes.push(d);});
  m.run({nodes}).catch(()=>{});}).catch(()=>{});}
function rethemeMermaid(){if(!window.mermaid)return;const nodes=[...document.querySelectorAll('.mermaid')];if(!nodes.length)return;
 window.mermaid.initialize({startOnLoad:false,securityLevel:'strict',theme:isDark()?'dark':'default'});
 nodes.forEach(d=>{if(d.dataset.src){d.removeAttribute('data-processed');d.innerHTML='';d.textContent=d.dataset.src;}});
 window.mermaid.run({nodes}).catch(()=>{});}
function renderMarkdown(el,text){el.innerHTML=text?DOMPurify.sanitize(marked.parse(text)):'<span class="empty">empty body</span>';processMermaid(el);}

/* ── fullscreen diagram viewer — Panzoom (lazy, like Mermaid): click a rendered
   diagram to inspect it full screen; drag pans, wheel or pinch zooms. ── */
let _panzoom=null;
function loadPanzoom(){return _panzoom||(_panzoom=loadScript('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@panzoom/panzoom@4/dist/panzoom.min.js').then(()=>window.Panzoom));}
const dgv=document.getElementById('dgv'),dgvStage=document.getElementById('dgv-stage'),dgvPan=document.getElementById('dgv-pan');
let dgvPz=null,dgvBack=null,dgvSeq=0;
function openDiagram(m){const src=m.dataset.src;if(!src||!m.querySelector('svg'))return;
 /* re-render from source rather than cloning the inline svg — mermaid scopes
    the styles it embeds to the svg's id, so a clone would lose its colors */
 Promise.all([ loadPanzoom(), loadMermaid() ]).then(all=>
  all[1].render('dgv-mmd-'+(++dgvSeq),src).then(out=>{
   dgvPan.innerHTML=out.svg;
   const c=dgvPan.querySelector('svg'),vb=c.viewBox&&c.viewBox.baseVal;
   const w=(vb&&vb.width)||800,h=(vb&&vb.height)||500;
   c.style.maxWidth='none';c.setAttribute('width',w);c.setAttribute('height',h);
   dgvBack=m;dgv.hidden=false;
   const fit=Math.min((innerWidth-48)/w,(innerHeight-96)/h,2);
   dgvPz=Panzoom(dgvPan,{maxScale:10,minScale:.1,startScale:fit,canvas:true,step:.2});
   document.getElementById('dgv-close').focus();
  })).catch(()=>{});}
function closeDiagram(){if(dgv.hidden)return;
 if(dgvPz){dgvPz.destroy();dgvPz=null;}
 dgv.hidden=true;dgvPan.innerHTML='';
 if(dgvBack){try{dgvBack.focus();}catch(e){}dgvBack=null;}}
dgvStage.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{if(dgvPz)dgvPz.zoomWithWheel(e);},{passive:false});
dgvStage.addEventListener('dblclick',()=>{if(dgvPz)dgvPz.reset();});
document.getElementById('dgv-in').onclick=()=>{if(dgvPz)dgvPz.zoomIn();};
document.getElementById('dgv-out').onclick=()=>{if(dgvPz)dgvPz.zoomOut();};
document.getElementById('dgv-reset').onclick=()=>{if(dgvPz)dgvPz.reset();};
document.getElementById('dgv-close').onclick=closeDiagram;
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const m=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.mermaid');if(m&&!dgv.contains(e.target))openDiagram(m);});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')&&e.target.classList&&e.target.classList.contains('mermaid')){e.preventDefault();openDiagram(e.target);}});

/* ── inspector ── */
const gbody=document.querySelector('.graph-body'), sideBody=document.getElementById('side-body');
const btnPanel=document.getElementById('btn-panel'), sideWiden=document.getElementById('side-widen');
function setSide(s){gbody.setAttribute('data-side',s);btnPanel.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(s!=='hidden'));
 sideWiden.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(s==='wide'));
 sideWiden.querySelector('.wide').style.display=s==='wide'?'none':'block';
 sideWiden.querySelector('.narrow').style.display=s==='wide'?'block':'none';}
function openPanel(){if(gbody.getAttribute('data-side')!=='hidden')return false;setSide('default');return true;}
btnPanel.onclick=()=>setSide(gbody.getAttribute('data-side')==='hidden'?'default':'hidden');
document.getElementById('side-close').onclick=()=>setSide('hidden');
sideWiden.onclick=()=>setSide(gbody.getAttribute('data-side')==='wide'?'default':'wide');
/* The inspector boots hidden on every screen (data-side="hidden" in the markup,
   so the graph lays out at full width) — the first node select opens it via
   openPanel. This sync just points the header buttons at that initial state. */
setSide('hidden');
/* ── drag-resize splitters: inspector + files tree (persisted; dblclick resets) ── */
function splitter(handle,host,cssVar,key,widthAt,opts){opts=opts||{};
 /* restore clamped to the current viewport — a width dragged on a desktop
    must not swallow a phone screen */
 try{const w=parseInt(localStorage.getItem(key),10);
  if(w)host.style.setProperty(cssVar,Math.min(w,Math.round(innerWidth*.7))+'px');}catch(e){}
 handle.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();
  if(opts.onStart)opts.onStart();
  try{handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(err){}
  handle.classList.add('dragging');host.classList.add('side-drag');
  let lastW=0,raf=false;
  /* Track the drag on window so it keeps working even where pointer capture
     is unavailable — the pointer leaves the 7px handle on the first frame. */
  const move=ev=>{lastW=Math.round(widthAt(ev));host.style.setProperty(cssVar,lastW+'px');
   if(opts.onMove&&!raf){raf=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{raf=false;opts.onMove();});}};
  const up=()=>{removeEventListener('pointermove',move);removeEventListener('pointerup',up);removeEventListener('pointercancel',up);
   handle.classList.remove('dragging');host.classList.remove('side-drag');
   if(opts.onEnd)opts.onEnd();
   if(lastW){try{localStorage.setItem(key,String(lastW));}catch(e){}}};
  addEventListener('pointermove',move);addEventListener('pointerup',up);addEventListener('pointercancel',up);});
 handle.addEventListener('dblclick',()=>{host.style.removeProperty(cssVar);
  try{localStorage.removeItem(key);}catch(e){}
  if(opts.onEnd)opts.onEnd();});}
const clampW=(v,lo,hi)=>Math.min(Math.max(v,lo),hi);
splitter(document.getElementById('side-resizer'),gbody,'--side-w-user','okf-side-w',
 ev=>{const r=gbody.getBoundingClientRect();return clampW(r.right-ev.clientX,280,r.width*.8);},
 {onStart:()=>{if(gbody.getAttribute('data-side')==='wide')setSide('default');},
  onMove:()=>cy.resize(),onEnd:()=>cy.resize()});
const fgrid=document.querySelector('.files-grid');
splitter(document.getElementById('ftree-resizer'),fgrid,'--ftree-w','okf-ftree-w',
 ev=>{const r=fgrid.getBoundingClientRect();return clampW(ev.clientX-r.left,220,r.width*.55);});
/* The count belongs in the eyebrow: how connected a concept is, is the first
   thing the section answers, and it answers it before the list is read. The
   title carries a title attribute because .rt truncates — the panel resizes,
   but the tooltip means a narrow one never hides a name outright. */
function relList(t,arr){if(!arr.length)return'';
 const row=id=>{const ty=typeOf[id]||'Untyped', ti=(byId[id]||{}).title||id;
  return `<a data-go="${esc(id)}" title="${esc(ti)}"><span class="dot" style="background:${color[ty]||'#64748b'}"></span><span class="rt">${esc(ti)}</span><span class="ty">${esc(ty)}</span></a>`;};
 return `<div class="rel"><h4>${t}<span class="c">${arr.length}</span></h4><div class="rellist">${arr.map(row).join('')}</div></div>`;}
/* Markdown links inside the inspector are GitHub-style relative file paths;
   there is no route for them here, so a plain click 404s the whole page.
   Resolve them against the open concept and navigate in-app instead; external
   links open in a new tab; anything unresolvable is disabled, never a 404. */
let shownId=null;
/* Every directory that holds a concept — the sync existence check for links
   that point at a directory or its index rather than at a concept file. */
const DIRSET=new Set();
NODES.forEach(n=>{const parts=n.id.split('/');for(let i=1;i<parts.length;i++)DIRSET.add(parts.slice(0,i).join('/'));});
/* A markdown href resolves to a concept ({id}) or to the authored layer
   ({res:{kind:'index',dir}} / {res:{kind:'log',path}}) — or to null (dead).
   Directory links (`model/`, `/`) count as that directory's index. */
function resolveTarget(href,baseId){let p=href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0];if(!p)return null;
 try{p=decodeURIComponent(p);}catch(e){}
 const out=p.charAt(0)==='/'?[]:(baseId?baseId.split('/').slice(0,-1):[]);
 for(const s of p.replace(/^\//,'').split('/')){if(!s||s==='.')continue;if(s==='..'){out.pop();continue;}out.push(s);}
 const path=out.join('/');
 const id=path.replace(/\.md$/i,'');
 if(byId[id])return {id:id};
 if(/(^|\/)index\.md$/i.test(path))return {res:{kind:'index',dir:dirOfPath(path)}};
 if(/(^|\/)log\.md$/i.test(path))return {res:{kind:'log',path:path}};
 if(path===''||DIRSET.has(path))return {res:{kind:'index',dir:path===''?'.':path}};
 return null;}
function interceptMdLinks(container,baseIdOf,go,goRes){container.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 const a=e.target.closest('a');
 if(!a||!container.contains(a)||a.hasAttribute('data-go'))return;
 const href=a.getAttribute('href')||'';
 if(/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(href)||href.indexOf('//')===0){e.preventDefault();window.open(a.href,'_blank','noopener');return;}
 e.preventDefault();if(href.charAt(0)==='#')return;
 const t=resolveTarget(href,baseIdOf());
 if(t&&t.id)go(t.id);
 else if(t&&t.res&&goRes)goRes(t.res);
 else{a.classList.add('dead');a.title='not a file in this bundle';}});}
const ixPathOf=dir=>dir==='.'?'index.md':dir+'/index.md';
interceptMdLinks(sideBody,()=>shownId,select,r=>r.kind==='index'?showDir(r.dir):showLog(r.path));
interceptMdLinks(document.getElementById('fp-body'),()=>fileSel,id=>openFile(id),
 r=>openReserved(r.kind,r.kind==='index'?ixPathOf(r.dir):r.path));
/* Clicking a folder node (tree mode) or an area box (cluster mode) opens that
   directory's §6 index entry in the inspector: the authored map when one
