```html
   exists, the synthesized listing when not. */
function showDir(dir){getIndex().then(dirs=>{const d=dirs.find(x=>x.dir===dir);if(!d)return;
 const opened=openPanel();sideBody.scrollTop=0;
 shownId=d.dir==='.'?'index':d.dir+'/index'; /* pseudo-id: relative links in the map resolve against its directory */
 const label=d.dir==='.'?'(root)':d.dir+'/';
 const types=Object.entries(d.types||{}).map(([t,n])=>esc(t||'Untyped')+' '+n).join(' · ');
 sideBody.innerHTML=`<span class="type">${d.present?'index.md':'no index.md · synthesized'}</span>
  <h2 class="title">${esc(label)}</h2>
  <div class="desc">${d.count} concept${d.count===1?'':'s'}${types?' · '+types:''}</div>
  <div class="body" id="dir-body"></div>`;
 if(d.present)renderMarkdown(document.getElementById('dir-body'),d.body||'');
 else document.getElementById('dir-body').innerHTML=listingHtml(d.listing);
 sideBody.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(a=>a.onclick=()=>select(a.getAttribute('data-go')));
 if(opened)requestAnimationFrame(()=>cy.resize());});}
/* A log.md link opens the history in the inspector, fetched fresh. */
function showLog(path){LOGS=null;getLogs().then(logs=>{const l=logs.find(x=>x.path===path);if(!l)return;
 const opened=openPanel();sideBody.scrollTop=0;
 shownId=path.replace(/\.md$/,'');
 sideBody.innerHTML=`<span class="type">update log · §7</span><h2 class="title">${esc(path)}</h2><div class="body" id="dir-body"></div>`;
 renderMarkdown(document.getElementById('dir-body'),l.content||'');
 if(opened)requestAnimationFrame(()=>cy.resize());});}
/* Two per-concept reads shared by the inspector and the files preview: the raw
   markdown body (rendered client-side) and the description fragment. Live they
   hit /node and /node/meta; under EMBED they resolve from the baked payload.
   Never memoized in server mode, so on-disk edits keep reflecting. */
function getNodeBody(id){if(EMBED)return Promise.resolve(EMBED.bodies[id]||'');return fetch(id+'.md').then(r=>r.ok?r.text():r.status===404?fetch(NODE_ENDPOINT+'?id='+encodeURIComponent(id)).then(r=>r.ok?r.text():''):'');}
function getNodeMeta(id){if(EMBED)return Promise.resolve(EMBED.meta[id]||'');if(OKF_CATALOG){for(var i=0;i<OKF_CATALOG.length;i++){if(OKF_CATALOG[i].id===id&&OKF_CATALOG[i].description)return Promise.resolve(OKF_CATALOG[i].description);}}return fetch(META_ENDPOINT+'?id='+encodeURIComponent(id)).then(r=>r.ok?r.text():'');}
function show(id){const n=byId[id];if(!n)return false;const ty=typeOf[id]||'Untyped';const c=color[ty]||'#64748b';
 shownId=id;const opened=openPanel();sideBody.scrollTop=0;
 sideBody.innerHTML=`<button type="button" class="type facet" data-focus-type="${esc(ty)}" title="Show only ${esc(ty)} in the graph"><span class="dot" style="background:${c}"></span>${esc(ty)}</button>
 <h2 class="title">${esc(n.title||id)}</h2><div class="desc loading" id="desc">loading…</div>
 <div class="tags">${(tagsOf[id]||[]).map(t=>`<button type="button" class="tag facet" data-focus-tag="${esc(t)}" title="Show only concepts tagged ${esc(t)}">${esc(t)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
 ${relList('Links to',outL[id])}${relList('Linked from',inL[id])}<div class="body" id="body"></div>`;
 sideBody.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(a=>a.onclick=()=>select(a.getAttribute('data-go')));
 /* Focus on the way in, clear on the way back out: the chip both sets the
    filter and undoes it, so the gesture never strands you in a filtered graph
    with the way back somewhere else. The inspected concept always carries the
    facet you clicked, so it survives its own filter and the panel stays on the
    concept you were reading — which is what makes the second click reachable. */
 sideBody.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-type]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
  const t=b.getAttribute('data-focus-type');typeFocused(t)?clearGraphFilter():focusGraphType(t);});
 sideBody.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-tag]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
  const t=b.getAttribute('data-focus-tag');tagFocused(t)?clearGraphFilter():focusGraphTag(t);});
 syncFacets();
 getNodeMeta(id).then(h=>{const d=document.getElementById('desc');if(d){d.innerHTML=h||'<span class="empty">no description</span>';d.classList.remove('loading');}}).catch(()=>{});
 const bodyEl=sideBody.querySelector('#body');
 getNodeBody(id).then(md=>{if(bodyEl.isConnected)renderMarkdown(bodyEl,md);}).catch(()=>{});
 return opened;}
/* One camera move per selection. When the click also opens the panel, the
   container is still animating (--side-w, .22s), so pan now and the debounced
   cy.resize() would shift the view again a moment later — the double movement.
   Instead wait for the panel to settle, resize once, then pan. cy.stop() first
   so rapid clicks replace the animation instead of queueing repeats. */
let centerTimer;
function centerOn(ele,delay){clearTimeout(centerTimer);
 const go=()=>{cy.resize();cy.stop();cy.animate({center:{eles:ele},duration:450,easing:'ease-in-out-cubic'});};
 if(delay)centerTimer=setTimeout(go,260);else{cy.stop();cy.animate({center:{eles:ele},duration:450,easing:'ease-in-out-cubic'});}}
function select(id){const ele=cy.getElementById(id);if(!ele.length)return;const opened=show(id);
 cy.elements().removeClass('hl').addClass('dim');const nb=ele.closedNeighborhood();nb.removeClass('dim');ele.addClass('hl');
 centerOn(ele,opened);
 try{if(decodeURIComponent((location.hash||'').slice(1))!==id)location.hash=encodeURIComponent(id);}catch(e){}}
cy.on('tap','node',e=>{const t=e.target;
 if(t.hasClass('dir'))return showDir(t.id().slice(DIR.length)||'.');
 if(t.isParent()){const a=t.id().indexOf('area::')===0?t.id().slice(6):null;return showDir(a&&a!=='(root)'?a:'.');}
 select(t.id());});
cy.on('tap',e=>{if(e.target===cy)cy.elements().removeClass('dim hl');});

/* ── graph filters (slide-over) ── */
const hiddenTypes=new Set(), activeTags=new Set(), activeAreas=new Set();
const searchInput=document.getElementById('search');
const q={graph:'',catalog:'',files:'',tags:''};
function applyGraphFilter(){const s=q.graph.toLowerCase();
 cy.nodes().forEach(n=>{if(n.isParent()||n.hasClass('dir'))return;const id=n.data('id');const t=typeOf[id]||'Untyped';const nt=tagsOf[id]||[];
  const hay=(n.data('title')+' '+t+' '+nt.join(' ')).toLowerCase();
  const m=(!s||hay.includes(s))&&!hiddenTypes.has(t)&&(activeTags.size===0||nt.some(x=>activeTags.has(x)))&&(activeAreas.size===0||activeAreas.has(areaOf(id)));
  n.style('display',m?'element':'none');});
 relaxZoom();}
function fbadge(){const c=hiddenTypes.size+activeTags.size+activeAreas.size;const b=document.getElementById('btn-filters');
 b.classList.toggle('on-filter',c>0);b.querySelector('.fbadge').textContent=c;ctlBadge();syncFacets();}
/* mirror the active view's tool state onto the ⚙ toggle — when the sheet is
   folded away on mobile, an active filter must still call out from the bar */
function ctlBadge(){const b=document.getElementById('btn-controls');if(!b)return;
 let c=0;
 if(view==='graph')c=hiddenTypes.size+activeTags.size+activeAreas.size;
 else if(view==='files'){try{c=(fileTypeCombo.get()?1:0)+(fileTagCombo.get()?1:0);}catch(err){}}
 b.classList.toggle('on-filter',c>0);b.querySelector('.fbadge').textContent=c;}
const ftypes=document.getElementById('ftypes'), ftags=document.getElementById('ftags'), fareas=document.getElementById('fareas');
const graphAreas=[...new Set(NODES.map(n=>areaOf(n.id)))].sort();
const areaCount={};NODES.forEach(n=>{const a=areaOf(n.id);areaCount[a]=(areaCount[a]||0)+1;});
const tagsByCount=Object.entries(TAGS).sort((a,b)=>b[1].length-a[1].length).map(e=>e[0]);
const dotFor=t=>`<span class="dot" style="background:${color[t]}"></span>`;
const toggleSet=(s,v)=>{s.has(v)?s.delete(v):s.add(v);};
/* One renderer for every filter chip group (graph, catalog and tags views):
   paints the items with their current state class and wires the toggle. */
function chipRow(el,items,attr,stateCls,isOn,onToggle){
 el.innerHTML=items.map(o=>`<span class="chip${isOn(o.v)?' '+stateCls:''}" ${attr}="${esc(o.v)}">${o.dot||''}${esc(o.v)} <span class="c">${o.n}</span></span>`).join('');
 el.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(ch=>ch.onclick=()=>onToggle(ch.getAttribute(attr)));}
const typeItems=list=>list.map(t=>({v:t,n:(TYPES[t]||[]).length,dot:dotFor(t)}));
const areaItems=list=>list.map(a=>({v:a,n:areaCount[a]}));
const tagItems=list=>list.map(t=>({v:t,n:(TAGS[t]||[]).length}));
/* The find box narrows the chips themselves; while it is empty, tags cap at the
   top 40 so a busy bundle doesn't flood the panel — searching reaches ALL tags. */
const fsearch=document.getElementById('filter-search');
function syncFilterChips(){const qq=fsearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();const match=v=>!qq||v.toLowerCase().includes(qq);
 const after=()=>{syncFilterChips();applyGraphFilter();fbadge();};
 chipRow(ftypes,typeItems(types.filter(match)),'data-t','off',t=>hiddenTypes.has(t),t=>{toggleSet(hiddenTypes,t);after();});
 chipRow(fareas,areaItems(graphAreas.filter(match)),'data-area','on',a=>activeAreas.has(a),a=>{toggleSet(activeAreas,a);after();});
 chipRow(ftags,tagItems(qq?tagsByCount.filter(match):tagsByCount.slice(0,40)),'data-tag','on',t=>activeTags.has(t),t=>{toggleSet(activeTags,t);after();});}
fsearch.oninput=syncFilterChips;
syncFilterChips();
// Fit the graph to the currently-visible nodes after a view swap settles (two rAFs
// so the container has resized), reusing the working fitGraph implementation.
function fitVisible(){requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(fitGraph));}
function focusGraphType(t){setView('graph');hiddenTypes.clear();activeTags.clear();activeAreas.clear();types.forEach(x=>{if(x!==t)hiddenTypes.add(x);});syncFilterChips();applyGraphFilter();fbadge();fitVisible();}
function focusGraphArea(a){setView('graph');hiddenTypes.clear();activeTags.clear();activeAreas.clear();activeAreas.add(a);syncFilterChips();applyGraphFilter();fbadge();fitVisible();}
function focusGraphTag(t){setView('graph');hiddenTypes.clear();activeTags.clear();activeAreas.clear();activeTags.add(t);syncFilterChips();applyGraphFilter();fbadge();fitVisible();}
function clearGraphFilter(){hiddenTypes.clear();activeTags.clear();activeAreas.clear();syncFilterChips();applyGraphFilter();fbadge();fitVisible();}
/* Is the graph focused on exactly this facet and nothing else? Only then is a
   second click on the chip an undo — with any other filter in play, clearing
   would throw away more than the click put there, so the chip re-focuses
   instead. This is also what lights the chip, so what you see and what the
   next click does are the same question, asked once. */
/* hiddenTypes.size>0 is not redundant: in a one-type bundle `types.length-1` is
   zero, so an unfiltered graph would read as focused, light the chip, and spend
   the first click clearing nothing. */
function typeFocused(t){return !activeTags.size&&!activeAreas.size&&hiddenTypes.size>0&&hiddenTypes.size===types.length-1&&!hiddenTypes.has(t);}
function tagFocused(t){return !hiddenTypes.size&&!activeAreas.size&&activeTags.size===1&&activeTags.has(t);}
/* The chips are filter indicators, so they repaint wherever the badge does —
   that way a filter cleared from the slide-over un-lights the chip too. */
function syncFacets(){
 sideBody.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-type]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',typeFocused(b.getAttribute('data-focus-type'))));
 sideBody.querySelectorAll('[data-focus-tag]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',tagFocused(b.getAttribute('data-focus-tag'))));}
const filtersEl=document.getElementById('filters');
document.getElementById('btn-filters').onclick=()=>filtersEl.classList.toggle('open');
document.getElementById('filters-close').onclick=()=>filtersEl.classList.remove('open');
document.getElementById('filters-reset').onclick=()=>{hiddenTypes.clear();activeTags.clear();activeAreas.clear();syncFilterChips();applyGraphFilter();fbadge();};

/* ── layout: 5 built-ins + extension layouts loaded lazily on first use ── */
const layoutSel=document.getElementById('layout');
const LAYOUT_EXT={
 fcose:{srcs:['https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/layout-base@2.0.1/layout-base.js','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cose-base@2.2.0/cose-base.js','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape-fcose@2.2.0/cytoscape-fcose.js'],reg:'cytoscapeFcose'},
 dagre:{srcs:['https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dagre@0.8.5/dist/dagre.min.js','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape-dagre@2.5.0/cytoscape-dagre.min.js'],reg:'cytoscapeDagre'},
 cola:{srcs:['https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/webcola@3.4.0/WebCola/cola.min.js','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape-cola@2.5.1/cytoscape-cola.min.js'],reg:'cytoscapeCola'}
};
const loadedExt={};
function loadScript(src){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const s=document.createElement('script');s.src=src;s.onload=res;s.onerror=()=>rej(new Error(src));document.head.appendChild(s);});}
async function ensureLayout(name){const ext=LAYOUT_EXT[name];if(!ext||loadedExt[name])return true;
 try{for(const src of ext.srcs)await loadScript(src);cytoscape.use(window[ext.reg]);loadedExt[name]=true;return true;}
 catch(e){console.warn('layout '+name+' failed to load',e);return false;}}
/* Labels count as part of a node's footprint (nodeDimensionsIncludeLabels) —
   the captions here run 3-6x wider than the circles, so spacing by the circle
   alone stacked every caption onto its neighbours. Edge lengths follow the same
   ruler: an ideal length shorter than a label's box (wrap at 120px) *instructs*
   linked nodes to overlap, so the force layouts ask for ~170 between centres —
   the footprint plus a gap, no more (240 read as wasteland). nodeOverlap
   keeps a real gap between boxes in cose; avoidOverlap + spacingFactor do the
   same for the geometric layouts. Extras are ignored by layouts that don't know
   them. */
function layoutOpts(name){const base={animate:true,padding:40,nodeOverlap:24,avoidOverlap:true,spacingFactor:1.2,nodeDimensionsIncludeLabels:true};
 if(name==='fcose')return{...base,name:'fcose',quality:'default',nodeRepulsion:6500,idealEdgeLength:160,nodeSeparation:100,packComponents:true};
 if(name==='dagre')return{...base,name:'dagre',rankDir:'TB',nodeSep:26,rankSep:55,edgeSep:12};
 if(name==='cola')return{...base,name:'cola',maxSimulationTime:2500,edgeLength:160,nodeSpacing:8};
 if(name==='cose')return{...base,name:'cose',nodeRepulsion:9000,idealEdgeLength:170};
 return{...base,name};}
async function runLayout(name){name=okfSafeLayout(name);if(await ensureLayout(name))cy.layout(layoutOpts(name)).run();else layoutSel.value='concentric';}
layoutSel.onchange=e=>{if(clustered)return;runLayout(e.target.value);};
layoutSel.value='concentric';

/* ── cluster by area (compound parent nodes) ── */
let clustered=false;const btnCluster=document.getElementById('btn-cluster');
/* cose treats compounds as an afterthought — nodes with no links drift to
   opposite corners of a huge half-empty box, and the boxes themselves sprawl —
   so grouped views needed hand-tidying every time. fcose is the engine built
   for compound graphs: tiling packs the loose nodes inside each area into neat
   rows, compound gravity keeps every box tight, and label-aware sizing stops
   captions from overlapping. Clustering therefore always uses it, with cose
   kept only for when the CDN is unreachable (a saved render opened offline
   still groups, just less prettily). */
function clusterLayout(){if(NODES.length>1200){okfToast('Cluster view needs a smaller graph ('+NODES.length+' nodes) — showing concentric');cy.layout(layoutOpts('concentric')).run();return;}ensureLayout('fcose').then(ok=>{if(!clustered)return;
 cy.layout(ok?{name:'fcose',quality:'proof',animate:true,padding:40,nodeRepulsion:6500,idealEdgeLength:90,
   nodeSeparation:100,nestingFactor:.1,gravityCompound:1.5,tile:true,tilingPaddingVertical:14,
   tilingPaddingHorizontal:14,packComponents:true,nodeDimensionsIncludeLabels:true}
  :{name:'cose',animate:true,padding:40,nodeRepulsion:8000,idealEdgeLength:70,nodeOverlap:24,nestingFactor:1.2,gravity:.7}).run();});}
function setClustered(on){if(on===clustered)return;if(on&&treeMode)setTree(false);
 clustered=on;btnCluster.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));layoutSel.disabled=on;
 if(on){const as=[...new Set(NODES.map(n=>areaOf(n.id)))];
  cy.add(as.map(a=>({group:'nodes',data:{id:'area::'+a,label:a}})));
  cy.batch(()=>NODES.forEach(n=>{const e=cy.getElementById(n.id);if(e.length)e.move({parent:'area::'+areaOf(n.id)});}));
  clusterLayout();
 }else{
  cy.batch(()=>NODES.forEach(n=>{const e=cy.getElementById(n.id);if(e.length&&e.isChild())e.move({parent:null});}));
  cy.nodes().filter(n=>n.id().indexOf('area::')===0).remove();
  runLayout(layoutSel.value);}}
btnCluster.onclick=()=>setClustered(!clustered);

/* ── file-tree mode: folders become nodes and the only edges are folder→child,
   so the picture is the acyclic files-and-folders tree, not the link graph. ── */
let treeMode=false;const btnTree=document.getElementById('btn-tree');
const DIR='dir::';
function setTree(on){if(on===treeMode)return;if(on&&clustered)setClustered(false);
 treeMode=on;btnTree.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));layoutSel.disabled=on;btnCluster.disabled=on;
 if(on){
  const dirs=new Set(['']);
  NODES.forEach(n=>{const parts=n.id.split('/');for(let i=1;i<parts.length;i++)dirs.add(parts.slice(0,i).join('/'));});
  cy.batch(()=>{
   cy.add([...dirs].map(d=>({group:'nodes',classes:'dir',
    data:{id:DIR+d,title:d?d.split('/').pop()+'/':'/',c:cvar('--faint'),sz:d?20:28}})));
   [...dirs].forEach(d=>{if(!d)return;const p=d.split('/').slice(0,-1).join('/');
    cy.add({group:'edges',classes:'tree',data:{id:'tree::'+d,source:DIR+p,target:DIR+d}});});
   NODES.forEach(n=>{const p=n.id.split('/').slice(0,-1).join('/');
    cy.add({group:'edges',classes:'tree',data:{id:'tree::n::'+n.id,source:DIR+p,target:n.id}});});
   cy.edges().not('.tree').addClass('linkhid');
   cy.elements().removeClass('dim hl');});
  /* Layered tree: root on top, folders as branches, files as leaves.
     animate:false — the freshly added folder nodes have no positions yet, and
     an animated run from (0,0) is unreliable; cut to the tree and fit. */
  cy.layout({name:'breadthfirst',directed:true,roots:cy.getElementById(DIR),animate:false,padding:40,spacingFactor:1.6,avoidOverlap:true}).run();
  fitGraph();
 }else{
  cy.batch(()=>{cy.edges('.tree').remove();cy.nodes('.dir').remove();cy.edges().removeClass('linkhid');});
  runLayout(layoutSel.value);}}
btnTree.onclick=()=>setTree(!treeMode);
/* A reserved file's "Open in graph": switch to the file tree, select its
   folder node, and put the directory's map in the inspector. */
function openInTree(dir){setView('graph');setTree(true);
 showDir(dir);
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const ele=cy.getElementById(DIR+(dir==='.'?'':dir));if(!ele.length)return;
  cy.elements().removeClass('hl').addClass('dim');ele.closedNeighborhood().removeClass('dim');ele.addClass('hl');
  centerOn(ele,true);});}

/* ── fit to screen ── */
// cy.animate({fit:…}) is a no-op in this Cytoscape build, so compute the target
// zoom + pan and animate those (which do work): fits the visible nodes, re-centered.
/* What "everything" spans, for both the fit button and the zoom floor: the
   visible leaves plus the area boxes drawn around them. A compound parent is
   26px of padding wider than its children on every side and carries its label
   above that, so fitting to the children alone crops the boxes and their names
   off the edges. A parent whose children are all filtered out is left out too —
   it collapses to a stale box that would inflate the fit. */
function fitBox(){const vis=cy.nodes(':visible');
 const eles=vis.filter(n=>!n.isParent()).union(vis.filter(n=>n.isParent()&&n.children(':visible').nonempty()));
 const use=eles.length?eles:cy.nodes();
 return use.length?use.boundingBox():null;}

/* Keep the zoom floor at or below what showing the whole graph needs, so no
   graph can grow past the point where it is reachable. Runs after every layout
   (which is what moves nodes) and after filtering, which can shrink the span
   back — the Math.min against MIN_ZOOM restores the normal floor for a small
   result rather than leaving it stuck at the big graph's. */
function relaxZoom(){const bb=fitBox(),w=cy.width(),h=cy.height();
 if(!bb||!bb.w||!bb.h||!w||!h)return;
 cy.minZoom(Math.min(MIN_ZOOM,Math.min(w/bb.w,h/bb.h)*.6));}
// The boot layout runs inside the cytoscape() constructor, so its layoutstop is
// already gone by the time this binds — relax once here for the graph on screen,
// and let the handler take every layout after it.
cy.on('layoutstop',relaxZoom);relaxZoom();

function fitGraph(){relaxZoom();const bb=fitBox();if(!bb)return;
 /* padding scales with the canvas — 60px is right on a desktop but eats a third
    of a phone's width */
 const w=cy.width(),h=cy.height(),pad=Math.min(60,Math.max(16,Math.round(w*.06)));
 const z=Math.max(cy.minZoom(),Math.min(cy.maxZoom(),Math.min((w-2*pad)/bb.w,(h-2*pad)/bb.h)));
 cy.stop();cy.animate({zoom:z,pan:{x:w/2-z*(bb.x1+bb.w/2),y:h/2-z*(bb.y1+bb.h/2)}},{duration:450,easing:'ease-in-out-cubic'});}
document.getElementById('btn-fit').onclick=fitGraph;

/* ── view switching ── */
let view='graph';
const inited={};
/* Which views have a search, and what it is called there — one table, because
   three things need the same answer: the placeholder, whether `/` has anywhere
   to go, and (mirrored in CSS) whether the box is shown at all. Stats is the
   only view absent here: it reads, it does not filter. */
const SEARCH_PH={graph:'search concepts…',catalog:'search concepts…',files:'filter files…',tags:'search tags…'};
function goToGraph(id){setView('graph');requestAnimationFrame(()=>select(id));}
function setView(v){if(v===view)return;view=v;document.getElementById('app').setAttribute('data-view',v);
 railActive();ctlBadge();
 document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('active',s.id==='view-'+v));
 const ph=SEARCH_PH[v];
 if(ph!==undefined){searchInput.placeholder=ph;searchInput.value=q[v]||'';}
 if(v==='graph')requestAnimationFrame(()=>cy.resize());
 if(v==='catalog'&&!inited.catalog)initCatalog();
 if(v==='files'&&!inited.files)initFiles();
 if(v==='tags'&&!inited.tags)initTags();
 if(v==='stats'&&!inited.stats)initStats();}
/* The Files view answers to two rail items: Files when the Files tab is up,
   Index when the Indexes tab is — the Index rail item is a shortcut into it. */
/* Which rail item the page is standing on. "index" is not a view — there is no
   #view-index — but the files view showing its Indexes tab, so the answer is a
   question of view *and* tab. Everything that has to name the current place
   asks here: the rail's own highlight, and the palette's `current` badge. */
function activeRail(){return view==='files'&&typeof ftab!=='undefined'&&ftab==='indexes'?'index':view;}
/* And everything that has to *go* somewhere clicks the rail item rather than
   calling setView: Index and Files are one view differing by tab, so setView
   alone lands on whichever tab was last open — and for "index" it lands on a
   view that does not exist. The rail button already gets this right; this is
   how the keyboard and the palette borrow it instead of drifting from it. */
function goRail(v){const b=document.querySelector('.rail-item[data-view="'+v+'"]');if(b)b.click();}
function railActive(){const v=activeRail();
 document.querySelectorAll('.rail-item').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===v));}
function goIndexes(){if(view!=='files')setView('files');setFtab('indexes');railActive();}
document.querySelectorAll('.rail-item').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
 if(b.dataset.view==='index')return goIndexes();
 if(b.dataset.view==='files'&&typeof ftab!=='undefined'&&ftab!=='files'){if(view!=='files')setView('files');setFtab('files');railActive();return;}
 setView(b.dataset.view);});
searchInput.oninput=()=>{q[view]=searchInput.value;
 if(view==='graph')applyGraphFilter();else if(view==='catalog')renderCatalog();else if(view==='tags')renderCloud();
 else if(view==='files')refreshTree();};

/* ── catalog ── */
let CATALOG=null;
function getCatalog(){return CATALOG||(CATALOG=okfCatalogFetch());}
const catActiveTypes=new Set(), catActiveAreas=new Set(), catActiveTags=new Set();
const catByCount=types.slice().sort((a,b)=>(TYPES[b]||[]).length-(TYPES[a]||[]).length);
const catChip=t=>`<span class="chip" data-t="${esc(t)}"><span class="dot" style="background:${color[t]}"></span>${esc(t)} <span class="c">${(TYPES[t]||[]).length}</span></span>`;
function syncCatChips(){document.querySelectorAll('#cat-types .chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('on',catActiveTypes.has(c.getAttribute('data-t'))));
 const n=catActiveTypes.size+catActiveAreas.size+catActiveTags.size;
 const b=document.getElementById('cat-filters-btn');b.classList.toggle('on-filter',n>0);b.querySelector('.fbadge').textContent=n;}
function catToggle(t){toggleSet(catActiveTypes,t);renderCatFilters();renderCatalog();}
function wireCatChips(el){el.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(ch=>ch.onclick=()=>catToggle(ch.getAttribute('data-t')));}
/* The slide-over mirrors the graph filters — Types, Areas, Tags — with one find
   box narrowing the chips of all three groups (tags cap at 40 until searched). */
function renderCatFilters(){const qq=(document.getElementById('cat-filter-search').value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
 const match=v=>!qq||v.toLowerCase().includes(qq);
 const after=()=>{renderCatFilters();renderCatalog();};
 chipRow(document.getElementById('cat-ftypes'),typeItems(catByCount.filter(match)),'data-t','on',t=>catActiveTypes.has(t),t=>{toggleSet(catActiveTypes,t);after();});
 chipRow(document.getElementById('cat-fareas'),areaItems(graphAreas.filter(match)),'data-area','on',a=>catActiveAreas.has(a),a=>{toggleSet(catActiveAreas,a);after();});
 chipRow(document.getElementById('cat-ftags'),tagItems(qq?tagsByCount.filter(match):tagsByCount.slice(0,40)),'data-tag','on',t=>catActiveTags.has(t),t=>{toggleSet(catActiveTags,t);after();});
 syncCatChips();}
function initCatalog(){inited.catalog=true;
 // Only the five most common types get inline chips; everything else — types,
 // areas, tags — lives in the searchable slide-over, so a bundle with many
 // values doesn't flood the header.
 const quick=document.getElementById('cat-types');quick.innerHTML=catByCount.slice(0,5).map(catChip).join('');wireCatChips(quick);
 renderCatFilters();
 const cf=document.getElementById('cat-filters');
 document.getElementById('cat-filters-btn').onclick=()=>cf.classList.toggle('open');
 document.getElementById('cat-filters-close').onclick=()=>cf.classList.remove('open');
 document.getElementById('cat-filters-reset').onclick=()=>{catActiveTypes.clear();catActiveAreas.clear();catActiveTags.clear();renderCatFilters();renderCatalog();};
 document.getElementById('cat-filter-search').oninput=renderCatFilters;
 getCatalog().then(renderCatalog);}
function renderCatalog(){if(!CATALOG)return;getCatalog().then(list=>{const s=(q.catalog||'').toLowerCase();
 const rows=list.filter(c=>{if(catActiveTypes.size&&!catActiveTypes.has(c.type))return false;
  if(catActiveAreas.size&&!catActiveAreas.has(areaOf(c.id)))return false;
  if(catActiveTags.size&&!c.tags.some(t=>catActiveTags.has(t)))return false;
  if(s){const hay=(c.title+' '+c.description+' '+c.type+' '+c.tags.join(' ')+' '+c.id).toLowerCase();if(!hay.includes(s))return false;}return true;});
 document.getElementById('cat-cnt').textContent=rows.length+' of '+list.length+' concepts';
 const g=document.getElementById('cat-grid');
 if(!rows.length){g.innerHTML='<div class="none">No concepts match — try clearing the filters.</div>';return;}
 g.innerHTML=rows.map(c=>{const cc=color[c.type]||'#64748b';
  const st=c.status?`<span class="status ${c.status==='shipped'?'shipped':''}">${esc(c.status)}</span>`:'';
  const tags=c.tags.slice(0,4).map(t=>`<span class="tag">${esc(t)}</span>`).join('');
  const ts=c.timestamp?`<span class="mini">⌂ ${esc(c.timestamp)}</span>`:'';
  const lk=(c.links_out+c.links_in)?`<span class="mini links">↳ ${c.links_out+c.links_in} links</span>`:'';
  return `<article class="card" tabindex="0" data-id="${esc(c.id)}">
   <div class="r1"><span class="badge"><span class="dot" style="background:${cc}"></span>${esc(c.type)}</span>${st}<span class="area">${esc(c.dir)}/</span></div>
   <h3>${esc(c.title)}</h3><p class="cd">${esc(c.description)||'<span class="empty">No description.</span>'}</p>
   <div class="cm">${tags}${ts}${lk}</div></article>`;}).join('');
 g.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(el=>{const id=el.dataset.id;el.onclick=()=>goToGraph(id);
  el.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();goToGraph(id);}};});});}

/* ── files ── */
let fileSel=null;
function initFiles(){inited.files=true;refreshTree();}
/* The tree column has two tabs. Files: the per-directory concept groups,
   foldable. Indexes: the authored layer flat — the log first (it is the
   chronological index), then every index.md, root before nested. Reserved
   files come from the /index and /log payloads — they are not concepts, so
   the catalog cannot know them. */
let IXDIRS=null,LOGPATHS=null,ftab='files';
const collapsedDirs=new Set();
function dirOfPath(p){return p.indexOf('/')<0?'.':p.split('/').slice(0,-1).join('/');}
function renderTree(list){const s=(q.files||'').toLowerCase();
 const el=document.getElementById('ftree-list');
 if(ftab==='indexes'){
  const reserved=[];
  (LOGPATHS||[]).forEach(p=>{if(!s||p.toLowerCase().includes(s))reserved.push({kind:'log',path:p});});
  (IXDIRS||[]).forEach(d=>{if(d.present&&(!s||d.index_path.toLowerCase().includes(s)))reserved.push({kind:'index',path:d.index_path});});
  const rank=r=>[ r.kind==='log'?0:1, r.path.indexOf('/')<0?0:1, r.path ];
  reserved.sort((a,b)=>{const x=rank(a),y=rank(b);return (x[0]-y[0])||(x[1]-y[1])||(x[2]<y[2]?-1:1);});
  if(!reserved.length){el.innerHTML='<p class="empty" style="padding:14px">No index.md or log.md files'+(s?' match.':' yet.')+'</p>';return;}
  el.innerHTML=reserved.map(r=>{
   const icon=r.kind==='index'?'<path d="M4 5h16M4 9.6h10.5M4 14.2h16M4 18.8h7.5"/>':'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M12 7.3V12l3.2 2"/>';
   return `<button class="file res${fileSel===r.path?' sel':''}" data-res="${r.kind}" data-path="${esc(r.path)}" title="${esc(r.path)}"><span class="fn"><svg class="ricon" viewBox="0 0 24 24">${icon}</svg><span class="rn">${esc(r.path)}</span><span class="badge-res">${r.kind==='index'?'map':'log'}</span></span></button>`;}).join('');
  el.querySelectorAll('.file[data-res]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openReserved(b.dataset.res,b.dataset.path));
  return;}
 const ft=fileTypeCombo.get(), fg=fileTagCombo.get();
 const rows=list.filter(c=>(!ft||c.type===ft)&&(!fg||c.tags.indexOf(fg)>=0)&&(!s||(c.title+' '+c.id+' '+c.description).toLowerCase().includes(s)));
 const groups={};rows.forEach(c=>{(groups[c.dir]=groups[c.dir]||[]).push(c);});
 const dirs=Object.keys(groups).sort();
 if(!dirs.length){el.innerHTML='<p class="empty" style="padding:14px">No files match.</p>';return;}
 const filtering=!!(s||ft||fg);
 el.innerHTML=dirs.map(dir=>{
  const closed=!filtering&&collapsedDirs.has(dir);
  const head=`<button class="ffolder${closed?' closed':''}" data-dir="${esc(dir)}"><svg class="chev" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>${dir==='.'?'(root)':esc(dir)+'/'}</button>`;
  if(closed)return head;
  return head+(groups[dir]||[]).map(c=>{const cc=color[c.type]||'#64748b';const name=c.id.split('/').pop()+'.md';
   return `<button class="file${fileSel===c.id?' sel':''}" data-id="${esc(c.id)}"><span class="fn"><span class="dot" style="background:${cc}"></span>${esc(name)}</span>${c.description?`<span class="fd">${esc(c.description)}</span>`:''}</button>`;}).join('');}).join('');
 el.querySelectorAll('.ffolder').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const d=b.dataset.dir;
  if(collapsedDirs.has(d))collapsedDirs.delete(d);else collapsedDirs.add(d);renderTree(list);});
 el.querySelectorAll('.file[data-id]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openFile(b.dataset.id,list));}
function setFtab(t){if(ftab===t)return;
 ftab=t;document.getElementById('app').setAttribute('data-ftab',t);
 [ 'files','indexes' ].forEach(x=>{const b=document.getElementById('ftab-'+x);
  b.classList.toggle('active',x===t);b.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(x===t));});
 railActive();refreshTree();}
[ 'files','indexes' ].forEach(t=>{document.getElementById('ftab-'+t).onclick=()=>setFtab(t);});
/* Searchable single-select combobox (keyboard-navigable) — one per files filter:
   type and tag. `items` is lazy so counts always reflect the current indexes. */
function makeCombo(name,allLabel,items,onChange){
 const combo=document.getElementById(name+'-combo'), input=document.getElementById(name+'-input'), list=document.getElementById(name+'-list');
 let value=null, active=-1;
 function options(qq){qq=(qq||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  return [{all:true,label:allLabel,n:NODES.length}].concat(items().filter(o=>!qq||o.v.toLowerCase().includes(qq)));}
 function render(qq){list.innerHTML=options(qq).map(o=>{const sel=(o.all&&value===null)||(!o.all&&o.v===value);
   const sw=o.c?`<span class="sw" style="background:${o.c}"></span>`:'';const attr=o.all?'data-all="1"':`data-v="${esc(o.v)}"`;
   return `<li role="option" ${attr} class="opt${sel?' sel':''}">${sw}<span>${esc(o.all?o.label:o.v)}</span><span class="c">${o.n}</span></li>`;}).join('');active=-1;}
 function open(){render(input.value===(value||'')?'':input.value);list.hidden=false;input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');}
 function close(){list.hidden=true;input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');active=-1;}
 function pick(li){if(!li)return;value=li.dataset.all?null:li.dataset.v;input.value=value||'';combo.classList.toggle('has',!!value);close();onChange();}
 input.addEventListener('focus',open);
 input.addEventListener('input',()=>{render(input.value.trim().toLowerCase());list.hidden=false;input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');});
 input.addEventListener('blur',()=>setTimeout(()=>{close();input.value=value||'';},130));
 input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const lis=[...list.querySelectorAll('li')];
  if(e.key==='ArrowDown'){e.preventDefault();if(list.hidden)open();active=Math.min(lis.length-1,active+1);}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();active=Math.max(0,active-1);}
  else if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();pick(lis[active]||lis[0]);input.blur();return;}
  else if(e.key==='Escape'){close();input.value=value||'';input.blur();return;}
  else return;
  lis.forEach((l,i)=>l.classList.toggle('active',i===active));if(lis[active])lis[active].scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});});
 list.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{const li=e.target.closest('li');if(!li)return;e.preventDefault();pick(li);});
 document.getElementById(name+'-clear').addEventListener('click',()=>{value=null;input.value='';combo.classList.remove('has');onChange();input.focus();});
 return {get:()=>value};}
const refreshTree=()=>{ctlBadge();return Promise.all([ getCatalog(),getIndex(),getLogs() ]).then(([ list,dirs,logs ])=>{IXDIRS=dirs;LOGPATHS=logs.map(l=>l.path);renderTree(list);});};
const fileTypeCombo=makeCombo('file-type','All types',()=>catByCount.map(t=>({v:t,n:(TYPES[t]||[]).length,c:color[t]})),refreshTree);
const fileTagCombo=makeCombo('file-tag','All tags',()=>tagsByCount.map(t=>({v:t,n:(TAGS[t]||[]).length})),refreshTree);
function openFile(id,list){fileSel=id;const c=(list||[]).find(x=>x.id===id)||byId[id]||{};
 setFtab('files');
 document.querySelectorAll('.file').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel',b.dataset.id===id));
 const ty=c.type||typeOf[id]||'Untyped';const cc=color[ty]||'#64748b';
 document.getElementById('fp-head').hidden=false;
 document.getElementById('fp-type').innerHTML=`<span class="dot" style="background:${cc}"></span>${esc(ty)}`;
 document.getElementById('fp-title').textContent=c.title||(byId[id]||{}).title||id;
 document.getElementById('fp-graph').hidden=false;
 document.getElementById('fp-graph').onclick=()=>goToGraph(id);
 const body=document.getElementById('fp-body');body.innerHTML='<p class="loading">loading…</p>';
 getNodeBody(id).then(txt=>{
  const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='body';renderMarkdown(wrap,txt);body.innerHTML='';body.appendChild(wrap);}).catch(()=>{body.innerHTML='<p class="empty">could not load this file</p>';});}
/* Reserved files read in the preview too: the index map from its payload, the
   log fetched fresh on every click so a just-appended entry shows. */
function openReserved(kind,path){fileSel=path;
 setFtab('indexes');
 document.querySelectorAll('.file').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel',b.dataset.path===path));
 document.getElementById('fp-head').hidden=false;
 document.getElementById('fp-title').textContent=path;
 const fg=document.getElementById('fp-graph');
 fg.hidden=false;fg.onclick=()=>openInTree(dirOfPath(path));
 const type=document.getElementById('fp-type');
 const body=document.getElementById('fp-body');body.innerHTML='<p class="loading">loading…</p>';
 const done=txt=>{const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='body';renderMarkdown(wrap,txt);body.innerHTML='';body.appendChild(wrap);};
 if(kind==='index')getIndex().then(dirs=>{const d=dirs.find(x=>x.dir===dirOfPath(path));
  type.textContent=d&&d.synthesized?'directory index · synthesized':'directory index · §6';
  if(d&&d.synthesized){body.innerHTML='<div class="body">'+listingHtml(d.listing)+'</div>';
   body.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>openFile(x.getAttribute('data-go')));}
  else done((d&&d.body)||'');});
 else{type.textContent='update log · §7';
  LOGS=null;getLogs().then(logs=>{const l=logs.find(x=>x.path===path);done((l&&l.content)||'');});}}

/* ── tags ── */
const tagSel=new Set(), tagTypes=new Set(), tagAreas=new Set();
/* Does this concept survive the tags view's type/area filters? Tags are counted
   and listed over the surviving concepts only; a tag left with none disappears. */
function tagMatch(id){return (tagTypes.size===0||tagTypes.has(typeOf[id]||'Untyped'))&&(tagAreas.size===0||tagAreas.has(areaOf(id)));}
function renderTagChips(){
 const after=()=>{renderTagChips();renderCloud();};
 chipRow(document.getElementById('tag-ftypes'),typeItems(types),'data-t','on',t=>tagTypes.has(t),t=>{toggleSet(tagTypes,t);after();});
 chipRow(document.getElementById('tag-fareas'),areaItems(graphAreas),'data-area','on',a=>tagAreas.has(a),a=>{toggleSet(tagAreas,a);after();});
 const n=tagTypes.size+tagAreas.size;const b=document.getElementById('tag-filters-btn');
 b.classList.toggle('on-filter',n>0);b.querySelector('.fbadge').textContent=n;}
function initTags(){inited.tags=true;
 const tf=document.getElementById('tag-filters');
 document.getElementById('tag-filters-btn').onclick=()=>tf.classList.toggle('open');
 document.getElementById('tag-filters-close').onclick=()=>tf.classList.remove('open');
 document.getElementById('tag-filters-reset').onclick=()=>{tagTypes.clear();tagAreas.clear();renderTagChips();renderCloud();};
 renderTagChips();renderCloud();}
function renderCloud(){const s=(q.tags||'').toLowerCase();
 // Uniform chip size, ordered by frequency (descending); the background tint scales
 // with occurrence count (a heatmap), ties keep insertion order. Max is over every
 // surviving tag so the scale stays stable while searching.
 const counted=Object.entries(TAGS).map(([t,ids])=>[t,ids.filter(tagMatch)]).filter(([,ids])=>ids.length>0);
 const entries=counted.filter(([t])=>!s||t.toLowerCase().includes(s)).sort((a,b)=>b[1].length-a[1].length);
 const max=Math.max(1,...counted.map(([,ids])=>ids.length));
 const total=Object.keys(TAGS).length;
 document.getElementById('tag-cnt').textContent=(counted.length===total?total:counted.length+' of '+total)+' distinct tags';
 const el=document.getElementById('tag-cloud');
 el.innerHTML=entries.map(([t,ids])=>
  `<button class="tcloud${tagSel.has(t)?' on':''}" data-tag="${esc(t)}" style="--heat:${(6+ids.length/max*36).toFixed(0)}%">${esc(t)}<b>${ids.length}</b></button>`).join('');
 el.querySelectorAll('.tcloud').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const t=b.dataset.tag;
  if(tagSel.has(t))tagSel.delete(t);else tagSel.add(t);b.classList.toggle('on');renderTagDetail();});
 renderTagDetail();}
function renderTagDetail(){const el=document.getElementById('tag-detail');
 if(!tagSel.size){el.innerHTML='<p class="empty">Select a tag to see the concepts that carry it.</p>';return;}
 const ids=[...new Set([...tagSel].flatMap(t=>(TAGS[t]||[]).filter(tagMatch)))].sort();
 el.innerHTML=`<div class="shead" style="margin-top:6px"><h2>${[...tagSel].map(esc).join(' · ')}</h2><span class="cnt">${ids.length} concepts</span></div>
  <div class="tlist">${ids.map(id=>{const ty=typeOf[id]||'Untyped';const cc=color[ty]||'#64748b';
   return `<button class="titem" data-id="${esc(id)}"><span class="dot" style="background:${cc}"></span><span class="tt">${esc((byId[id]||{}).title||id)}</span><span class="ty">${esc(ty)}</span></button>`;}).join('')}</div>`;
 el.querySelectorAll('.titem').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>goToGraph(b.dataset.id));}

/* ── stats ── */
function countUp(el,to){if(reduce()||to<=8){el.textContent=to;return;}let start=null;
 function step(ts){if(!start)start=ts;const p=Math.min(1,(ts-start)/650);el.textContent=Math.round(to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3)));if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);}
 requestAnimationFrame(step);}
function initStats(){inited.stats=true;
 const areas=new Set(NODES.map(n=>areaOf(n.id)));
 const stats=[['Concepts',NODES.length],['Areas',areas.size],['Concept types',types.length],['Cross-links',EDGES.length],['Distinct tags',Object.keys(TAGS).length]];
 const g=document.getElementById('stat-grid');
 g.innerHTML=stats.map(s=>`<div class="stat"><div class="n" data-to="${s[1]}">0</div><div class="l">${s[0]}</div></div>`).join('');
 g.querySelectorAll('.n').forEach(el=>countUp(el,+el.dataset.to));
 const byType=Object.entries(TYPES).map(([t,ids])=>[t,ids.length]).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
 const areaCnt={};NODES.forEach(n=>{const a=areaOf(n.id);areaCnt[a]=(areaCnt[a]||0)+1;});
 const byArea=Object.entries(areaCnt).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
 renderBars('bars-type',byType,t=>color[t],'type');renderBars('bars-area',byArea,()=>cvar('--accent'),'area');}
function renderBars(id,rows,colFn,kind){const max=Math.max(1,...rows.map(r=>r[1]));const box=document.getElementById(id);
 box.innerHTML=rows.map(([l,v])=>
  `<div class="bar clickable" data-val="${esc(l)}" role="button" tabindex="0" title="Show ${esc(l)} in the graph"><span class="bl">${esc(l)}</span><div class="bt"><div class="bf" style="background:${colFn(l)};transform:scaleX(${reduce()?1:0})" data-w="${v/max}"></div></div><span class="bv">${v}</span></div>`).join('');
 box.querySelectorAll('.bar').forEach(b=>{const go=()=>{const val=b.dataset.val;kind==='type'?focusGraphType(val):focusGraphArea(val);};
  b.onclick=go;b.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();go();}};});
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>box.querySelectorAll('.bf').forEach(f=>f.style.transform=`scaleX(${f.dataset.w})`));}

/* ── theme / fullscreen ── */
const btnTheme=document.getElementById('btn-theme');
function setTheme(t){root.setAttribute('data-theme',t);try{localStorage.setItem('okf-theme',t);}catch(e){}
 btnTheme.setAttribute('aria-label',t==='dark'?'Switch to light theme':'Switch to dark theme');applyCyTheme();rethemeMermaid();}
btnTheme.onclick=()=>setTheme(isDark()?'light':'dark');
const appEl=document.getElementById('app'), btnFull=document.getElementById('btn-full');
const fsOn=()=>document.fullscreenElement===appEl;
btnFull.onclick=()=>{if(fsOn())document.exitFullscreen();else if(appEl.requestFullscreen)appEl.requestFullscreen();};
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',()=>btnFull.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(fsOn())));

/* ── the §6 map payload — feeds folder clicks, the Indexes tab, and previews ── */
let INDEX=null;
function getIndex(){return INDEX||(INDEX=EMBED?Promise.resolve(EMBED.index):fetch('index.json',{cache:'no-cache'}).then(r=>r.ok?r.json():{directories:[]}).then(d=>Array.isArray(d)?d:(d&&Array.isArray(d.directories)?d.directories:[])).catch(function(){return [];}));}
function listingHtml(items){if(!items||!items.length)return '<p class="empty" style="margin:10px 0 0">No concepts directly here.</p>';
 return '<ul class="ix-listing">'+items.map(it=>`<li><a data-go="${esc(it.id)}">${esc(it.title||it.id)}</a>${it.description?` <span class="d">— ${esc(it.description)}</span>`:''}</li>`).join('')+'</ul>';}

/* ── log payload (the §7 history) — read by the Files view's log entries ── */
let LOGS=null;
function getLogs(){return LOGS||(LOGS=EMBED?Promise.resolve(EMBED.logs):fetch('log.json',{cache:'no-cache'}).then(r=>r.ok?r.json():{logs:[]}).then(d=>Array.isArray(d)?d:(d&&Array.isArray(d.logs)?d.logs:[])).catch(function(){return [];}));}

/* ── command palette: jump to a view always, and to a sibling bundle when a hub
   is serving one. It began as the bundle switcher, gated on HUB_PATH — which
   meant ⌘K did not exist at all under a standalone `okf server` or in `okf
   render` output, the two modes most people meet first. Views are what earn the
   palette a place in every mode; bundles are the group that comes and goes.
   The two are grouped rather than merged because the actions differ: a view is
   in-page and instant, a bundle is a page load that carries the view and layout
   across and deliberately drops the selected node. ── */
(function(){
 const ov=document.getElementById('sw'),input=document.getElementById('sw-input'),list=document.getElementById('sw-list');
 const isMac=/Mac|iP/.test(navigator.platform||'');
 const layout0=layoutSel?layoutSel.value:null;
 const HUB=HUB_PATH!==null;
 let active=0,lastFocus=null;
 /* The rail is the source of truth for which views exist, so read it back
    rather than keeping a second list here that a new view could fall out of. */
 const VIEWS=[ ...document.querySelectorAll('.rail-item[data-view]') ].map(b=>{
  const l=b.querySelector('.ri-lbl'), ic=b.querySelector('.ri-ico');
  /* The icon comes from the rail with the label, so a view wears the same mark
     in both places and neither can drift from the other. It is this page's own
     static markup being copied within the page — not a body, not a payload — so
     it is not a render path the sanitizer has to cover. */
  return { v:b.getAttribute('data-view'), label:(l?l.textContent:'').trim()||b.getAttribute('data-view'), icon:ic?ic.innerHTML:'' };});
 /* the current bundle's display name — the topbar carries it already */
 const identEl=document.querySelector('#topbar .ident');
 const IDENT=identEl&&identEl.firstChild?identEl.firstChild.textContent.trim():(SELF_SLUG||'this bundle');
 const hit=(q,s)=>String(s||'').toLowerCase().includes(q);
 const matchViews=q=>VIEWS.filter(x=>!q||hit(q,x.label)||hit(q,x.v));
 const matchBundles=q=>HUB?SIBLINGS.filter(b=>!q||hit(q,b.title)||hit(q,b.slug)):[];
 /* carry the bundle-agnostic page state (view, layout) into the target — the
    selected node and hash are bundle-specific and deliberately dropped */
 function target(p){const ps=new URLSearchParams();
  try{if(typeof view==='string'&&view!=='graph')ps.set('view',view);
   if(layoutSel&&layoutSel.value!==layout0)ps.set('layout',layoutSel.value);}catch(err){}
  const qs=ps.toString();return qs?p+'?'+qs:p;}
 const grp=t=>`<li class="sw-grp">${t}</li>`;
 const opt=(i,inner)=>`<a ${inner.attrs} id="sw-opt-${i}" role="option" class="${(i===active?'active':'')+(inner.cls||'')}">${inner.html}</a>`;
 /* Bundles lead, and on an empty box they are the only thing here: switching
    bundles is what the palette is for, and six views above them would push the
    answer below the fold to advertise a convenience. So views wait until what
    you typed reaches one, and arrive underneath, muted — found when wanted,
    silent when not. Standalone is the mirror image: no hub, no bundle to switch
    to, so views stop being the sideline and become the whole list.
    Headers only earn their line when both groups are up; over a lone list they
    label the obvious. Same for the you-are-here row — context on an empty box,
    noise once you are filtering. */
 function render(qs){const q=(qs||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const bs=matchBundles(q);
  const vs=(q||!HUB)?matchViews(q):[];
  const showB=HUB&&(bs.length||!q);
  const heads=showB&&vs.length>0;
  active=Math.min(active,Math.max(0,bs.length+vs.length-1));
  let h='';
  if(showB){
   if(heads)h+=grp('Bundles');
   if(!q)h+=`<a class="cur" aria-disabled="true"><span>${esc(IDENT)}</span><span class="slug">current</span></a>`;
   if(!SIBLINGS.length)h+='<a class="none"><span>only this bundle is registered — okf registry set &lt;dir&gt; adds more</span></a>';
   else h+=bs.map((b,i)=>opt(i,{
    attrs:`href="${esc(target(b.path))}" data-path="${esc(b.path)}"`,
    html:`<span>${esc(b.title)}${b.default?'<span class="sw-def">default</span>':''}</span><span class="slug">${esc(b.slug)}</span>`})).join('');
  }
  if(vs.length){
   if(heads)h+=grp('Views');
   h+=vs.map((x,i)=>opt(bs.length+i,{
```

```python
"""Recursive markdown documentation server.

Usage:  python3 server.py [port]
        python3 server.py 8080

Serves .md files from all subdirectories with auto-discovery,
syntax highlighting, dark mode, and search.
"""

import os, sys, json, http.server, socketserver, urllib.parse, re
import subprocess
import math
from datetime import datetime, timezone

PORT = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 8765
DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

# Load search index at startup
SEARCH_INDEX = None
SEARCH_DIR = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon')
SEARCH_PATH = os.path.join(SEARCH_DIR, 'search_index.json')
if os.path.exists(SEARCH_PATH):
    try:
        import math
        with open(SEARCH_PATH) as f:
            SEARCH_INDEX = json.load(f)
        print(f"   Search index: {len(SEARCH_INDEX['paths'])} docs")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   Search index: failed to load ({e})")

def search_query(q, limit=20):
    if not SEARCH_INDEX or not q.strip():
        return []
    q = q.lower().strip()
    query_words = set(re.findall(r'[a-z0-9]+', q))
    if not query_words:
        return []
    
    # Score each document by TF-IDF cosine similarity
    scores = []
    for i, doc in enumerate(SEARCH_INDEX['docs']):
        doc_words = doc.split()
        score = 0
        for w in query_words:
            if w in SEARCH_INDEX['idf']:
                tf = doc_words.count(w) / max(len(doc_words), 1)
                score += tf * SEARCH_INDEX['idf'][w]
        if score > 0:
            scores.append((score, i))
    
    scores.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
    results = []
    for score, i in scores[:limit]:
        # Get relative path
        full = SEARCH_INDEX['paths'][i]
        rel = os.path.relpath(full, DIR)
        # Get title from frontmatter
        with open(full) as f:
            first = f.read(300)
        m = re.search(r'title:\s*"?([^"\n]+)"?', first)
        title = m.group(1) if m else os.path.basename(full).replace('.md', '')
        results.append({
            'path': rel,
            'title': title,
            'score': round(score, 3)
        })
    return results


def get_system_stats():
    """Gather system statistics about the wiki bundle."""
    from collections import Counter
    
    stats = {
        'files': {'total': 0, 'entities': 0, 'sessions': 0, 'domains': 0},
        'sizes': {'total_bytes': 0, 'smallest': None, 'largest': None},
        'graph': {'nodes': 0, 'edges': 0},
        'domains': {},
        'tags': {},
    }
    
    entity_count = 0
    domain_counts = Counter()
    tag_counts = Counter()
    
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DIR):
        for fn in files:
            if not fn.endswith('.md'):
                continue
            fpath = os.path.join(root, fn)
            sz = os.path.getsize(fpath)
            stats['files']['total'] += 1
            stats['sizes']['total_bytes'] += sz
            
            if 'supercategories' in root:
                entity_count += 1
                if fn not in ('index.md', 'overview.md'):
                    parts = root.split(os.sep)
                    if 'domains' in parts:
                        didx = parts.index('domains')
                        if didx + 1 < len(parts):
                            domain_counts[parts[didx + 1]] += 1
                    # Read tags
                    try:
                        with open(fpath) as fh:
                            first = fh.read(300)
                        tm = re.search(r'tags:\s*\[(.*?)\]', first)
                        if tm:
                            tags = [t.strip().strip("\"'") for t in tm.group(1).split(',') if t.strip()]
                            for t in tags:
                                if t not in ('entity', 'ast', 'acronym'):
                                    tag_counts[t] += 1
                    except:
                        pass
            
            if stats['sizes']['smallest'] is None or sz < stats['sizes']['smallest']['size']:
                rel = os.path.relpath(fpath, DIR)
                stats['sizes']['smallest'] = {'path': rel, 'size': sz}
            if stats['sizes']['largest'] is None or sz > stats['sizes']['largest']['size']:
                rel = os.path.relpath(fpath, DIR)
                stats['sizes']['largest'] = {'path': rel, 'size': sz}
    
    # Session count
    session_dir = os.path.join(DIR, 'wiki', 'sessions')
    if os.path.isdir(session_dir):
        stats['files']['sessions'] = len([f for f in os.listdir(session_dir) if f.endswith('.md')])
    
    stats['files']['entities'] = entity_count
    stats['domains'] = dict(domain_counts.most_common())
    stats['tags'] = dict(tag_counts.most_common(20))
    
    # Graph stats
    graph_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'graph.json')
    if os.path.exists(graph_path):
        try:
            with open(graph_path) as f:
                g = json.load(f)
            stats['graph']['nodes'] = len(g.get('nodes', []))
            stats['graph']['edges'] = len(g.get('edges', []))
        except:
            pass
    
    stats['sizes']['total_mb'] = round(stats['sizes']['total_bytes'] / 1024 / 1024, 1)
    stats['sizes']['smallest']['size_kb'] = round(stats['sizes']['smallest']['size'] / 1024, 2)
    stats['sizes']['largest']['size_kb'] = round(stats['sizes']['largest']['size'] / 1024, 2)
    
    return stats

class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_json(self, data):
        """Send JSON response with CORS headers."""
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode())

    def do_GET(self):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)
        
        if parsed.path == '/graph.json':
            graph_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'graph.json')
            if os.path.exists(graph_path):
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
                self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache')
                self.end_headers()
                with open(graph_path) as f:
                    self.wfile.write(f.read().encode())
            else:
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(b'{"nodes":[],"edges":[]}')
            return
        
        if parsed.path == '/search':
            q = params.get('q', [''])[0]
            results = search_query(q)
            self.send_json(results)
            return
        
        if parsed.path == '/api/stats':
            stats = get_system_stats()
            self.send_json(stats)
            return
        

        # ── Hybrid Search API ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/search/hybrid':
            q = params.get('q', [''])[0]
            if not q:
                self.send_json({'query': '', 'results': [], 'total': 0})
                return
            try:
                import importlib.util
                sf_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'search_fusion.py')
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sf_module', sf_path)
                sf = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(sf)
                index = sf.load_index()
                if not index:
                    self.send_json({'error': 'Search index not built. Run: python3 .wiki-daemon/search_fusion.py build-index'})
                    return
                results = sf.search_query(index, q)
                self.send_json({'query': q, 'results': results, 'total': len(results)})
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Graph Topology API ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/graph/topology':
            try:
                graph_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'graph.json')
                root_id = params.get('root', [None])[0]
                depth = int(params.get('depth', ['2'])[0])
                with open(graph_path) as f:
                    g = json.load(f)
                if root_id:
                    # Build adjacency list
                    adj = {}
                    for e in g.get('edges', []):
                        adj.setdefault(e['source'], set()).add(e['target'])
                        adj.setdefault(e['target'], set()).add(e['source'])
                    # BFS from root
                    visited = set([root_id])
                    queue = [(root_id, 0)]
                    while queue:
                        node, d = queue.pop(0)
                        if d >= depth: continue
                        for neighbor in adj.get(node, set()):
                            if neighbor not in visited:
                                visited.add(neighbor)
                                queue.append((neighbor, d + 1))
                    # Filter nodes and edges
                    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in g.get('nodes', [])}
                    filtered_nodes = [node_map[nid] for nid in visited if nid in node_map]
                    filtered_edges = [e for e in g.get('edges', []) 
                                      if e['source'] in visited and e['target'] in visited]
                    self.send_json({
                        'nodes': filtered_nodes,
                        'edges': filtered_edges,
                        'root': root_id,
                        'depth': depth,
                        'total_nodes': len(g.get('nodes', [])),
                        'total_edges': len(g.get('edges', []))
                    })
                else:
                    self.send_json(g)
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Linter Health API ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/health/lint':
            try:
                import importlib.util
                kl_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'kb_linter.py')
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('kl_module', kl_path)
                kl = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(kl)
                report = kl.lint(return_json=True)
                self.send_json(report)
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Temporal History: file change log ──
        if parsed.path.startswith('/api/v2/history/log/'):
            filepath = parsed.path.replace('/api/v2/history/log/', '', 1)
            try:
                eng = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'temporal_engine.py')
                result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, eng, 'history', filepath],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
                data = json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout else []
                self.send_json(data)
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Temporal History: time-travel snapshot ──
        if parsed.path.startswith('/api/v2/history/snapshot'):
            filepath = params.get('path', [''])[0]
            timestamp = params.get('ts', [''])[0]
            if not filepath or not timestamp:
                self.send_json({'error': 'Required: path=<filepath>&ts=<timestamp>'})
                return
            try:
                eng = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'temporal_engine.py')
                result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, eng, 'snapshot', filepath, timestamp],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
                data = json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout else {'error': 'No data'}
                self.send_json(data)
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Build search index ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/search/build':
            try:
                result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'search_fusion.py'), 'build-index'],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
                self.send_json({'status': 'ok' if result.returncode == 0 else 'error', 'output': result.stdout})
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        

        def _load_audit_module():
            import importlib.util
            sa_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'build_stub_audit.py')
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('build_stub_audit', sa_path)
            sa = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
            spec.loader.exec_module(sa)
            return sa

        # ── Stub Auditor live data ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/stubs':
            try:
                self.send_json(_load_audit_module().scan_stubs())
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return

        # ── Guidance live data (coverage + focus + guidance queue) ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/guidance':
            try:
                self.send_json(_load_audit_module().scan_guidance())
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return

        # ── Guidance queue status ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/guidance/queue':
            buffer_dir = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'buffers')

            def _load(p):
                try:
                    with open(p, encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                        return json.load(fh)
                except Exception:
                    return None

            self.send_json({
                'queue': _load(os.path.join(buffer_dir, 'guidance-queue.json')),
                'guidance_manifest': _load(os.path.join(buffer_dir, 'guidance-inference.json')),
                'stub_queue': _load(os.path.join(buffer_dir, 'stub-audit-queue.json')),
                'manifest': _load(os.path.join(buffer_dir, 'stub-audit-inference.json')),
            })
            return

        # ── Stub Auditor queue status ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/stubs/queue':
            buffer_dir = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'buffers')

            def _load(p):
                try:
                    with open(p, encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                        return json.load(fh)
                except Exception:
                    return None

            self.send_json({
                'queue': _load(os.path.join(buffer_dir, 'stub-audit-queue.json')),
                'manifest': _load(os.path.join(buffer_dir, 'stub-audit-inference.json')),
            })
            return

        # ── Serve individual file content ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/file':
            filepath = params.get('path', [''])[0]
            if not filepath:
                self.send_json({'error': 'Missing path parameter'})
                return
            safe = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(DIR, filepath))
            if not safe.startswith(DIR):
                self.send_json({'error': 'Path traversal blocked'})
                return
            if not os.path.isfile(safe):
                self.send_response(404)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'error': 'File not found: ' + filepath}).encode())
                return
            try:
                with open(safe, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as fh:
                    md = fh.read()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/plain; charset=utf-8')
                self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
                self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(md.encode('utf-8'))
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return

        # ── List all .md files ──
        if self.path == '/files.json':
            # Serve the enriched files.json (path + type + title + tags) from
            # disk when present so the app's Type grouping, Content/Meta split
            # and badges work identically in live and static modes. Fall back
            # to a plain path list if the enriched snapshot is missing.
            enriched = os.path.join(DIR, 'files.json')
            if os.path.isfile(enriched):
                try:
                    with open(enriched, encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                        self.send_json(json.load(fh))
                    return
                except Exception:
                    pass
            # Recursively find all .md files, return relative paths
            md_files = []
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DIR):
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.') and d != '__pycache__']
                for f in sorted(files):
                    if f.endswith('.md'):
                        full = os.path.join(root, f)
                        rel = os.path.relpath(full, DIR)
                        md_files.append(rel)
            self.send_json(md_files)
            return
        
        # Fall through to default file server for everything else
        return super().do_GET()

    def _run_daemon_script(self, script, args, timeout=300):
        path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', script)
        try:
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, path] + args,
                                    capture_output=True, text=True,
                                    cwd=DIR, timeout=timeout)
            return {'ok': result.returncode == 0,
                    'output': (result.stdout or '') + (result.stderr or '')}
        except Exception as e:
            return {'ok': False, 'output': str(e)}

    def _safe_md_path(self, raw):
        """Resolve an API-supplied path to a writable .md file under DIR."""
        raw = (raw or '').replace('\\', '/').lstrip('/')
        if not raw.endswith('.md'):
            raw += '.md'
        safe = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(DIR, raw))
        if not safe.startswith(DIR + os.sep) and safe != DIR:
            return None
        rel = os.path.relpath(safe, DIR).replace(os.sep, '/')
        bad = ('/.' in '/' + rel) or rel.startswith('.') or rel.startswith('__pycache__')
        bad = bad or rel.startswith('.wiki-daemon/') or rel in ('server.py', 'index.html')
        bad = bad or not os.path.isfile(safe)
        if bad:
            return None
        return safe

    def _run_git(self, args):
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=DIR, timeout=60)
            return {'ok': r.returncode == 0, 'output': (r.stdout or '') + (r.stderr or '')}
        except Exception as e:
            return {'ok': False, 'output': str(e)}

    def _git_or_fs(self, args, fallback):
        """git command with plain-filesystem fallback for untracked files."""
        r = self._run_git(args)
        if r['ok']:
            return r
        try:
            fallback()
            return {'ok': True, 'output': 'filesystem operation (untracked file)'}
        except Exception as e:
            r['output'] = (r['output'] + '\nfs fallback failed: %s' % e).strip()
            return r

    def _read_json_body(self):
        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length else {}
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_json({'error': 'Invalid JSON body: %s' % e})
            return None

    def do_POST(self):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/stubs/queue/plan':
            self.send_json(self._run_daemon_script('drain_stub_queue.py', ['--plan']))
            return
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/stubs/queue/apply':
            self.send_json(self._run_daemon_script('drain_stub_queue.py', ['--apply']))
            return
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/stubs/build':
            self.send_json(self._run_daemon_script('build_stub_audit.py', []))
            return

        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/guidance/plan':
            self.send_json(self._run_daemon_script('drain_guidance.py', ['--plan']))
            return
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/guidance/apply':
            self.send_json(self._run_daemon_script('drain_guidance.py', ['--apply']))
            return

        # ── Article tools: edit / archive / delete ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/file':
            body = self._read_json_body()
            if body is None:
                return
            safe = self._safe_md_path(body.get('path', ''))
            if not safe:
                self.send_json({'error': 'Unwritable or missing path'})
                return
            content = body.get('content')
            if content is None:
                self.send_json({'error': 'Missing content'})
                return
            try:
                with open(safe, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                    fh.write(content)
                rel = os.path.relpath(safe, DIR)
                print(f"   File saved: {rel}")
                self.send_json({'status': 'ok', 'path': rel})
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/file/archive':
            body = self._read_json_body()
            if body is None:
                return
            safe = self._safe_md_path(body.get('path', ''))
            if not safe:
                self.send_json({'error': 'Unwritable or missing path'})
                return
            rel = os.path.relpath(safe, DIR)
            today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
            dst = os.path.join(DIR, 'raw', 'archive', 'stub-audit-' + today, rel)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
            self.send_json(self._git_or_fs(
                ['git', 'mv', safe, dst],
                lambda: os.rename(safe, dst)))
            return
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/file/delete':
            body = self._read_json_body()
            if body is None:
                return
            safe = self._safe_md_path(body.get('path', ''))
            if not safe:
                self.send_json({'error': 'Unwritable or missing path'})
                return
            self.send_json(self._git_or_fs(
                ['git', 'rm', '-q', safe],
                lambda: os.remove(safe)))
            return

        if parsed.path not in ('/api/v2/stubs/queue', '/api/v2/guidance/queue'):
            self.send_error(404, 'Not found')
            return

        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length else {}
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_json({'error': 'Invalid JSON body: %s' % e})
            return
        items = payload.get('items', [])
        if not isinstance(items, list):
            self.send_json({'error': 'Body must be {"items": [...]}'})
            return

        def _save_queue(filename, label):
            try:
                buffer_dir = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'buffers')
                os.makedirs(buffer_dir, exist_ok=True)
                queue_path = os.path.join(buffer_dir, filename)
                payload.setdefault('queued_at', datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='seconds'))
                payload['count'] = len(items)
                tmp = queue_path + '.tmp'
                with open(tmp, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                    json.dump(payload, fh, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
                os.replace(tmp, queue_path)
                rel = os.path.relpath(queue_path, DIR)
                print(f"   {label} saved: {rel} ({len(items)} items)")
                return {'status': 'ok', 'path': rel, 'count': len(items)}
            except Exception as e:
                return {'error': str(e)}

        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/guidance/queue':
            self.send_json(_save_queue('guidance-queue.json', 'Guidance queue'))
            return
        self.send_json(_save_queue('stub-audit-queue.json', 'Stub queue'))

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        print(f"  {args[0]} {args[1]} {args[2]}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Check daemon buffer directory health
    buffer_dir = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'buffers')
    if not os.path.isdir(buffer_dir):
        print(f"   ⚠ Buffer dir missing: {buffer_dir}")
        print(f"     Run: mkdir -p {buffer_dir}")
    else:
        buffer_count = len(os.listdir(buffer_dir))
        print(f"   Daemon buffers: {buffer_dir} ({buffer_count} files)")
        signals_dir = os.path.join(buffer_dir, 'signals')
        if os.path.isdir(signals_dir):
            sig_count = len(os.listdir(signals_dir))
            print(f"   Pending signals: {sig_count}")
    
    # Count .md files
    count = sum(1 for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DIR) 
                for f in files if f.endswith('.md')
                if not any(d.startswith('.') for d in root.split(os.sep)))
    print(f"📄 md — Self-Contained Documentation Viewer")
    print(f"   Serving: {DIR}")
    print(f"   .md files: {count}")
    print(f"   URL: http://localhost:{PORT}")
    print(f"   Auto-discovers files recursively from all subdirectories")
    class ReuseAddrTCPServer(socketserver.TCPServer):
        allow_reuse_address = True
    with ReuseAddrTCPServer(('', PORT), Handler) as httpd:
        httpd.serve_forever()
```

### `components/mykb/start.sh`  [1KB]

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# mykb — start both dashboard and OKF graph server
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
DASH_PORT=${1:-8826}
OKF_PORT=${2:-8808}
PID_DIR="$DIR/.wiki-daemon"
DASH_PID="$PID_DIR/dashboard.pid"
OKF_PID="$PID_DIR/okf-graph.pid"
LOG="$PID_DIR/server.log"

mkdir -p "$PID_DIR"

stop_old() {
  local pidfile="$1" name="$2"
  if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
    local pid=$(cat "$pidfile")
    if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "  Stopping old $name (PID $pid)"
      kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
      sleep 0.5
    fi
    rm -f "$pidfile"
  fi
}

echo "🔍 Checking for existing servers..."
stop_old "$DASH_PID" "dashboard"
stop_old "$OKF_PID" "okf-graph"

# Start dashboard (server.py)
echo "🚀 Starting dashboard on http://127.0.0.1:$DASH_PORT"
cd "$DIR"
nohup python3 server.py "$DASH_PORT" >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &
echo $! > "$DASH_PID"

# Start OKF graph server
echo "🌐 Starting OKF graph on http://127.0.0.1:$OKF_PORT"
nohup okf server "$DIR" -p "$OKF_PORT" --title "mykb" >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &
echo $! > "$OKF_PID"

sleep 1.5

# Verify both are running
DASH_OK=false
OKF_OK=false
kill -0 "$(cat "$DASH_PID" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null && DASH_OK=true
kill -0 "$(cat "$OKF_PID" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null && OKF_OK=true

if $DASH_OK; then
  echo "  ✅ Dashboard → http://127.0.0.1:$DASH_PORT"
else
  echo "  ❌ Dashboard failed — tail $LOG"
fi

if $OKF_OK; then
  echo "  ✅ OKF Graph → http://127.0.0.1:$OKF_PORT"
else
  echo "  ❌ OKF Graph failed — tail $LOG"
fi

# Open browser if available
if command -v termux-open-url &>/dev/null; then
  termux-open-url "http://127.0.0.1:$DASH_PORT" 2>/dev/null &
elif command -v xdg-open &>/dev/null; then
  xdg-open "http://127.0.0.1:$DASH_PORT" 2>/dev/null &
fi
```

```html
      <details><summary>Months</summary><table id="cum-t"></table></details>
    </div>
    <div class="panel" id="avg-month">
      <h2>Average words per month</h2>
      <p class="why">Mean body length of articles added each month — acquisition volume vs. depth.</p>
      <div class="chart"><canvas id="avg-c"></canvas></div>
      <details><summary>Months</summary><table id="avg-t"></table></details>
    </div>
    <div class="panel" id="last60">
      <h2>Files per day (last 60 days)</h2>
      <p class="why">Recent acquisition activity from frontmatter timestamps.</p>
      <div class="chart"><canvas id="last60-c"></canvas></div>
      <details><summary>Days</summary><table id="last60-t"></table></details>
    </div>
    <div class="panel" id="graph">
      <h2>Node degree distribution</h2>
      <p class="why">How many links each graph node has (degree buckets over all nodes).</p>
      <div class="chart"><canvas id="deg-c"></canvas></div>
      <details><summary>Buckets</summary><table id="deg-t"></table></details>
    </div>
    <div class="panel" id="topnodes">
      <h2>Most connected nodes</h2>
      <p class="why">Top 15 graph nodes by degree (in + out links).</p>
      <div class="chart"><canvas id="topn-c"></canvas></div>
      <details><summary>Nodes</summary><table id="topn-t"></table></details>
    </div>
    <div class="panel" id="links-in">
      <h2>Most linked-to articles</h2>
      <p class="why">Top 15 by inbound graph links — the hub pages of the wiki.</p>
      <div class="chart"><canvas id="li-c"></canvas></div>
      <details><summary>Nodes</summary><table id="li-t"></table></details>
    </div>
    <div class="panel" id="linkshist">
      <h2>Wikilinks per file</h2>
      <p class="why">Number of <code>[[wikilinks]]</code> per file, bucketed.</p>
      <div class="chart"><canvas id="links-c"></canvas></div>
      <details><summary>Buckets</summary><table id="links-t"></table></details>
    </div>
    <div class="panel wide" id="quality">
      <h2>Length vs. linking (scatter)</h2>
      <p class="why">Each dot is a file: body words (x) vs. wikilinks (y). Color = status. Dense linking at top-right is the goal.</p>
      <div class="chart" style="height:360px"><canvas id="scatter-c"></canvas></div>
      <details><summary>Raw sample</summary><table id="scatter-t"></table></details>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>
<footer>
  <p>Word counts = whitespace tokens in body text with YAML frontmatter stripped. Index pages (<code>index.md</code>) and the bundle log (<code>log.md</code>) are excluded from all article-level stats; graph node/edge totals still include them. Link counts include frontmatter wikilinks. Timestamps read from frontmatter; files without one are omitted from time charts.</p>
  <p>Regenerate: <code>python3 components/mykb/.wiki-daemon/build_stats.py</code> · Snapshots: <code>python3 gen-static-data.py --check</code></p>
</footer>
```
